model.tooltip: The model to patch.

attention.tooltip: The dense attention backend. Comfy Kitchen attention uses quantized INT8 attention and is available only on Nvidia and AMD GPUs.

output_tooltips: The model with the selected attention backend.
ModelAttentionBackend.name: ModelAttentionBackend
ModelAttentionBackend.description: Selects the dense attention implementation for the model. When used with Block Sparse Attention, this backend is used whenever sparse attention is inactive or unsupported.

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, snapped up to the model's 17k+5 grid (124 = ~5s; trained range is ~124-362, longer is untested)

EmptyMiniMaxH3LatentAV.name: EmptyMiniMaxH3LatentAV
EmptyMiniMaxH3LatentAV.description: Joint video+audio latent for MiniMax H3. Duration snaps to the model's 17k+5 frame grid at 24 fps.

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, snapped up to the model's 17k+5 grid (124 = ~5s; trained range is ~124-362, longer is untested)

frame_idx.tooltip: Frame index to anchor the image or the clip's first frame at. Negative values are counted from the end of the video.

vae.tooltip: Video VAE, needed when an image is connected.

audio_vae.tooltip: Audio VAE, needed when an audio is connected.

image.tooltip: Image or video frames to anchor. Multi-frame batches are anchored as a clip and cropped down to the model's valid clip lengths: 5, 22, 39... (17k + 5) frames. Batches shorter than 5 frames use only the first image.

audio.tooltip: Soundtrack to anchor starting at the same frame index, cropped to the video's remaining duration.

MiniMaxH3AddGuide.name: MiniMaxH3AddGuide
MiniMaxH3AddGuide.description: Anchor an image, a short clip, audio, or a clip with its soundtrack at any frame of a MiniMax H3 video. Chain several nodes to anchor several frames.

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, (124 = ~5s, trained range is ~124-362)

ref_image_size.tooltip: Reference image sizing. 'match' scales each ref (down only, keeping aspect) to the generation's pixel area; 'max' uses the reference pipeline's 2048px short edge for best identity fidelity. Reference tokens ride through every sampling step, so 'max' can be several times slower.

vae.tooltip: Video VAE. Without it reference images/videos only condition the text encoder.

audio_vae.tooltip: Audio VAE. Without it reference audio only conditions the text encoder.

ref_image.tooltip: Reference image (downscaled to 2048 short edge if larger, never upscaled)

ref_video_audio.tooltip: Soundtrack of the same-numbered reference video

MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.name: MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo
MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.description: <Picture i> / <Video k> / <Audio j> reference conditioning for MiniMax H3. Use the same tags when prompting.

source_video.tooltip: Video behind the mask; only read when a mask is given.

MiniMaxH3FunControlNetApply.name: MiniMaxH3FunControlNetApply
MiniMaxH3FunControlNetApply.description: Apply a MiniMax H3 Fun ControlNet to a text-to-video model as a model patch.

model.tooltip: The model to patch.

selection.tooltip: Method used to choose key blocks for full token-level attention. sol-attn: Sparsifying Online Attention uses a training-free adaptive threshold for each attention head and query block. sla: Sparse-Linear Attention keeps a fixed percentage of the highest-scoring key blocks; use only with model weights trained for this pattern. vsa: Video Sparse Attention (FastVideo) uses 3D video-cube tiling and a learned coarse attention branch; requires FastH3 model weights.

tau.tooltip: Threshold in score-distribution sigmas. Higher is sparser: 1.0 keeps ~16% of key blocks exact, 1.5 ~7%, 2.0 ~2.7%.

keep_percent.tooltip: Percent of key blocks each query block keeps exactly (sinks and the diagonal ride on top). The selection SLA-style LoRAs are distilled against; without such a LoRA higher is closer to dense.
Percent of video cubes each query cube keeps; FastH3-VSA checkpoints are trained at 10. Uses the model's to_gate_compress layers for the coarse branch when present.

start_percent.tooltip: Percentage point when sparse attention begins. Before this point, attention stays dense.

end_percent.tooltip: Percentage point when sparse attention ends. After this point, attention returns to dense.

dense_blocks.tooltip: Transformer blocks that always run dense, e.g. '0, 1, 47-49'.

min_tokens.tooltip: Sequences shorter than this stay dense.

extra_tokens.tooltip: Extra top-scoring tokens each query block attends beyond its selected blocks. Closer to dense for more attention time; 256 recommended, 0 disables. Ignored for VSA.

sink_conditioning.tooltip: MiniMax-H3 only. exact_kv: every query attends the packed text/audio/reference rows exactly (~3% cost). exact_kv_and_rows: additionally runs the target-audio query rows dense (keeps generated audio intact).

verbose.tooltip: Logs whether each attention shape used sparse attention or why it stayed dense.

output_tooltips: The model with block-sparse attention applied.
BlockSparseAttention.name: BlockSparseAttention
BlockSparseAttention.description: Applies block-sparse attention to eligible model attention layers, reducing compute for long sequences. The speed gain grows with sequence length since short sequences are usually faster dense. Outside the start/end_percent, dense_blocks and under min_tokens, the model uses the dense model attention backend. Use the node Model Attention Backend to select that fallback.

resolution.tooltip: Frame size budget. 720p costs roughly twice the GPU-seconds of 480p.

duration_seconds.tooltip: Length in seconds. The pipeline quantises to 17-frame steps at 24fps, so the clip lands within about two thirds of a second of this.

ComfyCloudMiniMaxH3TextToVideoNode.name: ComfyCloudMiniMaxH3TextToVideoNode
ComfyCloudMiniMaxH3TextToVideoNode.display_name: Comfy Cloud MiniMax H3 Text to Video [BETA]
ComfyCloudMiniMaxH3TextToVideoNode.description: BETA. The Comfy Cloud node set is still changing: options may be added or removed, and a workflow may be retired. Generates a video with a matching soundtrack from a text prompt, using MiniMax H3. Picture and audio come out of the same pass rather than being dubbed on afterwards. Runs on a Comfy Cloud GPU, billed by how long it runs at $0.001295/GPU-second (0.27 credits). Paid in credits, no Cloud subscription required.

resolution.tooltip: Frame size budget. 720p costs roughly twice the GPU-seconds of 480p.

duration_seconds.tooltip: Length in seconds. The pipeline quantises to 17-frame steps at 24fps, so the clip lands within about two thirds of a second of this.

ComfyCloudMiniMaxH3FirstLastFrameToVideo.name: ComfyCloudMiniMaxH3FirstLastFrameToVideoNode
ComfyCloudMiniMaxH3FirstLastFrameToVideo.display_name: Comfy Cloud MiniMax H3 First-Last Frame to Video [BETA]
ComfyCloudMiniMaxH3FirstLastFrameToVideo.description: BETA. The Comfy Cloud node set is still changing: options may be added or removed, and a workflow may be retired. Generates the motion between two keyframes, with a matching soundtrack, using MiniMax H3. Give it the opening and closing frames and the model fills in the shot between them. The last frame is optional: leave it out and the motion runs away from the first frame instead. Runs on a Comfy Cloud GPU, billed by how long it runs at $0.001295/GPU-second (0.27 credits). Paid in credits, no Cloud subscription required.

resolution.tooltip: Frame size budget. 720p costs roughly twice the GPU-seconds of 480p.

duration_seconds.tooltip: Length in seconds. The pipeline quantises to 17-frame steps at 24fps, so the clip lands within about two thirds of a second of this.

ComfyCloudMiniMaxH3ImageToVideoNode.name: ComfyCloudMiniMaxH3ImageToVideoNode
ComfyCloudMiniMaxH3ImageToVideoNode.display_name: Comfy Cloud MiniMax H3 Image to Video [BETA]
ComfyCloudMiniMaxH3ImageToVideoNode.description: BETA. The Comfy Cloud node set is still changing: options may be added or removed, and a workflow may be retired. Animates a still into a video with a matching soundtrack, using MiniMax H3. Feed it a clip's closing frame and it continues the sequence, so chaining several builds a longer shot. Runs on a Comfy Cloud GPU, billed by how long it runs at $0.001295/GPU-second (0.27 credits). Paid in credits, no Cloud subscription required.

low_vram.tooltip: OFF (default): apply the LoRA at run time (bypass) — sharpest, but costs extra peak VRAM. ON: merge the LoRA into the weights — lowest VRAM so small GPUs can run, but softer on quantized bases (the delta is partly rounded away). Turn ON only if you OOM.

MiniMaxH3TurboLoRA.name: MiniMaxH3TurboLoRA
MiniMaxH3TurboLoRA.description: Apply the MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA to the H3 diffusion model.

MiniMaxH3TurboSampler.name: MiniMaxH3TurboSampler
MiniMaxH3TurboSampler.description: 4-step sampler for the MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA. Feed into SamplerCustomAdvanced and set the scheduler to 4 steps. Auto-adapts to the ComfyUI version: on recent builds that handle the audio schedule natively (ModelSamplingAV) it steps as a plain single-schedule sampler; on older builds it steps video and audio on their separate clocks.

length.tooltip: 24fps; snapped up to the 17n+5 H3 grid.

audio_mode.tooltip: lock_source preserves source latent; remix_source denoises it; reference_only/native generate target audio.

add_source_as_reference.tooltip: Presents drive_audio to Qwen/DiT as an official <Audio N> reference.

prompt_primary_audio_ordinal.tooltip: Prompt audio ordinal intended as the primary source; remapped after video soundtracks. Use 0 to disable.

final_audio.tooltip: Optional clean/stem track passed through for final mux; defaults to drive_audio.

allow_above_reference_area.tooltip: Legacy workflow compatibility input. Canvases above the 1920x1088 reference area are now allowed regardless of this value and only emit a VRAM/runtime warning.

MiniMaxH3AudioConditioningT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioConditioningT8
MiniMaxH3AudioConditioningT8.description: Unified native H3 T2VA/I2VA/FL2VA/L2VA/Ref2VA/hybrid conditioning with correct media tags and source-audio control.

MiniMaxH3AudioLatentControlT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioLatentControlT8
MiniMaxH3AudioLatentControlT8.description: Injects source audio once and preserves an existing video noise mask.

source_duration_seconds.tooltip: 0 means unknown; the Audio Window node reads it from AUDIO.

MiniMaxH3AudioWindowT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioWindowT8
MiniMaxH3AudioWindowT8.description: Slices/pads source AUDIO to an aligned H3 context and returns exact final trim metadata.

MiniMaxH3OutputTrimT8.name: MiniMaxH3OutputTrimT8
MiniMaxH3OutputTrimT8.description: Applies Duration Planner trim metadata to decoded IMAGE frames and optional AUDIO.

sampler_name.tooltip: dual_clock_euler preserves the original T8 explicit dual-clock path. Other choices use ComfyUI's native MiniMax H3 FLOW_AV protocol.

scheduler.tooltip: native_flow preserves the original shifted uniform H3 flow schedule. beta57 uses ComfyUI's beta scheduler with alpha=0.5 and beta=0.7. Other choices use ComfyUI's built-in scheduler implementation.

MiniMaxH3DualClockSamplerT8.name: MiniMaxH3DualClockSamplerT8
MiniMaxH3DualClockSamplerT8.description: MiniMax H3 sampling setup with separate video/audio clocks. The default dual_clock_euler + native_flow path is unchanged; other ComfyUI samplers use native FLOW_AV support.

video_steps.tooltip: Number of committed video Euler macro updates.

audio_steps.tooltip: Number of audio micro updates and full joint H3 DiT calls. Must be at least video_steps.

MiniMaxH3MultiRateSamplerEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MultiRateSamplerEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MultiRateSamplerEXPT8.description: Experimental H3 Euler sampler: video uses macro steps while audio uses more micro steps. audio_steps is the actual number of full joint H3 DiT calls, so 4/10 costs about 10 model evaluations, not 4. Start with 4/8.

target_mode.tooltip: 1-frame is cheapest and most experimental; 22-frame is the next native 17n+5 grid point; 124-frame is the approximate trained-range baseline.

reference_strength.tooltip: 1 keeps reference latents clean; lower values add seeded reference noise.

edit_image.tooltip: Primary source image, presented to Ref2VA as <Picture 1>.

MiniMaxH3StillConditioningT8.name: MiniMaxH3StillConditioningT8
MiniMaxH3StillConditioningT8.description: Experimental Ref2VA single/multi-image semantic editing. Picture 1 is the primary edit source; this is not mask-based pixel editing.

MiniMaxH3StillPreflightT8.name: MiniMaxH3StillPreflightT8
MiniMaxH3StillPreflightT8.description: Checks the experimental Ref2VA still-image contract before sampling.

MiniMaxH3StillDecodeT8.name: MiniMaxH3StillDecodeT8
MiniMaxH3StillDecodeT8.description: Decodes only the H3 video latent and selects one still candidate.

minimum_render_frames.tooltip: Keep 124 for the current approximate H3 trained minimum.

timeline_start_seconds.tooltip: -1 derives the fixed-settings timeline from the quantized first and continuation segment durations; set it explicitly if earlier settings differ.

is_final_segment.tooltip: Only the final segment may trim a hidden tail for an exact requested duration. Its continuation checkpoint is disabled automatically.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoPlannerT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoPlannerT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoPlannerT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Segment Planner / 长视频分段规划 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoPlannerT8.description: Plans one retry-safe H3 chain segment. Segment 0 has no overlap; later segments render a 5/22/39-frame head context and expose exact AV trim metadata.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoContextLoadT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoContextLoadT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoContextLoadT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Previous Context / 读取上一段上下文 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoContextLoadT8.description: Segment 0 returns an empty passthrough context. Segment N loads only the validated AV tail saved for segment N-1; it never selects the newest file.

context_audio.tooltip: video_and_audio continues the generated AV latent. video_only keeps motion context but leaves audio to the selected native/source mode.

first_frame.tooltip: Exact frame 0 for the first segment. Later segments normally ignore it; persistent_identity_reference may reuse it as a compatibility fallback.

first_frame_reuse.tooltip: segment0_only preserves legacy behavior. persistent_identity_reference adds one non-timeline image reference on continuation segments. A connected persistent_identity_image is preferred; otherwise first_frame is reused. This remains experimental, adds reference rows/VRAM, and is not identity lock.

persistent_identity_image.tooltip: Optional continuation-only identity crop. Prefer one clear face or upper-body image. It is ignored on segment 0 and unless first_frame_reuse is set to persistent_identity_reference; first_frame still owns exact frame 0.

persistent_identity_strategy.tooltip: single_reference uses persistent_identity_image when connected, otherwise first_frame. scene_plus_identity supplies both images as separate references; it costs more reference rows/VRAM and remains a gated experiment.

persistent_identity_interval.tooltip: Continuation injection interval. 1 preserves the existing every-segment behavior; 2 injects on continuation segments 1, 3, 5, ... and lets the intermediate segments use motion context only. This is an Experimental identity-versus-motion control, not an adaptive drift detector.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoConditioningT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoConditioningT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoConditioningT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Long Video Conditioning / 长视频续写条件 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoConditioningT8.description: Independent long-video conditioning. It returns a cloned MODEL with a local H3 payload/layout patch; the input MODEL and all stable T8 nodes remain unchanged.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoContextSaveT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoContextSaveT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoContextSaveT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Save AV Tail / 保存下一段上下文 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoContextSaveT8.description: Atomically saves only the bounded H3 AV tail for this segment. Re-running the same segment replaces its own slot and never changes segment N-1.

candidate_id.tooltip: Blank creates a unique id. Set a new id for every intentional re-roll.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoCandidateSaveT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoCandidateSaveT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoCandidateSaveT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Save Candidate / 保存候选片段 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoCandidateSaveT8.description: Atomically writes only the current trimmed segment plus its bounded AV tail. It does not change accepted history; connect the descriptor to Review & Accept.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoAcceptCandidateT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoAcceptCandidateT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoAcceptCandidateT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Review & Accept / 预览并接受候选 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoAcceptCandidateT8.description: Preview with accept_candidate=false. When true, atomically promotes the candidate and updates the manifest. Replacing a segment invalidates all dependent later segments.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoAcceptedContextLoadT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoAcceptedContextLoadT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoAcceptedContextLoadT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Accepted Context / 读取已接受上下文 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoAcceptedContextLoadT8.description: Loads segment N-1 only from the accepted manifest. It also returns the exact parent candidate identity needed to prevent accepting a stale continuation.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoComposeAcceptedT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoComposeAcceptedT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoComposeAcceptedT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Compose Accepted / 合成已接受片段 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoComposeAcceptedT8.description: Verifies every accepted file and streams them into one MP4. Memory is bounded to one video frame plus one segment of PCM; cosine_bridge preserves the exact sample count.

render_window_frames.tooltip: Fixed internal H3 window for every segment. Keep 124 for the current bounded-memory baseline; larger windows require separate VRAM validation.

segment_prompts_json.tooltip: Optional list/object. Each item may contain prompt, seed and note. Unspecified segments use global_prompt and the selected seed policy.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoOrchestratorT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoOrchestratorT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoOrchestratorT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Chain Orchestrator / 总时长自动分段 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoOrchestratorT8.description: Converts a total duration into a fixed-window H3 timeline and resumes at the first unaccepted manifest segment. A completed final manifest blocks downstream sampling instead of generating an accidental extra segment.

execution_mode.tooltip: auto_accept_and_continue accepts every successfully rendered candidate without human review and queues the next segment.

max_retries.tooltip: Additional attempts per failed segment; resolution is never reduced.

release_policy.tooltip: Applied after every accepted segment, including pause and final. clear_execution_cache resets ComfyUI execution tensors and soft cache. unload_all_models is stronger but globally unloads every ComfyUI model, not only H3.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoBackgroundStartT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoBackgroundStartT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoBackgroundStartT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Background Start / 后台长视频启动 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoBackgroundStartT8.description: Registers the current prompt before model execution so upstream OOM/errors can be retried. review_only is non-mutating; auto_accept_and_continue must be selected explicitly. Connect chain_id and controller outputs to the background workflow.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoAutoQueueT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoAutoQueueT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoAutoQueueT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Auto Accept & Continue / 自动接受续跑 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoAutoQueueT8.description: Terminal node for the explicit background workflow. It accepts the current candidate, optionally composes a final MP4, requests the selected release policy even at pause/final boundaries, and queues exactly one next prompt. review_only remains non-mutating.

voice_description.default: an adult speaker with a natural warm voice, clear diction, human micro-pauses, and close conversational delivery

rights_confirmed.tooltip: Required for reference_voice. Confirm that you have consent or another lawful right to use the connected person's voice.

reference_duration_seconds.tooltip: 0 selects up to the first available 15 seconds after start.

peak_limit_minus_3_dbfs.tooltip: Only attenuates peaks above -3 dBFS; it never boosts quiet references.

MiniMaxH3VoiceProfileT8.name: MiniMaxH3VoiceProfileT8
MiniMaxH3VoiceProfileT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Voice Profile / 音色资料 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3VoiceProfileT8.description: Creates a workflow-memory voice profile. Reference mode prepares a 2-15s 32kHz stereo anchor and requires explicit rights confirmation.

acting_direction.default: natural, emotionally connected, with clear diction

emotion_intensity.tooltip: Prompt strength only; this is not a calibrated acoustic control.

target_units.tooltip: Words for Latin text; characters for CJK text.

MiniMaxH3SpeechPlanT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechPlanT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechPlanT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Plan / 语音规划 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechPlanT8.description: Separates spoken text from acting direction and performs language-aware chunking. It never guesses the render duration.

render_seconds.tooltip: Explicit H3 render window. It is aligned to 17n+5 frames and is not inferred from text length.

MiniMaxH3SpeechConditioningT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechConditioningT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechConditioningT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Conditioning / 语音条件 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechConditioningT8.description: Builds native H3 audio-first conditioning without loading a model. Described voice uses T2VA; reference voice uses Ref2VA with a dark image.

MiniMaxH3SpeechDecodeT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechDecodeT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechDecodeT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Decode / 仅解码语音 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechDecodeT8.description: Decodes only the H3 audio latent. Conservative energy trim is optional and does not replace ASR or speaker verification.

asr_model_directory.tooltip: Absolute faster-whisper CTranslate2 directory, or a folder name under ComfyUI/models/TTS. Required only when verification is enabled.

speaker_model_directory.tooltip: Local WavLM X-Vector model directory. A voice_profile with a reference is also required when speaker checking is enabled.

min_speaker_similarity.tooltip: Dataset-dependent EXP threshold; report_cosine does not gate output.

peak_limit_dbfs.tooltip: Final attenuation-only peak protection; never boosts quiet speech.

MiniMaxH3SpeechVerifyT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechVerifyT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechVerifyT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Verify & Align / ASR校验裁切 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechVerifyT8.description: Runs optional CPU faster-whisper verification. Exact-target mode removes Ref2VA lead-in only when the complete requested text is found in order.

MiniMaxH3SpeechAssembleT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechAssembleT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechAssembleT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Assemble / 语音时间线 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechAssembleT8.description: Assembles rendered turns on exact sample boundaries and emits actual audio-boundary timeline plus planned-text SRT/VTT.

MiniMaxH3DialogueScriptT8.name: MiniMaxH3DialogueScriptT8
MiniMaxH3DialogueScriptT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Dialogue Script / 对话脚本 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3DialogueScriptT8.description: Builds a two- or three-speaker, one-turn-at-a-time dialogue plan. Use 'S1: text' lines or structured JSON for per-turn acting and timing.

MiniMaxH3DialogueTurnSelectT8.name: MiniMaxH3DialogueTurnSelectT8
MiniMaxH3DialogueTurnSelectT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Dialogue Turn Select / 选择对白句 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3DialogueTurnSelectT8.description: Selects one dialogue turn and its bound voice profile for independent generation, retry, and replacement.

MiniMaxH3SpeechFinalizeT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechFinalizeT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechFinalizeT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Finalize & Release / 完成并释放 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechFinalizeT8.description: Passes AUDIO through, then requests the selected ComfyUI release policy. unload_all_models is global and is never described as H3-only.

trim_mode.tooltip: New reference-voice workflows conservatively remove only low-energy H3 alignment padding. Existing workflows saved as none remain unchanged.

asr_model_directory.tooltip: Optional CPU faster-whisper CTranslate2 model directory. Required only when verify_mode is not off.

MiniMaxH3SpeechStudioT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechStudioT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechStudioT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Studio / 一站式语音 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechStudioT8.description: Native ComfyUI speech graph: conditioning -> sampler -> audio-only decode -> explicit release. Stock res_multistep/simple is the initial quality baseline.

positive.tooltip: Conditioning containing MiniMax H3 image/video refs or keyframes.

reference_strength.tooltip: Maps directly to minimax_visual_cond_noise_aug. Test 0.999, 0.995, then 0.990; values <=0.950 are aggressive.

MiniMaxH3VisualReferenceStrengthEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VisualReferenceStrengthEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VisualReferenceStrengthEXPT8.description: Experimental global MiniMax H3 visual-conditioning strength. Lower values add seeded noise to visual reference/keyframe latents and may reduce overly smoothed texture, but can weaken identity and composition.

error_release_policy.tooltip: unload_all_models is global. Current ComfyUI already does this for recognized CUDA OOM; the guard closes non-OOM/cancel gaps.

MiniMaxH3SpeechGuardT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechGuardT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechGuardT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Abnormal-Exit Guard / 异常释放保护 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechGuardT8.description: Arms a prompt-lifecycle guard before speech conditioning. If OOM, cancellation, or another upstream exception prevents Finalize, the selected error release is requested.

MiniMaxH3SpeechVRAMPreflightT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechVRAMPreflightT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechVRAMPreflightT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech VRAM Preflight / 显存预检 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechVRAMPreflightT8.description: Reports present whole-device free VRAM and DynamicVRAM configuration. It cannot predict sampler peak and never grants a memory_safe label.

MiniMaxH3VoiceLibrarySaveT8.name: MiniMaxH3VoiceLibrarySaveT8
MiniMaxH3VoiceLibrarySaveT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Voice Library Save / 保存音色 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3VoiceLibrarySaveT8.description: Explicitly persists a voice profile and any reference audio in the local ComfyUI user directory.

MiniMaxH3VoiceLibraryLoadT8.name: MiniMaxH3VoiceLibraryLoadT8
MiniMaxH3VoiceLibraryLoadT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Voice Library Load / 加载音色 (EXP/T8)

MiniMaxH3VoiceLibraryDeleteT8.name: MiniMaxH3VoiceLibraryDeleteT8
MiniMaxH3VoiceLibraryDeleteT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Voice Library Delete / 删除音色 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3VoiceLibraryDeleteT8.description: Moves an entry to a recoverable local trash folder; it does not permanently erase it.

MiniMaxH3SpeechPerformanceT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechPerformanceT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechPerformanceT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Performance Direction / 演绎控制 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechPerformanceT8.description: Adds emotion, pace, pitch, energy and nonverbal prompt direction. These model controls remain uncalibrated and are reported as such.

MiniMaxH3SpeechADRFitT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechADRFitT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechADRFitT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech ADR Exact Fit / 配音精确时长 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechADRFitT8.description: Fits AUDIO to an exact sample count using refusal, pad/trim, or bounded phase-vocoder stretch. Exact duration is not a lip-sync claim.

MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormStartT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormStartT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormStartT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Long Form Start/Resume / 长文本恢复 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormStartT8.description: Creates or resumes an atomic accepted-segment manifest. Render only next_index per prompt; this avoids retaining every long-form latent in one execution.

MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormAcceptT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormAcceptT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormAcceptT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Long Form Accept / 接受语音分段 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormAcceptT8.description: Atomically stores one accepted chunk before advancing the manifest; safe to resume after a crash.

MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormControlT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormControlT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormControlT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Long Form Control / 长文本控制 (EXP/T8)

MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormComposeT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormComposeT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormComposeT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Long Form Compose / 合成长文本 (EXP/T8)

MiniMaxH3JointDialogueConditioningT8.name: MiniMaxH3JointDialogueConditioningT8
MiniMaxH3JointDialogueConditioningT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Joint Dialogue Conditioning / 多人同段条件 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3JointDialogueConditioningT8.description: Builds an unverified 2-3 speaker joint Ref2VA experiment. It is not the stable dialogue path and must not be described as identity-safe until leakage and identity-swap tests pass.

length.tooltip: Snapped up to H3's 17n+5 target grid.

source_audio.tooltip: Optional source soundtrack. Missing audio becomes reported stereo silence.

MiniMaxH3SourceMediaWindowT8.name: MiniMaxH3SourceMediaWindowT8
MiniMaxH3SourceMediaWindowT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Source Media Window / 来源视频窗口 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SourceMediaWindowT8.description: Selects a 24fps, 17n+5 source window, resizes it to an H3 canvas, and creates an exactly timed 32kHz stereo audio window for the standard video/audio VAE encoders. The full IMAGE input is already resident; this is not streaming decode and does not claim a memory-safe long-video path.

video_latent.tooltip: H3 video latent [B,24,T,H,W], or an existing H3 joint AV latent.

audio_latent.tooltip: H3 audio latent [B,32,2,T], or an H3 joint AV latent whose audio stream will be used.

video_denoise_strength.display_name: video denoise / 画面重绘强度
video_denoise_strength.tooltip: Used only by remix. No linear visual-strength claim is made before real A/B calibration.

audio_mode.tooltip: lock=preserve source latent; remix=use strength; regenerate=mask 1.

audio_denoise_strength.display_name: audio denoise / 音频重绘强度
audio_denoise_strength.tooltip: Used only by remix; regenerated or padded audio still requires perceptual validation.

audio_fit_policy.display_name: audio fit / 音频时钟对齐
audio_fit_policy.tooltip: strict never adjusts. trim/pad policies are explicit; a padded tail is zero latent with mask 1 so H3 may generate it. Every adjustment is reported.

dtype_device_policy.tooltip: match_video converts only the smaller audio stream; strict refuses a mismatch.

MiniMaxH3SourceAVPrepareT8.name: MiniMaxH3SourceAVPrepareT8
MiniMaxH3SourceAVPrepareT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Source AV Prepare / 来源音画重绘准备 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SourceAVPrepareT8.description: Strictly assembles H3 video/audio latents, preserves metadata and masks, aligns the audio clock only under an explicit policy, and creates separate video/audio denoise masks. This is stream assembly, not temporal concat; denoise strength is experimental and is not claimed to be a linear redraw weight.

MiniMaxH3AVLatentSeparateT8.name: MiniMaxH3AVLatentSeparateT8
MiniMaxH3AVLatentSeparateT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 AV Latent Separate / 联合潜空间拆分 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3AVLatentSeparateT8.description: Validates and separates a joint H3 AV latent without invoking either VAE. It preserves metadata and per-stream noise masks, so it is cheaper than decoding when only latent routing or replacement is needed.

asr_model_directory.tooltip: Absolute faster-whisper CTranslate2 directory, or a folder under ComfyUI/models/TTS. No model is downloaded automatically.

tail_activity_threshold_dbfs.tooltip: Only reports post-target signal activity. This is not a VAD or a speech/non-speech decision.

MiniMaxH3DialogueBoundaryAnalyzerT8.name: MiniMaxH3DialogueBoundaryAnalyzerT8
MiniMaxH3DialogueBoundaryAnalyzerT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Dialogue Boundary Analyzer / 对白边界分析 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3DialogueBoundaryAnalyzerT8.description: Runs local CPU faster-whisper and reports a boundary only when exactly one contiguous exact target-text sequence is found. It never edits audio and does not infer that tail energy is speech.

speech_accepted.tooltip: Connect accepted from Speech Verify after exact-target alignment. False is rejected; this mixer will not guess speech cleanliness.

sfx_fit_policy.tooltip: SFX can be padded/trimmed explicitly but is never looped.

duck_background.tooltip: Deterministically attenuates all background stems while speech is active.

MiniMaxH3DialogueSafeMasterT8.name: MiniMaxH3DialogueSafeMasterT8
MiniMaxH3DialogueSafeMasterT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Dialogue Safe Master / 对白安全混音 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3DialogueSafeMasterT8.description: Builds an exact-duration master from an already verified speech stem plus independent music, ambience, and SFX stems. Speech is never silently trimmed, and the master is never cut at the dialogue end. This is not source separation.

tail_lock_start_seconds.tooltip: Connect a verified speech_end_seconds or an explicit planned boundary. It is quantized upward to the H3 40Hz audio-latent grid.

tail_denoise_strength.tooltip: Use 0 to request an unchanged background-bed latent endpoint.

transition_seconds.tooltip: Default 0 makes the lock boundary explicit. A nonzero transition delays the fully locked tail and is reported, not assumed perceptually safer.

audio_latent_fit_policy.tooltip: Strict rejects a duration mismatch. fit_reported explicitly trims or zero-pads the encoded latent and records the action.

MiniMaxH3TimedAudioBedLockT8.name: MiniMaxH3TimedAudioBedLockT8
MiniMaxH3TimedAudioBedLockT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Timed Background Bed Lock / 分时背景底轨锁定 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3TimedAudioBedLockT8.description: Two-pass H3 helper: encodes an independent full-duration music/ambience/SFX bed into the AV latent and locks its tail after an explicit dialogue boundary. It preserves the video stream and does not separate speech from a mixed master.

image.tooltip: One middle timeline keyframe; batch item 0 is used.

position_mode.tooltip: percent uses an explicit 0..100 scale; no 0..1 ambiguity.

position.tooltip: Absolute 24fps frame, seconds, or 0..100 percent according to position_mode. It must resolve strictly between first and last.

visual_noise_aug.display_name: raw visual noise_aug / 原始视觉混噪值
visual_noise_aug.tooltip: Raw H3 conditioning value, not a calibrated linear strength. Start with 0.999; values <=0.950 are aggressive.

previous_plan.tooltip: Connect the previous Advanced Keyframe Plan to build a timeline.

MiniMaxH3KeyframePlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3KeyframePlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3KeyframePlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Keyframe Plan / 中间关键帧计划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3KeyframePlanT8Advanced.description: Chains one middle timeline image with an explicit frame/second/percent position and a raw per-frame H3 visual noise-augmentation value.

model.tooltip: MiniMax H3 MODEL; the output is a scoped clone.

length.tooltip: 24fps; snapped up to the 17n+5 H3 grid.

task_type.tooltip: Middle timeline keyframes require both first and last frames. Use Hybrid when reference media is also connected.

first_frame_noise_aug.display_name: first frame raw noise_aug / 首帧原始混噪值
first_frame_noise_aug.tooltip: Raw H3 value for the first timeline frame, not a calibrated strength percentage. Keep 0.999 unless running a controlled A/B.

last_frame_noise_aug.display_name: last frame raw noise_aug / 尾帧原始混噪值
last_frame_noise_aug.tooltip: Raw H3 value for the last timeline frame, not a calibrated strength percentage. Keep 0.999 unless running a controlled A/B.

reference_visual_noise_aug.display_name: reference raw noise_aug / 普通视觉参考全局值
reference_visual_noise_aug.tooltip: One raw H3 value shared by non-timeline image/video reference blocks; not an independent or calibrated strength percentage.

MiniMaxH3MultiKeyframeConditioningT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3MultiKeyframeConditioningT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MultiKeyframeConditioningT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Multi-Keyframe Conditioning / 多关键帧条件 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MultiKeyframeConditioningT8Adva.description: Opt-in Advanced FL2VA/Hybrid conditioning with first, last, and chained middle timeline keyframes. It clones MODEL and uses scoped H3 patches; the stable Conditioning node and saved workflows remain unchanged.

quality_base.tooltip: Exact validated FL2VA pruned ConvRot checkpoint used as the base.

reference_overlay.tooltip: Exact validated Ref2VA pruned ConvRot checkpoint used as the overlay source.

profile.tooltip: Neutral experimental recipes only. None is a proven quality winner; static modality rows also affect target streams.

verification.tooltip: header_only_exp is diagnostic and always blocks artifact construction. Use full_sha256 for a buildable plan.

positive.tooltip: Optional existing H3 Conditioning. With auto_match_reference_modalities_exp, its real ref kinds select the minimal video/audio modality recipe.

MiniMaxH3HybridPairInspectorT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3HybridPairInspectorT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HybridPairInspectorT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Hybrid Pair Inspector / 混合模型配对检查 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3HybridPairInspectorT8Advanced.description: Strictly checks the exact P0 FL2VA-pruned quality base and Ref2VA-pruned reference overlay before any artifact can be built. Explicit profiles run independently; auto modality matching waits for the optional Conditioning input.

MiniMaxH3HybridArtifactBuilderT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3HybridArtifactBuilderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HybridArtifactBuilderT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Hybrid Artifact Builder / 小型混合补丁构建 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3HybridArtifactBuilderT8Advanced.description: Builds or reuses a content-addressed 13.8–83.1 MiB FP16 target-slice artifact under ComfyUI/models/h3_hybrid_artifacts. It never copies a complete model and never overwrites a mismatched artifact.

mode.tooltip: base_only is the stock-loader control. apply_artifact_exp requires the exact artifact and remains experimental.

vram_policy.tooltip: Optional T8 policy applied before the stock diffusion-model load.

MiniMaxH3HybridModelLoaderT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3HybridModelLoaderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HybridModelLoaderT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Hybrid Model Loader / 混合模型加载 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3HybridModelLoaderT8Advanced.description: Loads the quality base through ComfyUI's stock diffusion loader, preserving DynamicVRAM/VBAR file-backed behavior, then applies only the connected small artifact to a clone. Use Hybrid -> LoRA ordering.

mode.tooltip: report_only has no side effects. fixed_total_reserved_exp sets a total reserve. external_usage_plus_margin_exp requires global cleanup first.

fixed_total_reserved_gib.tooltip: 4.0 GiB is the validated conservative starting point for the exact RTX 4060 Ti 16 GiB, 736x416, 124-frame Hybrid Stock20 workflow. It is not a universal safe value; re-measure other GPUs and workloads.

clean_before_load.tooltip: Global side effect: unloads every ComfyUI model before measuring/applying. Required by external_usage_plus_margin_exp.

policy_epoch.tooltip: Increment to explicitly invalidate ComfyUI's cached policy output.

MiniMaxH3VRAMPolicyT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3VRAMPolicyT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3VRAMPolicyT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 VRAM Policy / VBAR显存预留策略 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3VRAMPolicyT8Advanced.description: Plans a guarded process-global ComfyUI reserve and DynamicVRAM/VBAR simple headroom. The default is report-only. Connect the policy to the Advanced Hybrid Loader to guarantee it is applied before model loading.

action.tooltip: inspect_only has no side effects. Every other action requires explicit confirmation and a positive, single-use operation epoch.

confirm_action.tooltip: Required for mutation. Files are moved inside models/h3_hybrid_artifacts/_recycle instead of being permanently deleted.

operation_epoch.tooltip: Use a new positive value for each quarantine. Reuse the same value to restore or recover that exact transaction.

stale_after_minutes.tooltip: Only stale build-residue and stale maintenance-lock recovery use this age gate. A lock whose owner is still running is refused.

MiniMaxH3HybridArtifactMaintenanceT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3HybridArtifactMaintenanceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HybridArtifactMaintenanceT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Hybrid Artifact Maintenance / 混合补丁安全维护 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3HybridArtifactMaintenanceT8Adva.description: Inspects one exact content-addressed Hybrid artifact by default. Explicit actions can move a verified artifact pair or stale build residue into a recoverable quarantine, restore a quarantined pair, or recover an interrupted transaction. It never scans or deletes diffusion checkpoints.

enforcement.tooltip: report_only never blocks or mutates the MODEL. block_hard_conflicts raises on mechanically proven patch/order/contract/memory-gate failures.

require_applied_vram_policy.tooltip: Require Loader provenance showing that a non-report-only T8 VRAM policy was applied before the stock model load.

positive.tooltip: Optional final Conditioning lets the audit verify Long Video/MultiKeyframe MODEL pairing and reference-modality coverage.

MiniMaxH3HybridCompatibilityAuditT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3HybridCompatibilityAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HybridCompatibilityAuditT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Hybrid Compatibility Audit / 混合模型组合兼容审计 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3HybridCompatibilityAuditT8Advan.description: Passes the exact same MODEL through while auditing Hybrid offset-set integrity, LoRA ordering/overlap, Block Cache, SageAttention, Long Video, MultiKeyframe, sampling, DynamicVRAM/VBAR policy provenance, current VRAM and host commit. Place it after every MODEL patch/sampler node and before BasicGuider.

MiniMaxH3EnvironmentAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3EnvironmentAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnvironmentAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Environment Audit / 环境兼容审计 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3EnvironmentAuditT8Advanced.description: Read-only audit of the current ComfyUI H3 core, known fix ancestry, VAE chunking/tiled-decode contracts, wrapper ownership, DynamicVRAM and a requested workload. When Sage is selected it also preserves the exact package/core import, KJ-required symbols and CUDA-architecture probe evidence. It never patches, unloads, downloads, runs an attention kernel, or changes settings.

MiniMaxH3ActivationChunkT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ActivationChunkT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ActivationChunkT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 MLP Activation Chunk / MLP激活分块 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3ActivationChunkT8Advanced.description: Clone-local H3 DiT MLP token chunking. Attention is unchanged. Current TensorWise INT8 kernels already fuse SwiGLU and may show no memory benefit. Default report_only makes no MODEL change; apply_exp preserves and composes existing block hooks without a compatibility gate. KJ/Sage/Sol combinations are allowed at user risk, not guaranteed compatible; non-delegating hooks can bypass chunking.

cache_epoch.tooltip: Increment to create a fresh empty cache without mutating the input CLIP.

MiniMaxH3QwenReferencePrefixCacheT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3QwenReferencePrefixCacheT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3QwenReferencePrefixCacheT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Qwen Reference Prefix Cache / 参考前缀缓存 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3QwenReferencePrefixCacheT8Advan.description: Opt-in, bounded CPU-memory cache for the exact visual-reference prefix of the native H3 Qwen3-VL encoder. Prompt text is still recomputed. It wraps only this CLIP output and never patches ComfyUI core files or the input CLIP object.

MiniMaxH3QwenPrefixCacheStatsT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3QwenPrefixCacheStatsT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3QwenPrefixCacheStatsT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Qwen Prefix Cache Stats / 前缀缓存统计 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3QwenPrefixCacheStatsT8Advanced.description: Reads hit/miss/size counters from one bounded in-memory Qwen prefix cache. Connect Conditioning.report to after_report to force this node to run later.

MiniMaxH3UnifiedCastT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3UnifiedCastT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3UnifiedCastT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Unified Cast / 统一角色表 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3UnifiedCastT8Advanced.description: Builds one validated character-continuity contract for video prompts. It stores text metadata only and does not load a face, voice, or vision model.

MiniMaxH3SoundCanvasT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SoundCanvasT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SoundCanvasT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Sound Canvas / 声音画布 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SoundCanvasT8Advanced.description: Plans dialogue, music, ambience and SFX on one explicit timeline. The no-extra-speech guard preserves non-speech audio instead of trimming the master.

MiniMaxH3PromptCompilerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptCompilerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptCompilerT8Advanced.display_name: T8 Video Prompt Compiler / 多后端提示词编译 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptCompilerT8Advanced.description: Compiles one structured visual/audio brief for MiniMax H3, Wan 2.2, LTX-Video or a generic cinematic backend. This is text compilation only.

MiniMaxH3StudioTimelineT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3StudioTimelineT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3StudioTimelineT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Studio Timeline / 创作时间轴 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3StudioTimelineT8Advanced.description: Compiles many shots into deterministic H3 17n+5 windows. Long visual-only shots can be split explicitly; long dialogue must be split by the author.

MiniMaxH3StudioShotSelectT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3StudioShotSelectT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3StudioShotSelectT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Studio Shot Select / 镜头选择 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3StudioShotSelectT8Advanced.description: Selects one planned shot and exposes prompt, length and seed for existing Conditioning/Sampler nodes. It does not queue or load anything by itself.

MiniMaxH3SelectiveSegmentRepairT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SelectiveSegmentRepairT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SelectiveSegmentRepairT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Selective Segment Repair / 选择性分段重做 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SelectiveSegmentRepairT8Advance.description: Creates a non-destructive repair list from explicit indices or quality evidence. It never overwrites or automatically accepts existing media.

MiniMaxH3RepairSegmentSelectT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3RepairSegmentSelectT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3RepairSegmentSelectT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Repair Segment Select / 重做段选择 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3RepairSegmentSelectT8Advanced.description: Selects one item from a non-destructive repair plan and exposes it to the existing generation graph. Acceptance remains a separate user action.

MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairBindT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairBindT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairBindT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Selective Repair Bind / 修复绑定 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairBindT8Advanced.description: Binds one repair-plan item to an immutable accepted-manifest revision and exposes the exact existing generation inputs. It does not load models, queue work or modify the accepted chain.

MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairStageT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairStageT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairStageT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Selective Repair Stage / 修复暂存 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairStageT8Advanced.description: Verifies a generated candidate against the bound frame/sample/timeline and base-manifest contract. It remains preview-only and writes no repair overlay.

replace_existing.tooltip: Only enable after reviewing a new take for a slot that already has an accepted repair overlay.

MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairAcceptT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairAcceptT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairAcceptT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Selective Repair Accept / 修复接受 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairAcceptT8Advanced.description: Explicitly accepts a reviewed candidate into an atomic repair overlay. The original accepted manifest and every original segment stay unchanged.

MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairComposeT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairComposeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairComposeT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Selective Repair Compose / 修复合成 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairComposeT8Advance.description: Streams the immutable base segments plus accepted repair overlays into one bounded-memory MP4. base_rollback ignores the overlay without deleting anything.

lock_final_audio.tooltip: Replace final generated audio latent with encoded drive audio. Use mux_audio for unchanged source PCM.

allow_unverified_patch_stack.tooltip: Allow patches_replace/LongVideo/MultiKeyframe combinations that have not passed the Scheduled Audio validation matrix.

MiniMaxH3ScheduledDriveAudioInjectionT8A.name: MiniMaxH3ScheduledDriveAudioInjectionT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ScheduledDriveAudioInjectionT8A.display_name: MiniMax H3 Scheduled Drive Audio Injection (T8 Advanced)
MiniMaxH3ScheduledDriveAudioInjectionT8A.description: Experimental dual-clock sampler that repeatedly anchors the complete supplied drive-audio latent on its own sigma path. It does not isolate speech from music or effects. report_only is an unchanged dual-clock bypass.

MiniMaxH3AVDecodeSafetyT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AVDecodeSafetyT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AVDecodeSafetyT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 AV Decode Safety / 音视频安全解码 (T8 Advanced)
MiniMaxH3AVDecodeSafetyT8Advanced.description: Isolated AV decode preflight with explicit H3 latent/VAE contracts, output-size estimates and current headroom gates. preflight_only is the default and performs no decode. Current H3 regular decode also uses internal 256-pixel spatial tiles on larger canvases; explicit tile controls may be ignored and remain experimental.

MiniMaxH3ContextIRProviderT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ContextIRProviderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ContextIRProviderT8Advanced.display_name: T8 Context IR Provider / 参考语义理解 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3ContextIRProviderT8Advanced.description: Validates a local Context IR by default. External OpenAI-compatible visual analysis is opt-in, requires explicit upload confirmation and reads its API key only from an environment variable. Raw audio is never uploaded.

MiniMaxH3ContextIRPromptCompilerT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3ContextIRPromptCompilerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ContextIRPromptCompilerT8Advanc.display_name: T8 Context IR Prompt Compiler / IR提示词编译 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3ContextIRPromptCompilerT8Advanc.description: Deterministically compiles one reviewed Context IR through the existing T8 Prompt Packet contract. The provider cannot alter local paths or sampling.

MiniMaxH3ReelDeliveryPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ReelDeliveryPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ReelDeliveryPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Reel Delivery Plan / 成片交付计划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3ReelDeliveryPlanT8Advanced.description: Validates exact 24fps file clips, trims, bounded visual crossfades and dialogue/music/ambience/SFX lanes. Planning is read-only and fingerprints every source file.

MiniMaxH3ReelDeliveryComposeT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ReelDeliveryComposeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ReelDeliveryComposeT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Reel Delivery Compose / 成片合成 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3ReelDeliveryComposeT8Advanced.description: Streams a validated file-level reel into an atomic MP4. It requires explicit confirmation, supports hash-verified phase resume, and never materializes the whole reel as a ComfyUI IMAGE/AUDIO batch.

MiniMaxH3TrajectoryProbeT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TrajectoryProbeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryProbeT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Trajectory Probe / 采样轨迹探针 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryProbeT8Advanced.description: Splits only the stateless T8 dual_clock_euler sigma schedule and binds the checkpoint contract to the exact same-session MODEL/SAMPLER identity. It does not sample or write files.

MiniMaxH3TrajectoryCheckpointSaveT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3TrajectoryCheckpointSaveT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryCheckpointSaveT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Trajectory Checkpoint Save / 轨迹保存 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryCheckpointSaveT8Advan.description: Atomically saves the first-stage sampled AV latent only after explicit confirmation. The checkpoint stays inside the ComfyUI output directory.

MiniMaxH3TrajectoryCheckpointLoadT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3TrajectoryCheckpointLoadT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryCheckpointLoadT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Trajectory Checkpoint Load / 轨迹续跑 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryCheckpointLoadT8Advan.description: Loads an internal-x_sigma checkpoint produced through Trajectory Probe trajectory_model. Connect checkpoint_latent, remaining_sigmas, resume_noise, and the same trajectory_model to the second SamplerCustomAdvanced stage.

extra_substeps.tooltip: Total additional full H3 audio-video DiT calls. Zero is an exact pass-through.

tail_intervals.tooltip: Number of original intervals selected from the zero-sigma tail.

profile.tooltip: All project Turbo dual-clock tests use the 8-step baseline.

accept_turbo_schedule_ood.tooltip: Required before adding untrained intermediate times to an 8-step Turbo schedule.

MiniMaxH3AVSigmaTailSubdivisionT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3AVSigmaTailSubdivisionT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AVSigmaTailSubdivisionT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 AV Sigma Tail Subdivision / 音画尾段细分 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3AVSigmaTailSubdivisionT8Advance.description: Default-off H3 schedule experiment. It preserves every input sigma knot, inserts optional points in base-flow time, and reports both video and audio clocks. Turbo dual-clock validation uses 8 steps.

MiniMaxH3MotionQualityAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MotionQualityAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionQualityAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Quality Audit / 高速动态质量审计 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionQualityAuditT8Advanced.description: Read-only, dependency-free temporal proxy audit. Use a reviewed face/subject mask or manual ROI for face-focused analysis. It does not claim face identity detection and never changes, uploads, or automatically accepts generated media.

tail_power.tooltip: 1.0 is exact identity; values above 1 move existing points toward the zero-sigma tail.

MiniMaxH3AVSigmaSameNFERedistributionT8A.name: MiniMaxH3AVSigmaSameNFERedistributionT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AVSigmaSameNFERedistributionT8A.display_name: MiniMax H3 AV Sigma Same-NFE / 音画同NFE重分布 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3AVSigmaSameNFERedistributionT8A.description: Default-off causal-control schedule. It keeps the exact joint AV model-call count and endpoints while optionally redistributing existing base-flow times. Turbo dual-clock validation uses eight steps and requires explicit OOD consent.

MiniMaxH3MotionRepairPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MotionRepairPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionRepairPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Repair Plan / 动态风险重做计划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionRepairPlanT8Advanced.description: Maps Motion Quality Audit proxy ranges into the existing non-destructive Selective Repair Plan. It never renders, overwrites, or automatically accepts media.

frames.tooltip: Exact source IMAGE batch at the stated fps.

detector_mode.tooltip: OpenCV YuNet is the recommended real-person CPU route. The isolated anime ONNX route is EXP; manual ROI remains the fallback. No route downloads a model during execution.

scene_cut_threshold.tooltip: Low-resolution RGB mean absolute difference; smoothing resets at every cut.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefinePlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefinePlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefinePlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Plan / 远景脸修复规划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefinePlanT8Advanced.description: Builds a shot-aware, source-bound crop plan for a second H3 pass. It never downloads models or accepts a candidate automatically. The default OpenCV YuNet route runs a local MIT-licensed detector on CPU and destroys its detector object after planning; OpenCV may retain process-global CPU allocator pages. Manual ROI and local Ultralytics remain explicit alternatives.

audio_policy.tooltip: require_locked refuses a missing or nonzero audio noise mask.

allow_multi_shot_exp.tooltip: Default refuses hard cuts; split the source into shot-local H3 windows.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineConditioningT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineConditioningT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineConditioningT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Latent / 脸部二次生成条件 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineConditioningT8Advance.description: Strictly replaces only the video stream of an existing H3 AV latent with the VAE-encoded crop sequence. Audio latent and noise-mask objects are preserved; no temporal trim or padding is allowed. Use a native BasicScheduler denoise value for the second pass.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineSamplerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineSamplerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineSamplerT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Sampler / 低去噪双时钟采样 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineSamplerT8Advanced.description: Builds an isolated low-denoise dual-clock schedule for the face-refine second pass. It reuses the stable T8 sampler implementation without changing its source or any existing workflow. Denoise is experimental and not a calibrated strength.

max_face_mean_abs_delta.tooltip: Frames above this normalized RGB change fall back to the source.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineStitchAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineStitchAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineStitchAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Stitch Audit / 脸部回贴审计 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineStitchAuditT8Advanced.description: Creates a review candidate with source-bound geometry, local color matching, per-frame fallback and a bit-exact outside-mask audit. It never overwrites or accepts the source and does not modify audio.

pixels_per_latent.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video latent uses 16 pixels per latent cell. Choose 8 only for a plain SD/SDXL-style latent.

alignment_policy.tooltip: best_aspect checks the four closest legal size pairs and minimizes aspect-ratio error. nearest/floor/ceil prioritize the requested size.

MiniMaxH3LatentUpscaleBy32T8.name: MiniMaxH3LatentUpscaleBy32T8
MiniMaxH3LatentUpscaleBy32T8.display_name: Latent Upscale by 32 / 32整除潜空间放大 (T8)
MiniMaxH3LatentUpscaleBy32T8.description: Upscales a plain latent or the video part of a MiniMax H3 joint AV latent. The returned pixel width and height are always divisible by 32; best_aspect minimizes the unavoidable ratio error caused by the 32-pixel grid.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Parity Plan / 原版机制规划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityPlanT8Advanced.description: Builds the isolated upstream-parity crop contract: audited BGR YOLO input, separate 21/51-frame Gaussian center/size smoothing, per-frame float crops and the author's centred FaceDetailer-style mask geometry. The best source crop is only a convenient reference, not identity proof.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityLatentT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityLatentT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityLatentT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Parity Latent / 原版机制Latent (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityLatentT8Advance.description: Injects only the crop video latent into an existing MiniMax H3 AV latent. The audio latent and existing mask object are retained exactly. The real source frame batch is encoded directly; the VAE must naturally match the declared H3 latent time. Arbitrary pixel-tail duplication, trim, pad or resize is forbidden.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefinePerFrameDenoiseT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefinePerFrameDenoiseT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefinePerFrameDenoiseT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Per-Frame Denoise / 逐帧去噪 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefinePerFrameDenoiseT8Adva.description: Applies the audited upstream face-size curve (crop height divided by crop factor) to the video noise mask only. Defaults map a 30px face to 0.8 and a 120px face to 0.35 with 9-frame smoothing. The nested audio mask stays exactly zero.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityStitchT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityStitchT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityStitchT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Parity Stitch / 原版机制回贴 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityStitchT8Advance.description: Creates a non-destructive review candidate with the audited upstream mechanics: centred face rectangle, chunk-midpoint 24px source feather and post-warp source-coordinate colour match. Pixels outside the mask are audited bit-exact; audio is not touched.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineQualityGateT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineQualityGateT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineQualityGateT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Quality Gate / 候选质量门 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineQualityGateT8Advanced.description: Rejects obvious Face Refine regressions before export. It accepts only continuous runs whose source-relative structure, face delta, measured sharpness and temporal residual all pass conservative proxy thresholds; rejected frames return to the original source. Passing is not identity or quality proof and the result still requires full-video human review.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineManual512RelativeBase.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineManual512RelativeBaselineT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineManual512RelativeBase.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine MANUAL512 REL Baseline / 人工验收512相对模式基线 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineManual512RelativeBase.description: Fail-closed pass-through for the user-selected MANUAL512 REL author-parity v2. It requires a 512x512 crop canvas, crop factor 2.5, 21/51 smoothing, BGR YOLO, crop-derived relative 0.8/0.35 video denoise, locked zero-mask audio and the author's centred-mask/source-space 24/24 stitch. Reports must agree, including any explicit one-frame H3 alignment tail. It does not use proxy scores to replace the candidate and is not a universal quality guarantee.

MiniMaxH3FaceCharacterProfileT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceCharacterProfileT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceCharacterProfileT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Character Profile / 多人角色参考 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceCharacterProfileT8Advanced.description: Builds one in-memory character profile from one or more single-person reference images. OpenCV Zoo YuNet+SFace run on CPU. The embedding is a matching aid, never persistent identity proof.

MiniMaxH3FaceCastMergeT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceCastMergeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceCastMergeT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Cast Merge / 2-3人角色表 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceCastMergeT8Advanced.description: Chains two or three unique character profiles into one in-memory cast. It refuses duplicate IDs and never saves biometric embeddings to disk.

model.tooltip: Load sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors.

conditioning.tooltip: SAM3.1 CLIP text conditioning, normally: person

analysis_max_side.tooltip: 0 keeps source size. SAM3.1 still uses its fixed 1008-square backbone; this mainly bounds input/preview tensors rather than backbone VRAM.

MiniMaxH3SAM31MultiPersonTrackT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SAM31MultiPersonTrackT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SAM31MultiPersonTrackT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 SAM3.1 Multi-Person Track / 多人分色追踪 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SAM31MultiPersonTrackT8Advanced.description: Runs current ComfyUI native SAM3.1 multiplex tracking per detected shot, caps the result at 2-3 people and emits color-coded shot-local track IDs. Default cleanup selectively unloads only the SAM model and its clones before H3 repair. Colors are not character identity.

MiniMaxH3FaceTrackAssignT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceTrackAssignT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceTrackAssignT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Track Assign / 轨迹绑定角色 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceTrackAssignT8Advanced.description: Binds every shot-local SAM track to a reviewed character profile. CPU SFace suggestions are one-to-one within each shot and fail closed below similarity or margin thresholds. JSON overrides such as {"0:0":"Alice"} are authoritative.

window_frame_count.tooltip: Must be 5, 22, 39, 56, 73, 90, 107 or 124. The 73-frame default is about 3.04 seconds at 24 fps. If a shot is short by at most 16 frames, its last frame is used only as H3 context and the padded tail is discarded during final composition.

crop_scale_mode.tooltip: legacy_crop_factor preserves existing workflows. target_face_px automatically resolves crop_factor so the face reaches at least about the requested height in a manual H3 crop canvas. Source boundaries can make it larger.

target_face_px.tooltip: Minimum target face height inside the H3 crop canvas. The reviewed 512px single-person route covered about 205-312px; 300px targets its upper end.

MiniMaxH3MultiFaceRepairJobT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MultiFaceRepairJobT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceRepairJobT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Multi-Face Repair Job / 单角色修复任务 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceRepairJobT8Advanced.description: Selects one character in one shot and creates a 17n+5 Face Refine Parity job. YuNet localizes the face inside that person's SAM mask; SFace rejects identity-incompatible detections. Generate each person sequentially, then composite.

accept_candidate.tooltip: Enabled by default so the candidate reaches the final composite. Disable only when you want a preview-only run that returns the original frames.

MiniMaxH3MultiFaceCompositeT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MultiFaceCompositeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceCompositeT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Multi-Face Composite / 多人候选合成 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceCompositeT8Advanced.description: Applies one shot-local Face Refine candidate to the original full video and chains up to three people. Candidates are accepted by default so the example produces a repaired final video; disable accept_candidate for preview-only review. Overlapping masks still reject by default, pixels outside the audited changed mask remain bit-exact, and audio is untouched.

accept_true_cfg_cost.tooltip: Required for the two-branch true-CFG experiment.

accept_turbo_guidance_ood.tooltip: Required before applying a non-identity guidance curve to an 8-step Turbo profile.

MiniMaxH3DynamicCFGGuiderT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3DynamicCFGGuiderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3DynamicCFGGuiderT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Dynamic Guidance / 动态引导 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3DynamicCFGGuiderT8Advanced.description: Default-pass-through H3 guider. single_condition_gain_exp applies one device-side sigma-dependent gain to the BasicGuider route and is not true CFG. true_cfg_exp requires a layout-matched negative and explicit cost consent.

MiniMaxH3DynamicGuidanceAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3DynamicGuidanceAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3DynamicGuidanceAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Dynamic Guidance Audit / 动态引导审计 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3DynamicGuidanceAuditT8Advanced.description: Place after sampling. It reports observed guider calls, physical model forwards and cond/uncond branch batching without modifying the AV latent.

extra_tail_steps.tooltip: Additional full H3 joint audio-video forwards. Zero is exact pass-through.

MiniMaxH3AVTailDetailScheduleT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AVTailDetailScheduleT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AVTailDetailScheduleT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 AV Tail Detail Schedule / 音画尾段细化 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3AVTailDetailScheduleT8Advanced.description: Subdivides only the final H3 dual-clock interval. The default adds one joint AV model call; three adds a gradual 75/50/25% descent to zero. This does not inject random noise.

bias.tooltip: Negative values make the model see a slightly cleaner time. No random noise is added.

MiniMaxH3ModelTimeBiasSamplerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ModelTimeBiasSamplerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ModelTimeBiasSamplerT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Smooth Model-Time Bias / 平滑模型时间偏置 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3ModelTimeBiasSamplerT8Advanced.description: A scientifically explicit Navyblue/Detail-Daemon-style experiment for H3. It biases only the sigma visible to the shared AV Transformer under a smooth tail window; integration sigmas and NFE stay unchanged.

MiniMaxH3RectifiedFlowRestartSamplerT8Ad.name: MiniMaxH3RectifiedFlowRestartSamplerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3RectifiedFlowRestartSamplerT8Ad.display_name: MiniMax H3 Joint AV RF Restart / 联合音画流重启 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3RectifiedFlowRestartSamplerT8Ad.description: Runs the normal dual-clock trajectory, re-noises the clean endpoint with the rectified-flow interpolation, then performs a second joint AV descent. This is true stochastic restart and is higher risk than tail subdivision.

rescale.tooltip: Must remain 0; shared AV global-std rescale is intentionally rejected.

MiniMaxH3SpatioTemporalGuidanceT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SpatioTemporalGuidanceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SpatioTemporalGuidanceT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Spatio-Temporal Guidance / 时空引导 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SpatioTemporalGuidanceT8Advance.description: H3-specific skip-layer spatio-temporal guidance. It adds one perturbed joint AV forward at every active step and refuses block-replacement conflicts.

frame_chunk_size.tooltip: Processes frames with a one-frame temporal halo to bound temporary memory.

maximum_output_megapixels.tooltip: Fail-closed output pixel budget; this does not include the input tensor.

MiniMaxH3TemporalDetailEnhanceT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalDetailEnhanceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TemporalDetailEnhanceT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Temporal Detail Enhance / 时序保护细节增强 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TemporalDetailEnhanceT8Advanced.description: Motion-gated luma detail enhancement with optional multiple-of-32 bicubic upscaling. It reduces sharpening in moving regions to limit flicker, does not touch audio, and cannot reconstruct missing faces or geometry.

MiniMaxH3DetailMixerSamplerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3DetailMixerSamplerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3DetailMixerSamplerT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Detail Mixer Sampler / 混合细节采样 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3DetailMixerSamplerT8Advanced.description: Composes Tail subdivision, smooth Model-Time Bias, H3 STG and joint AV RF Restart in one fail-closed sampler setup. All effects default off. Temporal Detail Enhance remains a separate post-decode IMAGE node.

video_latent.tooltip: Separated MiniMax H3 video LATENT [B,24,T,H,W], not the joint AV latent.

checkpoint_fingerprint.tooltip: Record a checkpoint SHA/header fingerprint; filenames alone are not proof.

independent_clip_count.tooltip: Must not exceed the actual latent batch count. Typing 100 for one clip does not promote it; dataset status needs 100 actual batch entries whose independence remains a dataset provenance assertion.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumHarvesterT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumHarvesterT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumHarvesterT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Spectrum Harvester / 空间频谱标定 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumHarvesterT8Advance.description: Fits P(omega)=A|omega|^-beta from H3 VIDEO LATENT samples. It never substitutes WAN/FLUX constants. A single clip remains a research probe; dataset status requires at least 100 actual independent batch entries.

scales.tooltip: Strictly increasing spatial scales ending in 1.0.

manual_transition_sigmas.tooltip: One descending public H3 video sigma per resolution transition.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Plan / 渐进分辨率计划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDPlanT8Advanced.description: Builds a multiple-of-32 H3 spatial progression with the official SPEED kappa and sigma-alignment equations. Manual sigmas are the safe default until an H3 dataset spectrum is validated. NFE is preserved exactly.

length.tooltip: 24fps; the H3 builder snaps to the 17n+5 grid.

checkpoint_fingerprint.tooltip: SHA/header fingerprint used to bind a delta-optimal spectrum profile. Manual-sigma plans do not require it.

vae_fingerprint.tooltip: Video-VAE fingerprint used to bind a delta-optimal spectrum profile.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDSourceT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDSourceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSourceT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Stage Source / 分阶段条件源 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSourceT8Advanced.description: Retains raw H3 text/media inputs so every SPEED stage can resize and re-encode keyframes/references for its own canvas. It does not load a second H3 model and does not alter the stable Conditioning node.

execution_scope.tooltip: Strict mode requires media-free native-audio T2VA, exactly 20 steps, shifts 12/3, and an unpatched stock H3 model. Multimodal research mode enables stage-rebuilt I/FL/L/Ref/Hybrid mechanics. Turbo8 research mode requires media-free T2VA, exactly 8 steps and a compatible weight-patched MODEL; the node cannot prove a LoRA file's identity from patch tensors.

dct_chunk_size.tooltip: Number of B*C*T spatial slices transformed per chunk.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDSamplerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDSamplerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSamplerT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Whole-Chain Sampler / 整链采样 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSamplerT8Advanced.description: Runs native H3 Euler sampling over spatial stages, rebuilding AV layout and conditioning at every canvas. Video receives official DCT expansion. Audio stays spatially untouched and is reindexed on the shared public H3 flow; this H3-specific audio extension remains EXP until real GPU listening tests pass.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDModalityStableNoiseT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDModalityStableNoiseT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDModalityStableNoiseT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Modality-Stable AV Noise / AV独立随机噪声 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDModalityStableNoiseT8Advan.description: Generates deterministic video and audio noise from separate derived seeds. Changing only the video canvas therefore cannot silently change the audio noise stream. Intended for controlled H3 SPEED baselines and diagnostics.

video_latent.tooltip: Separated H3 video LATENT [B,24,T,H,W], never joint AV latent.

batch_id.tooltip: A unique stable ID for this actual source batch; repeats are rejected.

dataset_provenance_json.tooltip: Optional reviewed natural-corpus provenance. Appended after the legacy inputs so existing widget positions remain unchanged.

source_entry_json.tooltip: Optional manifest-bound source and decoded-window hashes for this batch.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetAccumulateT.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetAccumulateT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetAccumulateT.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Spectrum Dataset Accumulate / 频谱数据集累积 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetAccumulateT.description: Accumulates exact per-clip H3 spatial power statistics across ComfyUI executions without retaining source or CUDA latents. Duplicate batch IDs and exact clip-spectrum repeats fail closed; model, VAE, task and latent contracts must remain identical.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetFinalizeT8A.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetFinalizeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetFinalizeT8A.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Spectrum Dataset Finalize / 频谱数据集定稿 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetFinalizeT8A.description: Fits one task/model/VAE-bound H3 SPEED profile from accumulated sufficient statistics. Fewer than 100 unique clips or a weak fit remains a research probe and cannot authorize the validated delta-optimal Plan mode.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetFileT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetFileT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetFileT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Spectrum Dataset File / 频谱数据集文件 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetFileT8Advan.description: Loads or explicitly saves one accumulated spectrum dataset under the ComfyUI output directory. Save is atomic, stores no source latent/video, requires confirmation and refuses silent overwrite or unsafe paths.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDModelVAEFingerprintT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDModelVAEFingerprintT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDModelVAEFingerprintT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Model + VAE Fingerprint / 模型与VAE指纹 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDModelVAEFingerprintT8Advan.description: Streams the complete selected diffusion checkpoint and video VAE files to produce binding SHA-256 fingerprints. It does not load model weights onto GPU; first execution can be disk-I/O heavy and ComfyUI may cache unchanged inputs.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDCalibrationWindowT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDCalibrationWindowT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDCalibrationWindowT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Calibration Window / 画幅安全标定窗口 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDCalibrationWindowT8Advance.description: Resamples one strict H3 24fps/17n+5 calibration window and uses aspect-preserving center-cover resize. It never stretches source geometry, never pads short clips and does not alter the existing Source Media Window.

aspect_policy.tooltip: preserve_source is the safe default. honor_dimensions_exp permits different X/Y scales but still enforces max_anisotropy.

release_policy.tooltip: offload_after keeps a CPU cache but releases GPU weights; clear_after also removes the CPU cache; keep_loaded is opt-in and retains GPU memory.

MiniMaxH3LearnedLatentUpscaleT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LearnedLatentUpscaleT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LearnedLatentUpscaleT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Learned Latent Upscale / H3学习型潜空间放大 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3LearnedLatentUpscaleT8Advanced.description: Runs the verified 24-channel learned 3D H3 latent-resizer checkpoint on video only while preserving the native joint audio latent. Output pixel dimensions are exactly divisible by 32. Resolutions above the official 1920x1088 reference area are allowed and reported as a memory risk instead of being blocked. The default unloads this upscaler from the GPU after every execution without unloading the user's H3 models.

audio_policy.tooltip: auto keeps the high-resolution template audio for lock/remix masks, otherwise it continues the first-pass audio.

second_pass_audio_source.tooltip: legacy_policy preserves old saved-workflow behavior. first_pass is the explicit audio-lock route: reuse pass-1 audio while pass 2 refines video. For native author-parity generation, keep legacy_policy so pass 2 can finish the joint audio trajectory.

second_pass_audio_strength.tooltip: Pass-2 audio denoise only for an explicit non-legacy source. Use 0 to lock the selected audio exactly; values above 0 deliberately regenerate it and remain experimental.

MiniMaxH3TwoPassLatentReconcileT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3TwoPassLatentReconcileT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TwoPassLatentReconcileT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Two-Pass Latent Reconcile / H3二采潜空间协调 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TwoPassLatentReconcileT8Advance.description: Combines learned-upscaled first-pass values with a newly rebuilt high-resolution H3 Conditioning template. It fails closed on stale low-resolution keyframes, reference metadata mismatches, audio-clock mismatches, or NaN.

model.tooltip: Connect the MODEL output of MiniMax H3 Dual-Clock Sampler so the actual video/audio shifts are available.

MiniMaxH3TwoPassSigmaPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TwoPassSigmaPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TwoPassSigmaPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Two-Pass Sigma Plan / H3二采Sigma计划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TwoPassSigmaPlanT8Advanced.description: Splits one native H3 rectified-flow trajectory in base-flow time, then maps both halves with the actual video/audio shifts carried by MODEL. Default 4+4 keeps eight total joint AV Transformer calls.

model.tooltip: Connect a MiniMax H3 model carrying the same video/audio shifts that both passes will use.

refine_steps.tooltip: Defaults to the published four-call high-resolution profile so the 4+4 graph executes eight total joint AV forwards. Saved workflows that explicitly store 3 or 5 remain compatible.

MiniMaxH3LearnedTwoPassParityPlanT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3LearnedTwoPassParityPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LearnedTwoPassParityPlanT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Learned Two-Pass Parity Plan / H3学习放大原版二采计划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3LearnedTwoPassParityPlanT8Advan.description: Reproduces the published LBH low-resolution simple-schedule split and its current 3/4/5-step high-resolution raw video-sigma sequences. The native H3 sampler derives the matching audio clock from the active video/audio shifts.

refine_sigmas.tooltip: Connect refine_sigmas from MiniMax H3 Learned Two-Pass Parity Plan.
