MiniMaxH3TwoPassDetailMixerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TwoPassDetailMixerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TwoPassDetailMixerT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Two-Pass Detail Mixer / 二采混合细节设置 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TwoPassDetailMixerT8Advanced.description: Applies Tail subdivision, Model-Time Bias, H3 STG and joint AV RF Restart to an existing partial high-resolution refine schedule without replacing it with a new full trajectory. Use only after learned latent upscale/reconcile. Temporal Detail remains after AV Decode.

global_prompt.tooltip: 始终可见的全局场景、人物、风格与声音约束。
global_prompt.default: Cinematic continuous shot, coherent subject identity, natural motion, stable lighting and synchronized ambience.

local_prompts.tooltip: 每行一个局部事件；也兼容使用 | 分隔。清空文本和time_ranges时生成只含global_prompt的无补丁直通Plan。
local_prompts.default:
The woman looks toward the camera and raises her hand.
She turns and walks rapidly into the illuminated street.
The camera pulls back while she becomes small in the distance.

length.tooltip: 24fps；会向上对齐到 MiniMax H3 的 17n+5 帧网格。

timing_mode.tooltip: auto_equal 自动均分；其他模式读取 time_ranges。

time_ranges.tooltip: 每行一个范围，并按开始时间从早到晚排列。frames 只接受整数帧且结束帧包含在范围内；seconds/percent 的结束值作为边界；percent 使用 0..100。

math_profile.tooltip: paper_v1 是论文公式；legacy_repo_compat 只用于复现社区旧参数，不代表论文实现。

epsilon.tooltip: 论文默认 0.1；paper_v1 会让事件边界权重回到 epsilon。

allow_gaps.tooltip: 关闭时，各局部事件必须覆盖完整目标时间线。

allow_overlaps.tooltip: 关闭时，局部事件时间范围不能重叠。

prompt_relay_events.tooltip: 可选：连接链式 Event 节点后以它为权威事件源；未连接时继续读取local_prompts/time_ranges。

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Relay Plan / 分段提示词时间线 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayPlanT8Advanced.description: Compiles one global prompt plus line-separated local events into an auditable H3 timeline. paper_v1 uses the published epsilon/window/sigma equation; legacy_repo_compat is comparison-only.

model.tooltip: 原生 MiniMax H3 MODEL；输出为局部克隆。

clip.tooltip: 原生 MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP。

prompt_relay_plan.tooltip: 必须直接来自同一版本 Prompt Relay Plan 节点。

task_type.tooltip: 支持 T2VA/I2VA/FL2VA/L2VA/Ref2VA/Hybrid 的目标视频时间路由；显式接入 Query Route 后可实验性扩展到目标音频。

audio_mode.tooltip: 支持原生生成、锁定源音频、重混源音频和仅参考音频。默认Plan只路由目标视频；joint_av_exp会直接路由目标音频，不能与lock_source组合。

execution_mode.tooltip: 先用 report_only 检查 token/layout/显存报告；确认后显式选择 apply_exp 才安装注意力路由。零个或一个局部事件时会自动原样直通，不安装补丁；单事件通常应合并进 global_prompt。

query_chunk_rows.tooltip: 目标视频/显式联合音频 query 分块。更小更省显存但更慢；不会创建完整 S×S mask。

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayConditioningT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayConditioningT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayConditioningT8Advanc.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Relay Conditioning / 分段提示词条件 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayConditioningT8Advanc.description: Authoritatively encodes the Plan prompt through the native H3 Qwen chain, binds exact local token spans, and optionally patches a cloned H3 MODEL with a bounded-memory plan-selected query relay. Stable nodes remain unchanged.

prompt_relay_plan.tooltip: 来自 Prompt Relay Plan 的原始、已校验时间线。

query_route.tooltip: video_only_paper只路由目标视频并保持论文范围；joint_av_exp还会按H3原生音频时间轴路由目标音频，属于未被论文验证的实验扩展。

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayQueryRouteT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayQueryRouteT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayQueryRouteT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Relay Query Route / 联合音画路由 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayQueryRouteT8Advanced.description: Optionally extends a Prompt Relay Plan from the paper-faithful target-video route to an experimental native-H3 target-audio-plus-video route. Connect this between Plan and Conditioning; old workflows bypass it unchanged.

prompt_relay_plan.tooltip: 整条长视频只创建一次的全局 Prompt Relay Plan。

length.tooltip: 直接连接 Long Video Planner 的 length。

context_frames.tooltip: 直接连接 Long Video Planner 的 context_frames。

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayLongVideoPlanT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayLongVideoPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayLongVideoPlanT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Relay Long Video Window / 长视频绝对时间窗口 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayLongVideoPlanT8Advan.description: Projects one global Prompt Relay timeline into the exact rendered Long Video window. Continuation frame 0 maps to accepted-start minus context overlap, so events do not restart at each segment. Existing Plan and Long Video nodes stay unchanged.

model.tooltip: 未接其他补丁的原生 MiniMax H3 MODEL。

clip.tooltip: 原生 MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP。

prompt_relay_plan.tooltip: 必须来自同段 Long Video Window 节点。

execution_mode.tooltip: 先 report_only；确认报告后再显式切到 apply_exp。

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayLongVideoConditionin.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayLongVideoConditioningT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayLongVideoConditionin.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Relay Long Video Conditioning / 长视频分段路由条件 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayLongVideoConditionin.description: Isolated composition of the existing Long Video motion-context payload repair and Prompt Relay attention routing. It requires the paired projected Plan and never changes the old Long Video Conditioning schema.

prompt_packet.tooltip: 直接连接 T8 Video Prompt Compiler；只接受 backend=minimax_h3 且哈希完整的 packet。

events_json.tooltip: 显式事件列表。auto_equal只写prompt；其他模式还要写start/end。使用[]表示只保留全局Prompt Packet且不安装Relay补丁。

timing_mode.tooltip: frames的end为包含端点；seconds/percent的end为时间边界。

math_profile.tooltip: 默认使用Prompt Relay论文公式。

prompt_relay_events.tooltip: 可选：连接链式 Event 节点后以它为权威事件源；未连接时继续读取 events_json。

MiniMaxH3PromptPacketRelayPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptPacketRelayPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptPacketRelayPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Packet → Relay Plan / 编译提示词转时间线 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptPacketRelayPlanT8Advanced.description: Converts an authenticated MiniMax H3 Prompt Compiler packet into an auditable Prompt Relay timeline. The packet's compiled visual/audio prompt remains global; local events are never inferred or rewritten.

prompt.tooltip: 只写这一时间段的局部动作，不重复全局人物/场景/声音设定。
prompt.default: The subject performs one clearly observable action.

start.tooltip: auto_equal时忽略；frames为整数起始帧，seconds为秒，percent为0..100；多个Event必须按开始时间排序。

end.tooltip: frames模式只接受整数并包含end帧；seconds/percent模式把end视为边界。

enabled.tooltip: 关闭后不把本事件加入链；如果整条链都关闭，Plan会变成全局提示直通，不需要拆线。

previous_events.tooltip: 连接上一个Event节点；第一个Event留空。

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayEventT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayEventT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayEventT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Relay Event / 单事件串联 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayEventT8Advanced.description: Adds one explicit local action to a chainable Prompt Relay event list. Duplicate this node for each event; start/end are interpreted by the Packet bridge timing mode.

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayPreviewT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayPreviewT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayPreviewT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Relay Preview / 时间线预检 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayPreviewT8Advanced.description: Validates an authenticated Prompt Relay plan and shows every event's frame/second range before any H3 model is loaded or sampling begins. Its plan output is an unchanged pass-through for inline use.

query_chunk_rows.tooltip: Must match the Prompt Relay Conditioning node for a useful estimate.

precision.tooltip: Element width used only for the explicit bias-size estimate.

keyframe_stills.tooltip: Count first/last/intermediate still guides at the target canvas size.

reference_images_match.tooltip: Count only match-size reference images; use manual rows for max-size refs.

reference_video_frames_each.tooltip: Requested frames per reference video; the report shows H3 aligned-down frames.

additional_text_rows.tooltip: Conservative allowance for Qwen system/media tokens beyond UTF-8 prompt bytes.

manual_extra_packed_rows.tooltip: Manual allowance for max-size refs or other conditioning not represented above.

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayResourceEstimateT8Ad.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayResourceEstimateT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayResourceEstimateT8Ad.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Relay Resource Estimate / 资源预估 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayResourceEstimateT8Ad.description: Model-free estimate of native H3 packed rows and Prompt Relay's bounded explicit chunk-bias allocation. It does not estimate total VRAM and is never a 16GB safety certificate. The Plan output is an unchanged pass-through.

second_pass_input.tooltip: Connect the Reconcile AV latent that enters pass 2.

fail_on_locked_mismatch.tooltip: At strength 0, stop the workflow if audio differs after pass 2.

locked_atol.tooltip: Maximum sampler roundoff allowed before failure. After the check, locked audio is replaced by the exact pass-2 input latent.

MiniMaxH3TwoPassAudioAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TwoPassAudioAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TwoPassAudioAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Two-Pass Audio Audit / H3二采音频硬校验 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TwoPassAudioAuditT8Advanced.description: Compares the audio latent immediately before and after pass 2. In the explicit strength-0 lock route it allows only bounded floating-point roundoff, then restores the exact input audio before decode. Larger changes fail closed, preventing a mechanically valid but sonically rewritten result from being saved. Do not insert this node into the native author-parity route: native pass 2 must complete audio as well as video.

model.tooltip: Connect the H3 model stack you want to run. LoRA hook count, strength, model identity and base family are reported but never used as load gates.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the exact Stock20 or Turbo8 SIGMAS sent to the sampler.

mode.tooltip: disabled is exact bypass; report_only measures CFI/g without changing the output; apply_exp enables the experimental gain. tau=0 is not off.

tau.tooltip: Paper enhancement weight. 4 is an upstream candidate, not a validated H3 optimum; always compare against disabled/report_only with the same seed.

max_workspace_mib.tooltip: Upper planning budget for chunked temporal score buffers. This is not a whole-workflow VRAM guarantee.

g_hard_limit.tooltip: Fail closed when the observed gain exceeds this value. The node refuses the run instead of silently clamping and calling it paper-equivalent.

sampling_profile.tooltip: Select the expected sigma schedule. Existing LoRA details are diagnostic only; incompatible user-selected models fail only in real execution.

MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoT8Advanced.description: Experimental H3 full-3D adapter for Enhance-A-Video/FETA. It computes the paper temporal CFI only from target-video Q/K, in exact low-memory chunks, and directly scales only target-video attention output rows.

MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Enhance-A-Video Runtime Audit (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoAuditT8Advanced.description: Place after sampling. It verifies the selected schedule forward count, all 50 H3 DiT attention measurements, observed g range, and chunk workspace without changing the AV latent.

model.tooltip: Connect an unpatched native Stock20 H3 model. LoRA, Prompt Relay, Sage, BlockCache, STG, Long Video and model-Hybrid artifacts remain rejected.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the exact 20-step Stock20 SIGMAS sent to the sampler.

mode.tooltip: disabled is exact bypass; report_only audits without modifying output; apply_exp enables FETA. tau=0 is not an off switch.

max_workspace_mib.tooltip: FETA score-buffer planning budget only; not total workflow VRAM.

MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoReferenceComposerT.name: MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoReferenceComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoReferenceComposerT.display_name: MiniMax H3 Enhance-A-Video Ref2VA / Hybrid Composer (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoReferenceComposerT.description: Isolated Stock20 composer for native Ref2VA or Hybrid conditioning. It audits the exact reference-segment layout, computes FETA only from target-video Q/K, and never directly scales reference, text, condition, or target-audio rows.

model.tooltip: Connect the H3 stack to run. Attention-owner conflicts remain explicit, but LoRA identity, hook count and strength do not block loading.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the exact SIGMAS sent to the sampler.

task_scope.tooltip: visual: T2VA/I2VA/FL2VA/L2VA. reference: Ref2VA/Hybrid and Stock20 only. Scope is explicit so task routing cannot silently drift.

mode.tooltip: disabled returns the original model and runs neither Sage nor FETA. report_only still runs Sage but does not apply the FETA gain. apply_exp runs both.

tau.tooltip: Experimental FETA weight; 4 is a candidate, not an H3 optimum.

max_workspace_mib.tooltip: FETA score-buffer budget only; not a whole-workflow VRAM claim.

sampling_profile.tooltip: reference scope is intentionally Stock20-only. visual scope also supports the Turbo8 schedule; LoRA identity is diagnostic only.

MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoSageComposerT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoSageComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoSageComposerT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Enhance-A-Video + Strict Sage (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoSageComposerT8Adva.description: Owns both the H3 FETA route and a strict SageAttention HND backend. External callable patches are retained with user-risk warnings. Real strict Sage kernel errors propagate without hidden PyTorch retry; external owners may bypass this node's optimization.

model.tooltip: Connect the MODEL output of Prompt Relay Conditioning in apply_exp with at least two active events. For turbo8_alpha8, apply the corrected Alpha8 bypass LoRA after Relay and before this composer.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the exact SIGMAS sent to the sampler.

mode.tooltip: disabled preserves Prompt Relay exactly and disables only EAV; report_only measures FETA after Relay without scaling; apply_exp enables the target-video gain.

tau.tooltip: Experimental FETA weight; 4 is a candidate, not an H3 optimum.

max_workspace_mib.tooltip: FETA score-buffer budget only; not total workflow VRAM.

sampling_profile.tooltip: stock20 supports the bound visual/reference task. turbo8_alpha8 is strictly limited to T2VA with the corrected 208-hook bypass LoRA.

MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoPromptRelayCompose.name: MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoPromptRelayComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoPromptRelayCompose.display_name: MiniMax H3 Enhance-A-Video + Prompt Relay (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoPromptRelayCompose.description: Explicitly replaces one authenticated Prompt Relay wrapper with a single combined owner. Relay performs its local-event attention route first; FETA then scales only target-video output rows. It does not add model forwards.

model.tooltip: Connect DualClock MODEL after MiniMax H3 Block Cache (T8). The first qualified recipe uses CPU cache. Other selected cache devices and callable wrappers are retained with unverified-composition warnings.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the exact native Stock20 SIGMAS sent to the sampler.

mode.tooltip: disabled preserves the exact BlockCache MODEL; report_only audits FETA without gain; apply_exp enables target-video gain.

tau.tooltip: Experimental FETA weight; 4 is a candidate, not an H3 optimum.

max_workspace_mib.tooltip: FETA score-buffer budget only; not total workflow VRAM.

MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoBlockCacheComposer.name: MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoBlockCacheComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoBlockCacheComposer.description: Explicit Stock20 composer for the separately installed T8 BlockCache. It runs FETA only in blocks that actually execute and audits one measurement on a cache hit versus 50 on a full forward.

model.tooltip: Connect an unpatched native H3 model. Do not stack standalone STG, BlockCache, Prompt Relay, Sage, Long Video or another guidance hook.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the exact native Stock20 SIGMAS sent to the sampler.

mode.tooltip: disabled keeps STG active but disables only EAV for a controlled baseline; report_only measures FETA on both branches; apply_exp also enables the target-video gain.

max_workspace_mib.tooltip: FETA score-buffer budget only; not total workflow VRAM.

stg_scale.tooltip: Strength of the extra weak-branch guidance. 0.35 is a conservative starting point, not a universal quality optimum.

stg_double_blocks.tooltip: Comma-separated H3 double blocks skipped only by the weak branch.

shift_video.tooltip: Must match the native H3 video clock used by the schedule.

rescale.tooltip: Must remain 0; shared AV global-std rescale is not validated.

MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoSTGComposerT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoSTGComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoSTGComposerT8Advan.description: One explicit Stock20 owner for target-video FETA and skip-block STG. FETA is applied consistently to both the main and weak branches; the runtime audit verifies the exact extra joint audio-video forwards.

model.tooltip: Connect the MODEL output of the matching Long Video Conditioning node.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the exact native Stock20 SIGMAS sent to this segment sampler.

context_frames.tooltip: Connect Long Video Planner context_frames (0, 5, 22 or 39).

mode.tooltip: disabled preserves the exact Long Video MODEL; report_only audits FETA without gain; apply_exp enables target-video gain.

max_workspace_mib.tooltip: FETA score-buffer budget only; not total workflow VRAM.

MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoLongVideoComposerT.name: MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoLongVideoComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoLongVideoComposerT.display_name: MiniMax H3 Enhance-A-Video + Long Video (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoLongVideoComposerT.description: Keeps Long Video Conditioning as the scoped layout owner and adds one fresh EAV runtime per Stock20 segment. Segment/context inputs bind resume state and prevent a consumed audit token from leaking across segments.

mode.tooltip: report_only never expands frames. auto_conservative_exp applies only when all abstain gates pass. manual_ranges uses the ranges field exactly.

manual_ranges.tooltip: Examples: 36-60:4 or 1.5s-2.4s:3; used only in manual_ranges mode.

minimum_residual_motion.tooltip: Absolute decoded-frame residual gate after a small global-translation search. This prevents a quantile-only rule from always selecting something.

MiniMaxH3MotionOverloadAnalyzeT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MotionOverloadAnalyzeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionOverloadAnalyzeT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Overload Analyze / 动作过载分析 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionOverloadAnalyzeT8Advanced.description: Read-only H3 latent and decoded-frame analysis. It separates motion measurement from compute allocation, can abstain on calm clips, and never patches MODEL or sampling.

MiniMaxH3MotionRetimingPrepareT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MotionRetimingPrepareT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionRetimingPrepareT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Retiming Prepare / 动作扩时二采准备 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionRetimingPrepareT8Advanced.description: Expands only the frames selected by a signed motion plan, encodes the longer H3 video latent, and optionally seeds the shared AV Transformer with a phase-vocoder guide made from pass-1 audio. Keep final audio on pass1_original unless explicitly reviewed.

denoise_fraction.tooltip: Fraction of the existing schedule retained for pass 2; not a sigma value.

MiniMaxH3MotionRecoveryComposerT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3MotionRecoveryComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionRecoveryComposerT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Recovery Composer / 动作二采编排 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionRecoveryComposerT8Advance.description: Authenticates the prepared AV latent and signed plan, then selects the final fraction of an existing H3 sigma schedule for the second V2V pass. It installs no MODEL wrapper and never auto-stacks EAV, STG, Restart or BlockCache.

audio_mode.tooltip: pass1_original is the stable exact-pass1 default. A full human review rejected pass2_recovered_exp because its middle window suddenly sounded distant before returning; keep it diagnostic-only. blend_exp sounded normal in that one clip at pass1_mix=0.8 but remains opt-in.

pass1_mix.tooltip: Used only by blend_exp; 1.0 is all pass-1 audio. One reviewed I2VA clip passed at 0.8, which is not a general audio guarantee.

MiniMaxH3MotionRecoverAVT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MotionRecoverAVT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionRecoverAVT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Recover AV / 动作音画回时钟 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionRecoverAVT8Advanced.description: Returns the regenerated clip to its exact world-frame clock by selecting one real generated frame from every hold group. The safe default keeps pass-1 audio and does not phase-vocode the deliverable soundtrack.

MiniMaxH3MotionSegmentPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MotionSegmentPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionSegmentPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Segment Plan / 动作分段窗口计划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionSegmentPlanT8Advanced.description: Turns one signed full-clip motion plan into budgeted sequential windows. It does not impose a global pixel/frame prohibition; it reports hot cuts so the user can raise the budget or lower max_hold before rendering.

store_dtype.tooltip: float32_exact preserves recovered frame values; float16_half_disk halves the frame-bank storage but is not pixel-exact.

MiniMaxH3MotionWindowCollectT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MotionWindowCollectT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionWindowCollectT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Window Collect / 动作窗口断点收集 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionWindowCollectT8Advanced.description: Banks one recovered window per queue item and deterministically assembles all signed windows when complete. Missing windows pass the baseline through, so a cancel, crash or OOM requires rerendering only the missing item.

MiniMaxH3MotionAutoGateT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MotionAutoGateT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionAutoGateT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Auto Gate / 动作自动修复旁路 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionAutoGateT8Advanced.description: Uses ComfyUI native lazy inputs. A calm clip marked ABSTAIN returns the exact pass-1 frames/audio without evaluating the connected second-pass graph; only should_repair=true requests the repaired inputs.

profile.tooltip: 默认档严格复现上游当前默认值；manual才读取下方数值。

auto_vram.tooltip: 让上游运行时根据当前序列与可用显存缩小驻留窗口。

require_external_runtime.tooltip: 上游流式加载器未安装时提前报错。

MiniMaxH3ExternalBlockSwapBridgeT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3ExternalBlockSwapBridgeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ExternalBlockSwapBridgeT8Advanc.display_name: MiniMax H3 External BlockSwap Bridge / 流式驻留桥接 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3ExternalBlockSwapBridgeT8Advanc.description: Builds a compatible BlockSwap payload for the optional external streaming MiniMaxH3KSampler. It never patches or replaces ComfyUI's official MODEL path.

audio_intervals.tooltip: JSON，例如 [{"start":1.2,"end":2.0}]；仅这些时段重绘音频。

frame_policy.tooltip: strict要求17n+5；trim_down只裁掉尾部不足一个网格的帧。

require_lanpaint_sampler.tooltip: 未安装上游LanPaint时提前报错，避免误用普通采样器。

MiniMaxH3LanPaintAVPrepareT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LanPaintAVPrepareT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LanPaintAVPrepareT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 LanPaint AV Prepare / 音画局部重绘准备 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3LanPaintAVPrepareT8Advanced.description: Encodes source frames and audio once and attaches exact nested video/audio noise masks for the upstream LanPaint KSampler Advanced. The external GPL LanPaint sampler is intentionally not duplicated in this node pack.

MiniMaxH3LanPaintAVCompositeT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LanPaintAVCompositeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LanPaintAVCompositeT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 LanPaint AV Composite / 原片音画回贴 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3LanPaintAVCompositeT8Advanced.description: Blends repaired pixels only inside the video mask and repaired audio only inside declared intervals, preserving the original soundtrack elsewhere.

prompt.tooltip: 原始短提示词；对白、歌词和画面文字会要求保持原文。

base_model_path.tooltip: 相对路径从 ComfyUI/models/text_encoders 解析，也可填绝对目录。精确基座为 Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct。

adapter_path.tooltip: 相对路径从 ComfyUI/models/loras 解析，也可填绝对目录。精确LoRA为 lightx2v/MiniMax-H3-Prompt-Rewriter-LoRA-8B。

load_policy.tooltip: 16GB显卡建议自动CPU分片；gpu_only需要足够显存。

max_new_tokens.tooltip: 默认1024兼顾完整度与16GB分片速度；过低可能截断三段结构，过高只提高上限而不会强迫模型生成到上限。

unload_after_generate.tooltip: 生成、报错或OOM后都尝试只释放本节点的模型和缓存。

free_comfy_models_before_load.tooltip: 加载8B前释放ComfyUI当前模型，为16GB显卡留空间；不会在生成后全局卸载。

allow_hub_download.tooltip: 默认只允许本地模型，避免运行时意外下载大文件。

MiniMaxH3PromptRewriter8BT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRewriter8BT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRewriter8BT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Rewriter 8B / 多模态提示词改写 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRewriter8BT8Advanced.description: Runs the pinned LightX2V Qwen3-VL-8B LoRA for T2VA/I2VA/L2VA/FL2VA. It is separate from the H3 32B CLIP because their parameter shapes are not LoRA-compatible. Unload-after-generate is enabled by default.

MiniMaxH3PromptRewriterUnloadT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRewriterUnloadT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRewriterUnloadT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Rewriter Unload / 手动卸载 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRewriterUnloadT8Advanced.description: Releases only the optional Prompt Rewriter 8B cache retained by this node pack.

model.tooltip: Connect the clean native H3 MODEL output from Dual-Clock. Do not place KJ Sage, Sol-Attn, FETA, BlockCache, STG or another LoRA before it.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the same native_flow SIGMAS from Dual-Clock. The included upstream SLA checkpoint is officially 4-step/6V/3A; 8 steps and other NFE values run under an explicit experimental schedule report.

lora_name.tooltip: Default LightX2V MiniMax H3 FL2V Turbo-SLA ComfyUI BF16 LoRA. File name, SHA, size, metadata and tensor layout are diagnostic only. The selected file is passed to the real ComfyUI loader.

mode.tooltip: apply_lightx2v_sla is a diagnostic auto mode, not quality-safe: under 50K packed tokens it uses dense attention; longer sequences keep dense first/last forwards and protect text/keyframe/audio keys during sparse middle forwards. Both the short all-dense result and the earlier fixed-sparse result failed full-duration human review. Use the new Turbo / SLA Profile Router for the recommended Turbo8 fallback. apply_lightx2v_sla_upstream_exact_exp reproduces 85% sparse attention on every forward and may collapse outside the published long 768p profile. dense_lora_control keeps the same SLA LoRA but uses dense attention for a scientific A/B. disabled_identity changes nothing.

base_policy.tooltip: Controls report labels only. Base dtype and quantization are recorded but never used to reject a user-selected model.

max_router_workspace_mib.tooltip: Fail-closed ceiling for estimated router score/map workspace. This is not a whole-workflow VRAM limit.

MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 LightX2V SLA Loader + Attention (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAT8Advanced.description: Loads a structurally valid H3 FL2VA Turbo-SLA LoRA and owns the LightX2V Sage2 attention path. The saved apply_lightx2v_sla mode remains loadable as a diagnostic policy: short sequences stay dense; eligible sequences use dense boundary forwards and prefix-protected sparse middle forwards. The exact all-sparse upstream route remains an explicit EXP mode. The upstream checkpoint defaults to 4 steps, video shift 6 and audio shift 3; other native_flow NFE values are accepted as experimental. External SageAttention/Sol-Attn/LoRA nodes must be bypassed.

MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 LightX2V SLA Runtime Audit (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAAuditT8Advanced.description: Place after the sampler. It fails unless every scheduled H3 forward and all 50 main blocks per forward used the selected dense-control or sparse path without a hidden kernel fallback.

model.tooltip: Connect Dual-Clock MODEL to KJNodes MiniMax H3 Mem Eff Sage Attention Patch, then connect that MODEL here. A recognized built-in ModelAttentionBackend is redundant and will be replaced by the SLA owner; Sol-Attn and foreign attention overrides are still refused.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the same native_flow SIGMAS from Dual-Clock. The official checkpoint defaults to 4-step/6V/3A; 8-step is allowed and audited as an experimental user-selected NFE schedule.

lora_name.tooltip: Defaults to the LightX2V H3 FL2V Turbo-SLA LoRA. Compatible repacked or alternate H3 SLA LoRAs use structural/full-mapping validation instead of one fixed file hash.

mode.tooltip: apply_lightx2v_sla uses a diagnostic sequence/forward policy that failed full-duration human review and is not quality-safe. Use the Turbo / SLA Profile Router for recommended Turbo8 output. The upstream-exact EXP option keeps all forwards 85% sparse. dense_lora_control keeps the same LoRA and routes all 50 main blocks through the authenticated upstream KJ Sage forward.

base_policy.tooltip: The official SLA base is BF16 FL2VA; quantized bases remain explicit compatibility experiments.

max_router_workspace_mib.tooltip: Fail-closed ceiling for SLA router score/map workspace.

MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAKJSageComposerT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAKJSageComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAKJSageComposerT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 LightX2V SLA + KJ Sage Composer (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAKJSageComposerT8Adva.description: Compose an upstream KJNodes MiniMax H3 memory-efficient Sage patch with LightX2V SLA under one audited attention owner. Diagnostic sparse forwards use block-sparse Sage2; planned dense forwards, dense-control and calls outside the SLA route retain KJ Sage. No attention call runs both kernels.

video_frame_count.tooltip: 0 skips A/V boundary comparison; otherwise use the decoded frame count.

MiniMaxH3AudioIntegrityAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AudioIntegrityAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioIntegrityAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Integrity Audit / 音频完整性审计 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3AudioIntegrityAuditT8Advanced.description: CPU-only, report-only audit for opening discontinuities, tail/head similarity, DC jumps, clipping, exact samples and optional video-boundary mismatch. It never repairs or modifies the audio.

MiniMaxH3SpeakerRoutingAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SpeakerRoutingAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SpeakerRoutingAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speaker Routing Audit / 多人对白路由预检 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeakerRoutingAuditT8Advanced.description: Compiles dialogue speakers to deterministic <Audio N> ordinals and abstains on missing/duplicate references, unstructured vocalizations or ambiguous same-gender descriptors. It never changes the dialogue plan.

character_limit.tooltip: Default 7000 matches the current official MiniMax H3 CLI submission limit. It is not a detected hard limit of the local open-weight tokenizer. Raising it opts out of official submission compatibility; the report warns and the prompt is never truncated.

token_limit.tooltip: 0 reports token counts without applying a token ceiling.

MiniMaxH3PromptBudgetCompilerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptBudgetCompilerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptBudgetCompilerT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Budget + Role Compiler / 提示词预算与角色编译 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3PromptBudgetCompilerT8Advanced.description: Never truncates. The default 7000-character audit ceiling matches the current official H3 CLI submission rule without claiming a local tokenizer hard limit. Also audits token budgets, media count/order, assignment coverage and subject-to-picture/video/audio bindings.

MiniMaxH3CreatorShotOverrideT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorShotOverrideT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorShotOverrideT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Shot Override / 可编辑镜头卡 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorShotOverrideT8Advanced.description: Adds one non-destructive overlay to an existing Studio Timeline shot: prompt, seed variants, media roles, retention and hold metadata. Chain one node per shot.

MiniMaxH3CreatorWorkspaceT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorWorkspaceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorWorkspaceT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Workspace / 创作运行窗口 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorWorkspaceT8Advanced.description: Compiles run-from/run-to selection, variants, retention and hold-map sidecar. It never queues, loads a model, deletes media or changes sampler math.

MiniMaxH3CreatorWorkspaceShotSelectT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorWorkspaceShotSelectT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorWorkspaceShotSelectT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Workspace Shot Select / 工作区镜头选择 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorWorkspaceShotSelectT8Adv.description: Selects one run position and one deterministic variant seed for existing H3 Conditioning/Sampler nodes. No hidden queue execution is performed.

MiniMaxH3CreatorSynchronizedCompareT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorSynchronizedCompareT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorSynchronizedCompareT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Synchronized A/B / 同步候选对比 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorSynchronizedCompareT8Adv.description: Creates a labelled side-by-side IMAGE batch on CPU, preserving aspect ratio by center padding and trimming only to the shorter frame count. Audio is not compared.

projection_path.tooltip: Absolute path or filename under ComfyUI/models/clip_projections. The header is read without loading tensors.

MiniMaxH3ClipProjCompatibilityAuditT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3ClipProjCompatibilityAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ClipProjCompatibilityAuditT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 ClipProj Compatibility Audit / 小编码器投影审计 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3ClipProjCompatibilityAuditT8Adv.description: Passes the connected CLIP through unchanged while auditing a separately installed ComfyUI-ClipProj wrapper, version, projection dimensions, Qwen3-VL declaration, load mode and visual-reference boundary. It never loads an encoder or matrix. Encoder quantization choices do not certify the diffusion MODEL/DiT format.

expected_dense_blocks.tooltip: Must match the upstream Sol node's dense_blocks widget, e.g. 0-2,-1. Those blocks intentionally have no Sol forward patch.

allow_unreviewed_composition.tooltip: When false, DiT replacements, whole-model wrappers and unknown full-block patches force ABSTAIN. True downgrades only that finding to a warning.

MiniMaxH3SolAttnCompatibilityAuditT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3SolAttnCompatibilityAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SolAttnCompatibilityAuditT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Sol-Attn Compatibility Audit / 外部补丁所有权审计 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3SolAttnCompatibilityAuditT8Adva.description: Passes MODEL through unchanged while checking a separately installed Sol-Attn version, CUDA/BF16 architecture, complete H3 attention ownership, shadowing and unreviewed DiT/model-wrapper combinations. It does not import or run the kernel.

output_device.tooltip: cpu avoids allocating the combined output on GPU. Input tensors can still remain cached by ComfyUI, so this is not a global unload operation.

require_identical_metadata.tooltip: When enabled, non-sample metadata must match exactly. Otherwise the first segment's metadata is preserved and differences are reported.

MiniMaxH3NativeLatentTimelineConcatT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3NativeLatentTimelineConcatT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentTimelineConcatT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Native Latent Timeline Concat / 原生时格拼接 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentTimelineConcatT8Adv.description: Concatenates independently sampled complete H3 AV latents on the native temporal grid: later video segments drop the exact 5-frame/2-latent prefix and audio drops a cumulative 24fps-to-40Hz phase amount. No sampling or VAE decode is performed.

MiniMaxH3AudioPerceptualDriftAuditT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3AudioPerceptualDriftAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioPerceptualDriftAuditT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Perceptual Drift Audit / 音色远近漂移审计 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3AudioPerceptualDriftAuditT8Adva.description: CPU-only, report-only comparison of a synchronized candidate against a reference. It marks persistent spectral-envelope and level drift for human review; it does not diagnose distance, reverb or speaker identity.

MiniMaxH3CreatorRunReceiptT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorRunReceiptT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorRunReceiptT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Run Receipt / 候选运行回执 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorRunReceiptT8Advanced.description: Records one explicitly observed candidate outcome, attempt, prompt ID, cache observation and artifact metadata. It never probes or mutates the queue/cache.

MiniMaxH3CreatorResumePlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorResumePlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorResumePlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Resume Plan / 下一候选与继续位置 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorResumePlanT8Advanced.description: Finds the next explicit render, review or retry from an immutable Creator Workspace and optional receipt ledger. It never queues, cancels or deletes.

MiniMaxH3CreatorBackgroundStartT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorBackgroundStartT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorBackgroundStartT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator × Long Video Background Start / 创作工作区后台绑定 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorBackgroundStartT8Advance.description: Binds one Creator Workspace hash to the existing proven Long Video background queue/cancel/retry controller. Use only with the Long Video candidate/Auto Accept terminal; review_only remains non-mutating.

MiniMaxH3CreatorBackgroundRunSelectT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorBackgroundRunSelectT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorBackgroundRunSelectT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator × Long Video Run Select / 按后台进度选择镜头 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorBackgroundRunSelectT8Adv.description: Uses the bound Long Video accepted_count and retry_count to choose the next Creator shot and deterministic seed. It never owns the queue; paused, failed, cancelled, detached or review-only states block downstream generation.

endpoint.tooltip: Empty uses 127.0.0.1:1234 for OpenAI-compatible or 127.0.0.1:11434 for Ollama. Non-loopback endpoints require HTTPS and explicit permission.

api_key_env.tooltip: Environment-variable name only; never paste the secret value here.

ollama_keep_alive.tooltip: 0 asks Ollama to unload after the response; ignored by other providers.

contract_repair_attempts.tooltip: Optional deterministic repair requests after contract validation fails. Default 0 preserves old workflow request count; retries do not resend images.

MiniMaxH3PromptProviderRouterT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptProviderRouterT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptProviderRouterT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Provider Router / 提示词服务路由 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3PromptProviderRouterT8Advanced.description: Uses the pinned H3 three-field rewriting contract with local passthrough, an OpenAI-compatible server (OpenAI/LM Studio/llama.cpp), or Ollama. Network use is explicit; keys come only from environment variables.

MiniMaxH3CreatorRetentionPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorRetentionPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorRetentionPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Artifact Retention Plan / 候选保留与拟删除清单 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorRetentionPlanT8Advanced.description: Compiles each shot's retention policy against explicit run receipts. It emits reviewable keep/proposed-delete manifests and never touches the filesystem.

checkpoint_id.tooltip: Logical checkpoint identity; must match during resume verification.

expected_manifest_json.tooltip: Leave empty to create a baseline. Paste the previously saved manifest to verify a reloaded latent before continuing.

mismatch_policy.tooltip: error is the safe resume default. report_only exposes a MISMATCH report without allowing it to be mistaken for a verified checkpoint.

hash_chunk_megabytes.tooltip: Upper bound for each temporary CPU hash chunk. It affects speed/memory, not the resulting content SHA-256.

MiniMaxH3NativeLatentResumeManifestT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3NativeLatentResumeManifestT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentResumeManifestT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Native Latent Resume Manifest / 原生Latent恢复清单 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentResumeManifestT8Adv.description: Builds a chunked exact SHA-256 manifest for one complete H3 AV latent. When a previous manifest is supplied, the default policy fails closed on any content, shape, dtype, mask or checkpoint-ID mismatch. It writes no files.

filename_prefix.tooltip: Relative filename prefix under output/MiniMaxH3/latent_checkpoints. A unique suffix is always added; absolute and traversal paths are rejected.

checkpoint_id.tooltip: Logical identity that must match when the checkpoint is reloaded.

confirm_save.tooltip: Safety gate. False only computes the exact content manifest and writes nothing; enable explicitly after reviewing the target and checkpoint ID.

verify_after_write.tooltip: Reloads the temporary safetensors file and verifies its embedded exact AV manifest before atomic placement. Keep enabled for resumable work.

hash_chunk_megabytes.tooltip: Maximum temporary CPU hash chunk. This changes memory/speed only, not the checkpoint content digest.

MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointSaveT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointSaveT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointSaveT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Native AV Latent Checkpoint Save / 原生音画Latent检查点保存 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointSaveT8Adv.description: Atomically saves one complete H3 nested video/audio latent as a no-pickle .h3latent.safetensors checkpoint under the ComfyUI output directory. confirm_save is false by default and existing files are never overwritten.

checkpoint_path.tooltip: Relative .h3latent.safetensors path returned by the Save node. It may be pasted after a restart or connected directly in the same graph.

expected_manifest_json.tooltip: Optional independently retained manifest. When supplied, any latent, mask, metadata, dtype, shape or checkpoint-ID mismatch fails closed.

expected_file_sha256.tooltip: Optional whole-file SHA-256 returned by Save. Use it to detect replacement of both payload and embedded manifest.

hash_chunk_megabytes.tooltip: CPU hash chunk bound; it does not change the resulting digest.

MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointLoadT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointLoadT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointLoadT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Native AV Latent Checkpoint Load / 原生音画Latent检查点加载 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointLoadT8Adv.description: Loads one H3 no-pickle AV latent checkpoint from the bounded ComfyUI output store, verifies its embedded exact-content manifest, and optionally requires an independently saved manifest and whole-file SHA-256.

timeline_latent.tooltip: Segment 0, or the output of this node from the previous continuation.

continuation_segment.tooltip: The sampled latent produced by the matching Long Video Conditioning.

planner_report_json.tooltip: Connect Long Video Segment Planner report_json for this segment.

conditioning_report_json.tooltip: Connect Long Video Conditioning report_json used for this segment.

output_device.tooltip: cpu keeps the combined output off GPU, but does not evict ComfyUI's cached input latents or models.

audio_context_policy.tooltip: The safe default requires the previous audio tail to have been supplied to Long Video Conditioning. allow_video_only still removes the overlap duration but cannot claim audio continuity.

MiniMaxH3NativeLatentContinuationConcatT.name: MiniMaxH3NativeLatentContinuationConcatT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentContinuationConcatT.display_name: MiniMax H3 Native Latent Continuation Concat / 原生续段去重拼接 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentContinuationConcatT.description: Appends one H3 Long Video continuation and removes its complete proven 5/22/39-frame head context on the native video/audio clocks. Planner and Conditioning reports must be connected directly; no sampling or VAE decode runs.

preset.tooltip: Published mode fixes 4 steps, shifts 12/3, sink/window 2/2 and CPU-pinned KV. Manual mode is forwarded exactly but is unreviewed.

MiniMaxH3RavenStreamingProfileT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3RavenStreamingProfileT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3RavenStreamingProfileT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 RAVEN Streaming Profile / 流式参数配置 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3RavenStreamingProfileT8Advanced.description: Emits one synchronized RAVEN parameter set for both the T8 audit and the external RAVEN Streaming Sampler. The default is the published 4-NFE profile.

unet_name.tooltip: Must be the full, non-pruned, non-quantized BF16 H3 diffusion model. INT8/FP8/NVFP4/ConvRot checkpoints are incompatible with v0.1.

lora_name.tooltip: Mandatory MiniMax H3 RAVEN Streaming LoRA; strength stays 1.0.

enforcement.tooltip: Default blocks before loading unless plugin/model/CUDA/BF16 and the reviewed ~24GiB GPU + 192GiB host-memory envelope pass. report_only still loads the model and is explicitly high risk.

MiniMaxH3RavenGuardedLoaderT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3RavenGuardedLoaderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3RavenGuardedLoaderT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 RAVEN Guarded Loader / 受保护加载器 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3RavenGuardedLoaderT8Advanced.description: Preflights the separately installed MIT RAVEN ComfyUI plugin, full BF16 H3 base, mandatory RAVEN LoRA and reviewed memory envelope before delegating to the external loader. No upstream runtime source is copied here.

allow_experimental_over_192.tooltip: Legacy compatibility input. Requests above the reviewed192-frame band now produce an advisory only, without requiring acknowledgement. External RAVEN engine shape and resource constraints still apply.

enforcement.tooltip: Mechanical conflicts include references/keyframes, non-empty latent, masks, non-causal MODEL, missing adapter and external object patches.

MiniMaxH3RavenRequestAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3RavenRequestAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3RavenRequestAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 RAVEN Request Audit / 流式请求审计 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3RavenRequestAuditT8Advanced.description: Delegates strict T2VA conditioning, empty-AV-latent and causal-MODEL checks to the external runtime, verifies the mandatory 266-module adapter and blocks unreviewed model/attention patches before the external streaming sampler.

mode.tooltip: disabled performs the same Euler math without file I/O; checkpoint_each_step writes after every completed NFE; resume loads the last valid boundary and emits only its remaining sigmas.

checkpoint_path.tooltip: Relative path under output/MiniMaxH3/nfe_checkpoints. Absolute paths, traversal and symlinks are rejected. Use a unique name per render.

model_contract_id.tooltip: Required outside disabled mode. Record the exact base checkpoint/hash, all LoRAs and strengths, and attention/model wrappers. A mismatch blocks resume; the node does not pretend this text hashes all loaded weights.

run_contract_json.tooltip: Required non-empty JSON outside disabled mode. Connect the MiniMax H3 NFE Run Contract output, or paste another strict immutable JSON object. The plain Conditioning report is text, not valid JSON.

confirm_checkpoint_write.tooltip: Safety gate. Required for checkpoint_each_step. In resume mode, false continues read-only; true also advances the same atomic checkpoint.

allow_replace_existing.tooltip: Only for intentionally starting a new session at an existing path. Resume of the already verified same session does not need this switch.

hash_chunk_megabytes.tooltip: Upper CPU chunk used to verify every checkpoint tensor. It changes verification memory/speed, never the mathematical state.

MiniMaxH3NFEResumeSamplerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3NFEResumeSamplerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3NFEResumeSamplerT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Dual-Clock NFE Checkpoint + Resume / 双时钟步边界断点恢复 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NFEResumeSamplerT8Advanced.description: Append-only experimental sampler setup for exact completed-step checkpoints of T8 dual_clock_euler/native_flow. It atomically stores the packed AV state, original noise/latent/mask and complete sigma table after every finished NFE. Other samplers, mid-forward recovery and undeclared model/conditioning changes fail closed. Existing samplers and workflows are unchanged.

action.tooltip: Always run prepare_only first and keep its manifest_json. quarantine moves reviewed files; restore/recover_to_source moves them back.

execution_manifest_json.tooltip: Empty for prepare_only. For quarantine, paste the exact prepared manifest. For restore, the quarantine receipt or original manifest is accepted.

expected_plan_hash.tooltip: Required for every mutating action and must exactly match the reviewed Retention Plan plan_hash.

execution_epoch.tooltip: 0 for prepare_only. Use a new positive integer for quarantine and reuse the same value for restore/recovery.

confirm_action.tooltip: False is non-mutating. Must be enabled explicitly for quarantine, restore or recovery after reviewing paths and hashes.

hash_chunk_megabytes.tooltip: Bounded CPU read chunk for SHA-256 verification.

MiniMaxH3CreatorArtifactQuarantineT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorArtifactQuarantineT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorArtifactQuarantineT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Artifact Quarantine / 候选文件可恢复隔离 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorArtifactQuarantineT8Adva.description: Append-only executor for a reviewed Creator Retention Plan. prepare_only hashes every proposed file without mutation. quarantine requires the retained manifest, exact plan hash, a new epoch and explicit confirmation, then atomically moves files into output/MiniMaxH3/creator_quarantine. restore/recover_to_source returns them to their original paths. It never permanently deletes files.

semantic_contract_json.tooltip: Strict local JSON. Each group requires id, any_of and scope. Scope is full, integrated, soundscape or music. Empty anchors always ABSTAIN.

MiniMaxH3PromptSemanticContractAuditT8Ad.name: MiniMaxH3PromptSemanticContractAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptSemanticContractAuditT8Ad.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Semantic Contract Audit / 提示词语义合同审计 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3PromptSemanticContractAuditT8Ad.description: Checks explicit required/forbidden phrase groups, exact dialogue blocks and media tags. It defaults to the original prompt until a mechanical pass is human-reviewed and explicitly accepted; it does not claim semantic equivalence.

hash_chunk_megabytes.tooltip: Upper CPU transfer chunk while hashing conditioning tensors. It only changes verification memory/speed, never the contract hash.

MiniMaxH3NFERunContractT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3NFERunContractT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3NFERunContractT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 NFE Run Contract / 断点运行合约编译器 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NFERunContractT8Advanced.description: Compiles the exact final prompt, media map, conditioning report and real conditioning tensor contents into strict deterministic JSON for the NFE checkpoint/resume node. It never mutates conditioning or sampler state.

preset.tooltip: subtle is the safe default; oil_control reduces bright oily patches; tone_even favors low-frequency tone consistency.

skin_mask.tooltip: Required for processing. Without a reliable explicit mask the node returns the source unchanged and reports ABSTAIN.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishT8.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishT8
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish / H3肤质收尾 (T8)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishT8.description: Creates a conservative non-generative skin-finishing candidate only inside an explicit MASK. Missing or unreliable masks ABSTAIN to the exact source. Before allocating full candidate/audit outputs it checks a shape-derived host RAM and Windows commit floor. It cannot reconstruct identity, missing facial structure, blur or lip sync.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False preserves the source on selected output. Acceptance is always explicit and never automatic.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishAdvancedT8.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishAdvancedT8
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishAdvancedT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish / H3肤质收尾 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishAdvancedT8.description: Append-only advanced P0 route with explicit mask provenance, area gates, CPU-bounded chunks, exact outside-mask pixels, exact alpha/aux preservation, shape-derived host/commit preflight and source-by-default selection. face_refine_plan builds a conservative inner-face proxy mask; it is not a semantic face parser.

comparison_position.tooltip: Left side is source; right side is candidate.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPreviewAuditT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPreviewAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPreviewAuditT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Preview / 肤质收尾预览审计 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPreviewAuditT8Advance.description: Builds a source/candidate split, full-resolution masked crop, used/rejected mask view, amplified difference and a ±2-frame loop. The selected output stays on source unless accept_candidate is explicitly enabled and audio passthrough remains PCM-exact.

absolute_start_frame.tooltip: Absolute zero-based frame index of this chunk. The first chunk must start at 0; later chunks may overlap a reviewed bounded tail.

preset.tooltip: Multi-person mode intentionally exposes only shared color-neutral finishing. Per-person hue/saturation changes are not automatic.

minimum_detail.tooltip: Gradient-detail floor used only to downweight already blurred faces. Skin Finish does not sharpen or reconstruct them.

bbox_ema_alpha.tooltip: Causal current-observation weight; resets naturally at shot-local tracks.

include_neck.tooltip: Off by default. A conservative neck strip is still clipped to the person track.

accept_candidate.tooltip: Source remains selected until the candidate has been reviewed.

audio.tooltip: Passed through as the same AUDIO object. Do not concatenate duplicate audio from overlapped chunks; use Video Finalize for file-level audio.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Multi-Person / 多人肤质收尾 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonT8Advanced.description: Reuses an existing native SAM3.1 multi-person track plan without loading SAM again. Shot-local person masks are intersected with CPU YuNet face regions; small, profile, blurred or occluded faces are downweighted. A hashed causal state lets overlapped long-video chunks continue without temporal RGB averaging.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False returns the exact source VIDEO and writes nothing. Enable only after reviewing the Skin Finish candidate.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishVideoFinalizeT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishVideoFinalizeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishVideoFinalizeT8Advanc.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Video Finalize / 原音频封装 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishVideoFinalizeT8Advanc.description: Finalizes reviewed full-length IMAGE frames against an untrimmed file-backed ComfyUI VIDEO. Video is encoded frame by frame while original compressed audio packet payloads are copied and SHA-256 verified. Unsupported codecs, trims, HDR/10-bit, geometry or packet drift fail closed.

minimum_detail.tooltip: Downweights already blurred faces; this node never sharpens or reconstructs missing detail.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False returns the source VIDEO without analysis or file writes. Enable only after choosing to render a review candidate.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishVideoStreamT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishVideoStreamT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishVideoStreamT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Video Stream / 两遍低内存肤质收尾 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishVideoStreamT8Advanced.description: Consumes an untrimmed file-backed VIDEO without GetVideoComponents. Pass 1 retains only pinned CPU YuNet face metadata; pass 2 processes bounded frame chunks, incrementally encodes H.264 and packet-copies verified source audio. No complete IMAGE batch is materialized. Source is selected by default.

shadow_protection.tooltip: Source luma at or below this value is preserved.

highlight_protection.tooltip: Source luma at or above this value is preserved.

minimum_texture_ratio.tooltip: Per-frame high-pass RMS floor relative to source. This is a hard retention guard, not a perceptual quality score.

maximum_new_clipped_fraction.tooltip: Maximum newly clipped masked-pixel fraction before frame fallback.

accept_candidate.tooltip: Source remains selected until the guarded candidate is reviewed.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTextureGuardT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTextureGuardT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTextureGuardT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Texture Guard / 肤质纹理保护 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTextureGuardT8Advance.description: Append-only fail-closed guard for an existing Skin Finish candidate. Source deep shadows and near-clipped highlights are preserved; frames that introduce clipping or fall below a source-relative high-frequency floor return to source. It is not a beauty score, semantic parser, deblur or pore generator.

include_neck.tooltip: Off by default so face finishing cannot spill onto neck or clothing.

crop_expansion.tooltip: Expanded upright square around each source-bound face box. Existing face plans do not retain five-point landmarks, so this is not affine alignment.

feature_protection_px.tooltip: Protection dilation in the fixed 512x512 parser canvas.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSemanticMaskT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSemanticMaskT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSemanticMaskT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Semantic Mask / 语义皮肤遮罩 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSemanticMaskT8Advance.description: Builds a source-bound semantic skin mask with the pinned local FaceXLib ParseNet checkpoint. Eyes, brows, nose, lips, mouth, hair and accessories are excluded by class. Missing, altered or unsafe weights fail closed to an empty mask; no network download or persistent model cache is used.

include_neck.tooltip: Neck remains excluded by default; clothing is always protected.

maximum_alignment_rms.tooltip: Normalized five-landmark residual on the 512 parser canvas.

minimum_ready_frame_fraction.tooltip: If fewer frames contain at least one reliable tracked face, the whole batch returns an empty mask instead of intermittent processing.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonSemanticMa.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonSemanticMaskT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonSemanticMa.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Multi-Person Semantic Mask / 多人语义皮肤遮罩 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonSemanticMa.description: Matches one pinned-YuNet five-point face to each shot-local SAM3.1 person track, aligns it to the FFHQ 512 template, runs the pinned ParseNet on CPU, and intersects the projected semantic skin mask with that person's track. Missing or ambiguous evidence fails closed to an empty mask.

selector.tooltip: Use the reviewed character ID, or switch selector_type to shot_track and enter a shot-local key such as 0:1.

tone_adjust.tooltip: Bounded midtone exposure-like adjustment; not automatic skin-tone matching. Keep 0 unless reviewed on the actual character.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPersonProfileT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPersonProfileT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPersonProfileT8Advanc.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Person Profile / 逐人物肤质参数 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPersonProfileT8Advanc.description: Adds one explicit character_id or shot:track Skin Finish profile to a small hashed in-memory stack. Chain the output into another profile node for more people. It never estimates skin tone or accepts a candidate automatically.

semantic_report_json.tooltip: Connect report_json from the same Multi-Person Semantic Mask node. The report binds source, track plan and mask.

default_policy.tooltip: source_unmatched changes only explicitly profiled people. default_profile applies the default controls to every remaining track.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False preserves source on selected output; acceptance is never automatic.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPerPersonT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPerPersonT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPerPersonT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Per-Person / 逐人物逐镜头肤质收尾 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPerPersonT8Advanced.description: Reassigns a source-bound combined ParseNet skin mask to exact SAM3.1 tracks, then applies reviewed per-character or per-shot parameters. Exact shot:track profiles override character profiles. Cross-person overlap and unmatched people remain bit-exact source pixels.

include_neck.tooltip: Neck remains excluded by default; clothing is always protected.

maximum_alignment_rms.tooltip: Strict five-landmark residual. This node does not raise it; a rejected pose may use the profile-crop fallback instead.

profile_crop_expansion.tooltip: Square face crop used only after strict five-point alignment rejects the pose. 1.45 passed the bounded six-frame profile probe.

minimum_ready_frame_fraction.tooltip: If fewer frames contain at least one reliable tracked face, the whole batch returns an empty mask instead of intermittent processing.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonProfileSem.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonProfileSemanticMaskT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonProfileSem.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Multi-Person Profile Semantic Mask / 多人侧脸语义皮肤遮罩 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonProfileSem.description: Keeps the existing strict YuNet five-point FFHQ alignment first. Only when that alignment is rejected, it parses an expanded square crop in the original profile pose, projects the mask back, and intersects it with the exact SAM3.1 person track. It does not frontalize a face or loosen the five-point residual gate.

audit_scope.tooltip: mask_only works without SAM. track_union requires every edited pixel inside a tracked person. unique_track_owner also rejects edits where two person masks overlap.

temporal_policy.tooltip: report_only records source-relative treatment jumps. hard_gate also rejects jumps above the configured limit.

maximum_temporal_effect_jump.tooltip: Maximum adjacent-frame change in mask-weighted treatment statistics, not raw video motion. Shot boundaries reset the comparison.

scene_cut_reset_threshold.tooltip: Used only without a track plan. A source-frame mean absolute change above this value resets the temporal comparison.

accept_candidate.tooltip: Even after hard gates pass, the source remains selected until a human explicitly enables this switch.

output_tooltips: The untouched candidate when all hard gates pass; exact source when any hard gate fails. Finalizers should consume this output.
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSafetyAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSafetyAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSafetyAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Safety Audit / 肤质候选安全审计 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSafetyAuditT8Advanced.description: Final fail-closed audit for a Skin Finish IMAGE candidate. It can reject mask spill, excessive changes, treatment jumps, multi-person track spill and audio mismatch. It cannot auto-score beauty or replace human review.

low_frequency_strength.tooltip: 0 keeps the source low-frequency layer; 1 uses the candidate's low-frequency tone/brightness correction.

source_detail_gain.tooltip: Gain for high-frequency detail already present in the source. 1.0 is neutral; this does not create missing detail.

separation_radius_percent.tooltip: Low-pass radius as a percentage of the shorter image side. Resolution-relative scaling avoids one fixed pixel radius across sizes.

maximum_radius_px.tooltip: Hard CPU-cost cap for the calculated separation radius.

maximum_new_clipped_fraction.tooltip: Frames exceeding this new clipping fraction return to source.

accept_candidate.tooltip: Source remains selected until the recombined candidate is reviewed.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishFrequencySplitT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishFrequencySplitT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishFrequencySplitT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Frequency Split / 肤色纹理解耦 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishFrequencySplitT8Advan.description: Rebuilds a Skin Finish candidate from its low-frequency tone/brightness layer and the source frame's existing high-frequency detail. It is non-generative: it cannot deblur, create pores, repair identity or decide that a result is better.

selector.tooltip: global ignores this text; character_id uses a reviewed assignment; shot_track uses the SAM-local key such as 0:1.

frame_in_shot.tooltip: Local frame inside the selected Studio Timeline shot.

interpolation_to_next.tooltip: Controls continuous parameters until the next key in the same Studio shot. Preset is categorical and switches only at the next key.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTimelineKeyframeT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTimelineKeyframeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTimelineKeyframeT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Timeline Keyframe / 肤质时间关键帧 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTimelineKeyframeT8Adv.description: Adds one source-bound Skin Finish keyframe to a hashed Studio Timeline plan. Keyframes interpolate only inside their Studio shot; SAM shot:track identity remains an independent routing domain. Chain multiple nodes for more keys.

semantic_report_json.tooltip: Connect report_json from the same source-bound Multi-Person Semantic Mask node.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False preserves source on selected output; acceptance is never automatic.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTimelineT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTimelineT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTimelineT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Studio Timeline / 逐人物肤质时间执行 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTimelineT8Advanced.description: Applies reviewed Skin Finish keyframes to exact semantic skin owned by each SAM3.1 track. Routing precedence is SAM shot:track, character_id, global, then bit-exact source. It never blends across Studio cuts or accepts automatically.

mask_feather_px.tooltip: Zero is the conservative semantic default; extra feathering may approach eyes or lips and requires review.

chunk_frames.tooltip: Two frames is the conservative CPU/RAM default.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False returns the exact source VIDEO without analysis or writes. Enable only to render a candidate for human review; the node never accepts aesthetic quality automatically.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishQualityVideoStreamT8A.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishQualityVideoStreamT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishQualityVideoStreamT8A.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Quality Stream / 语义低内存肤质收尾 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishQualityVideoStreamT8A.description: Two-pass file VIDEO route that never materializes a full IMAGE batch. Pass 1 keeps only pinned YuNet face metadata; pass 2 runs pinned CPU ParseNet, Skin Finish, Frequency Split, Texture Guard and a cross-chunk Safety Audit on bounded chunks, then incrementally encodes H.264 and packet-copies verified source audio. Accepted runs preflight a reviewed 2048 MiB available-system-RAM floor when host measurement is supported; insufficient RAM returns source and writes no file.

highlight_detail_suppression.tooltip: Restores the input candidate only where bright positive detail was lost. The correction cannot pass beyond that candidate; 0 is exact ordinary split.

maximum_specular_delta.tooltip: Hard per-pixel luma correction cap before Texture Guard.

accept_candidate.tooltip: The source stays selected until the labelled candidate is reviewed.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSpecularFrequencyT8Ad.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSpecularFrequencyT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSpecularFrequencyT8Ad.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Specular-Aware Split / 高光感知纹理解耦 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSpecularFrequencyT8Ad.description: Runs the unchanged Frequency Split, then selectively restores only the darker highlight intent that split lost. The result stays between the frequency base and the input Skin Finish candidate; mask exterior, alpha and audio stay bound.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False keeps the exact source selected. Enable only after labelled full-video review and downstream Texture/Safety gates.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSurfaceT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSurfaceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSurfaceT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Guided Surface / 引导滤波肤质收尾 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSurfaceT8Advanced.description: Clean-room guided-filter surface candidate for reliable semantic skin masks. It balances compact and broad highlights plus blemishes while explicitly retaining source texture. Broad highlights are measured against masked local skin illumination and treatment fades inside hard mask edges; this remains a display-referred finish, not physical specular separation. Source stays selected until full human review.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False keeps the exact source selected. Enable only after labelled full-video review and downstream Texture/Safety gates.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishDichromaticT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishDichromaticT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishDichromaticT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Dichromatic Specular / 二色反射高光抑制 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishDichromaticT8Advanced.description: Experimental clean-room highlight attenuation for reliable semantic skin masks. It requires both a neutral-illuminant dichromatic specular estimate and local chroma dilution, so same-chromaticity bright skin is preserved. This is bounded SDR finishing, not physical inverse rendering. Source stays selected until full human review.

model.tooltip: Connect the Dual-Clock MODEL, optionally through the complete KJNodes MiniMax H3 Sage patch. Do not connect an external LoRA.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect SIGMAS from the same Dual-Clock node. Consumer Turbo8 requires 8/12/3; SLA exact requires 4/6/3. A mismatch fails before sampling instead of producing a misleading collapsed video.

turbo_lora_name.tooltip: Regular Turbo LoRA for the recommended 8-step route. File identity, metadata and structure are reported only and never block loading.

sla_lora_name.tooltip: LightX2V SLA LoRA used only by the upstream-exact SLA profile. Alternate files are passed to the real loader without an identity gate.

profile.tooltip: consumer_turbo8_recommended: corrected regular Turbo LoRA, 8/12/3, dense or authenticated KJ Sage attention. sla_4step_upstream_exact_exp: SLA LoRA, 4/6/3, exact released 85% sparse experiment; base-family matching is diagnostic only. sla_4step_int8_bypass_exp: 4/6/3 INT8 ConvRot research route using dynamic model-only LoRA bypass to avoid base re-quantization. disabled_identity: no LoRA or attention change.

base_policy.tooltip: Records whether the base resembles the published BF16/FP8 evidence. Unknown, quantized and INT8 bases still pass through to real execution.

max_router_workspace_mib.tooltip: Fail-closed SLA router workspace ceiling. It affects only the SLA profile and is not a whole-workflow VRAM limit.

sla_start_percent.tooltip: INT8 bypass only: begin SLA sparse attention at this ComfyUI denoising progress. Default 0.15 keeps the first 4-step model forward dense. Other profiles ignore this range.

sla_end_percent.tooltip: INT8 bypass only: stop SLA sparse attention after this denoising progress. With 4 NFE, 0.15-0.90 maps to dense/sparse/sparse/sparse because model calls begin at 0%, 25%, 50% and 75%.

MiniMaxH3TurboSLAProfileRouterT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TurboSLAProfileRouterT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TurboSLAProfileRouterT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Turbo / SLA Profile Router (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3TurboSLAProfileRouterT8Advanced.description: Separates the project-validated consumer Turbo8 route from the exact LightX2V SLA experiment. Consumer Turbo8 loads the corrected Alpha8 bypass LoRA and requires 8 NFE with video/audio shift 12/3. SLA exact loads the selected SLA LoRA and requires the published 4 NFE with shift 6/3. The released evidence used BF16/FP8, but other selected base families are reported rather than blocked. It never silently runs an SLA LoRA as a dense Turbo fallback. The explicit INT8 bypass experiment keeps the quantized base untouched and applies the SLA residual dynamically; it is not a validated quality preset.

model.tooltip: Matching native ComfyUI full/non-pruned H3 MODEL. Do not connect an existing LoRA, pruned model or another PDD node.

av_latent.tooltip: Connect av_latent from the existing T8 Conditioning node. It is used to configure ComfyUI's native joint AV sampler.

pdd_lora_name.tooltip: Converted *_comfyui_pdd.safetensors file. Ordinary Load LoRA nodes drop the required dynamic PDD heads.

base_variant.tooltip: Select how the PDD runtime should interpret the adapter. File metadata and variant mismatches are reported but do not block loading.

strength.tooltip: Official released setting is 1.0. Lower values interpolate both the dynamic LoRA residual and PDD heads and are unvalidated.

MiniMaxH3PDD8StepSetupT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PDD8StepSetupT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PDD8StepSetupT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 PDD 8-Step Setup (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3PDD8StepSetupT8Advanced.description: Loads a converted Alibaba PAI MiniMax-H3 PDD adapter with its dynamic video/audio output heads. It applies the 258 backbone adapters as model-only bypass residuals and returns the required Euler/simple 8-step sampler and sigmas at shifts 12/3. Use only the matching full non-pruned FL2VA or Ref2VA base.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Audit / 音频精修前置审计 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineAuditT8Advanced.description: Read-only audit for an exact uncached MiniMax H3 joint-AV audio refinement tail. ALLOW is only a mechanical precondition; protected audio, unvalidated patches, and insufficient telemetry ABSTAIN.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefinePlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefinePlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefinePlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Plan / 音频精修尾段计划 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefinePlanT8Advanced.description: Builds a deterministic KSampler-equivalent partial-tail plan with fixed CFG 1, video/audio shifts 12/3, video mask 0, audio mask 1, dual_clock_euler and native_flow. It performs no sampling.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockSetupT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockSetupT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockSetupT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Dual-Clock Setup / 音频精修双时钟装配 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockSetupT8Adva.description: Revalidates the signed Plan and assembles deterministic NOISE, a BasicGuider-equivalent GUIDER, the stable T8 dual-clock sampler, exact tail SIGMAS and a nested 0/1 mask. It does not execute the model.

accept_candidate.tooltip: Keep false until you have listened to the saved original/candidate pair.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineQualityGateT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineQualityGateT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineQualityGateT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Quality Gate / 音频精修人工质量门 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineQualityGateT8Advance.description: Defaults to the original result. It audits decoded candidate audio, rejects invalid shape/rate/duration/non-finite data, and only after explicit human acceptance splices the candidate AUDIO latent into the exact original VIDEO latent. Signal heuristics are review cues, not quality claims.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineModelRouteT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineModelRouteT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineModelRouteT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Model Route / 音频精修双模型路由 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineModelRouteT8Advanced.description: Binds the audited first-pass MODEL to an explicit same-Turbo or base-without-Turbo refine MODEL using runtime base/patch UUIDs, weight-patch structure and LoRA metadata. Unknown stacks fail closed.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefinePhase2PlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefinePhase2PlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefinePhase2PlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Phase 2 Plan / 音频精修二阶段计划 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefinePhase2PlanT8Advanced.description: Builds the signed four-NFE Phase 2 tail for a proven model route. Only the pre-registered 0.35 and 0.50 denoise points are accepted.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelSetupT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelSetupT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelSetupT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Dual-Model Setup / 音频精修双模型装配 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelSetupT8Adva.description: Revalidates the signed Audit/Route/Plan, refine MODEL, conditioning, latent and resource gates, then emits the exact uncached dual-clock partial tail for SamplerCustomAdvanced.

render_window_frames.tooltip: Each segment is sampled independently with this fixed H3 window. 124 is the bounded-memory baseline.

segment_prompts_json.tooltip: Optional list/object. Each segment may override prompt, seed and note.

resume_existing.tooltip: Resume only when the saved job contract matches. Disable to require an empty chain_id.

long_video_sampling_plan.tooltip: Optional Tail/manual second-pass plan. Disconnect to preserve the original loop sampler and cache contract.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoInNodeLoopT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoInNodeLoopT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LongVideoInNodeLoopT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 In-Node Long Video Loop / 节点内循环长视频 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoInNodeLoopT8Advanced.description: One execution generates all H3 segments strictly in sequence, atomically accepts each completed segment, resumes from disk after interruption, and streams the accepted files into one final VIDEO. Existing long-video nodes and workflows are unchanged. This route intentionally has no per-segment human review gate; use the existing Background route when review is required.

global_prompt.tooltip: Used when Prompt Relay is disabled. With Relay, leave empty or copy the Plan global prompt exactly.

segment_prompts_json.tooltip: Prompt overrides must be empty when Prompt Relay owns the timeline.

prompt_relay_mode.tooltip: disabled is exact bypass; report_only compiles/projects Relay without attention bias; apply_exp enables the projected route.

eav_mode.tooltip: Stock20 only. report_only audits CFI/g without modifying attention; apply_exp enables target-video FETA gain.

minimum_free_vram_mib.tooltip: Rechecked before every segment; this is a start floor, not a peak guarantee.

long_video_sampling_plan.tooltip: Optional Tail/manual second-pass plan. Prompt Relay remains scoped; EAV audits pass 1 only for manual second-pass mode.

source_motion.tooltip: Dance RGB motion source. Read a different source interval per segment; generated continuity is separate.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoInNodeLoopEffectsT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoInNodeLoopEffectsT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LongVideoInNodeLoopEffectsT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 In-Node Long Video + Relay/EAV / 内循环长视频增强 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoInNodeLoopEffectsT8Adv.description: Append-only long-video runner that projects one global Prompt Relay timeline into every segment and/or creates one fresh Enhance-A-Video audit runtime per segment. Relay+EAV uses one Relay-then-FETA attention owner. The original in-node loop node and every old workflow remain unchanged.

MiniMaxH3AVLatentBuilderT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AVLatentBuilderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AVLatentBuilderT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 AV Latent Builder (T8 Advanced)
MiniMaxH3AVLatentBuilderT8Advanced.description: Combine separately encoded MiniMax H3 video and audio latents. Validates the official stream shapes and shared timeline before sampling.

MiniMaxH3AttentionHooksT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AttentionHooksT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AttentionHooksT8Advanced.description: Expose standard attn1 and attn1-output patch hooks on older H3 cores. Native hook support is preserved. Official H3 Sol/SLA/VSA producers are adapted locally: VSA tiles and coarse gates remain active. Calls with hooks materialize full QKV and may use more VRAM; calls without hooks retain the original chunked producer.

MiniMaxH3ForwardSyncOptimizationT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3ForwardSyncOptimizationT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ForwardSyncOptimizationT8Advanc.display_name: MiniMax H3 Forward Sync Optimization (T8 Advanced)
