MiniMaxH3ForwardSyncOptimizationT8Advanc.description: Reduce repeated H3 per-step device-to-host synchronization without changing schedules. Newer ComfyUI cores with the official behavior pass through natively.

MiniMaxH3GlobalCoordinateTiledVAET8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3GlobalCoordinateTiledVAET8Advanced
MiniMaxH3GlobalCoordinateTiledVAET8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Tiled VAE Coordinate Audit (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3GlobalCoordinateTiledVAET8Advan.description: Audit the upstream global-coordinate tiled-VAE proposal. A real fp16 H3 VAE check regressed grid artifacts, so the safe default reports only and returns the source VAE unchanged.

MiniMaxH3FunControlLoaderT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FunControlLoaderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FunControlLoaderT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Fun ControlNet Loader (T8 Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FunControlLoaderT8Advanced.description: Load an H3 Fun ControlNet from models/controlnet. Uses the official ComfyUI implementation when available and a clone-scoped fallback on older cores.

MiniMaxH3FunControlApplyT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FunControlApplyT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FunControlApplyT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Fun ControlNet Apply (T8 Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FunControlApplyT8Advanced.description: Drive H3 target video rows with a preprocessed depth, pose or edge video. Returns both MODEL and CONDITIONING so it works on current and future native cores.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoVoiceContextT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoVoiceContextT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LongVideoVoiceContextT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Long Video Voice Context / 长视频人物音色与句界 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoVoiceContextT8Advanced.description: Compiles Character-to-<Audio N> bindings, exact global/local audio pin frames, per-segment prompts and cross-boundary sentence diagnostics for the existing long-video runtime. It never reinjects or cuts waveform audio.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoVoiceReviewGateT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoVoiceReviewGateT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LongVideoVoiceReviewGateT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Voice Context Review Gate / 首段人工确认门 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoVoiceReviewGateT8Advan.description: Releases the compiled segment prompts only after the optional first-shot human review is accepted. This is a planning gate; a real pause between segments uses the existing Background/Accepted workflow.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoSeamDriftT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoSeamDriftT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LongVideoSeamDriftT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Long Video Seam Drift / 长视频接缝色彩漂移审计 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoSeamDriftT8Advanced.description: Reports seam brightness, white-balance, chroma, texture and optional person-ROI changes. The opt-in candidate uses only bounded low-frequency gain/offset and rolls unsafe frames back to source. It never sharpens, invents detail or touches audio.

MiniMaxH3ResidencyStrategyT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ResidencyStrategyT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ResidencyStrategyT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Residency Strategy / 低显存驻留策略 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ResidencyStrategyT8Advanced.description: Compiles a side-effect-free report_only/minimum_memory/balanced/faster policy from current ComfyUI and AIMDO telemetry. Applying it remains explicit through a compatible loader; this node never unloads other models or monkey-patches globally.

MiniMaxH3CreatorSegmentCacheT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorSegmentCacheT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorSegmentCacheT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Segment Cache / 创作分段语义缓存计划 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorSegmentCacheT8Advanced.description: Hashes source/model/LoRA/prompt/sampling/effect contracts per shot variant, reports declaration matches (not verified file/cache hits) and scoped invalidation, and proposes LRU quarantine under byte/count limits. It never opens, moves or deletes artifacts, never authorizes runtime cache reuse; accepted media stays protected.

MiniMaxH3GenericLoopCapabilityT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3GenericLoopCapabilityT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3GenericLoopCapabilityT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Generic Loop Capability / 通用循环能力探针 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3GenericLoopCapabilityT8Advanced.description: Read-only detection of the draft ComfyUI Generic Loops scheduler contract. It never enables a draft backend or changes the released T8 long-video runtime.

MiniMaxH3OfficialRiskDiagnosticT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3OfficialRiskDiagnosticT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3OfficialRiskDiagnosticT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Official Risk Diagnostic / 官方问题证据诊断 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3OfficialRiskDiagnosticT8Advance.description: Read-only evidence classifier for VRAM/V-copy, reference load, Sage FP8, audio integrity, multi-speaker cross-talk and periodic dark flashes. Unknown remains unknown; no model fingerprint or canvas-size hard gate is used.

MiniMaxH3TAEH3PreviewCapabilityT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3TAEH3PreviewCapabilityT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TAEH3PreviewCapabilityT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 TAEH3 Preview Capability / 快速预览能力 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3TAEH3PreviewCapabilityT8Advance.description: Read-only inspection of ComfyUI's native TAEH3 progress-preview path and the installed models/vae_approx asset. It never changes preview settings or sampling.

release_policy.tooltip: offload_after removes only RAFT weights from GPU; it never calls the global ComfyUI unload-all-models path.

MiniMaxH3RAFTMotionAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3RAFTMotionAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3RAFTMotionAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 RAFT Motion Audit / 光流运动审计 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3RAFTMotionAuditT8Advanced.description: Read-only RAFT optical-flow audit for real motion, sudden cuts and temporal collapse. It does not repair faces, sharpen frames or modify H3 sampling. Model selection has no filename/hash/byte-size allowlist.

keyframe_indices.tooltip: Comma-separated 0-based frame indices; count must equal the MASK batch.

MiniMaxH3RAFTMaskPropagationT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3RAFTMaskPropagationT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3RAFTMaskPropagationT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 RAFT Mask Propagation / 光流遮罩传播 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3RAFTMaskPropagationT8Advanced.description: Propagates one reviewed person/object mask through a shot with bidirectional RAFT and forward-backward confidence. Run once per identity. It stops at detected cuts and never assigns identity automatically.

MiniMaxH3TrajectoryControlPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TrajectoryControlPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryControlPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Trajectory Control Plan / 轨迹控制规划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryControlPlanT8Advanced.description: Builds normalized multi-object bbox trajectories from explicit keyframes. This is TrailBlazer-inspired creator interaction for H3 control-video conditioning, not a claim of reproducing TrailBlazer's U-Net attention edits.

MiniMaxH3TrajectoryControlRenderT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3TrajectoryControlRenderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryControlRenderT8Advanc.display_name: MiniMax H3 Trajectory Control Render / 轨迹控制视频 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryControlRenderT8Advanc.description: Renders the plan as a soft region, box path or reference sprite IMAGE batch for the existing H3 Fun Control Apply node. It creates no audio and owns no H3 attention.

MiniMaxH3RealBasicVSRRestoreT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3RealBasicVSRRestoreT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3RealBasicVSRRestoreT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 RealBasicVSR Temporal Restore / 时序修复 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3RealBasicVSRRestoreT8Advanced.description: Optional post-process based on the official OpenMMLab RealBasicVSR x4 architecture. It restores temporal/detail consistency in small serial chunks, keeps AUDIO as the exact original object and never downloads a model at runtime.

reuse_ratio.tooltip: Used only by variance_preserving_blend. paper_permutation always uses the paper-style full shared pool (1.0).

MiniMaxH3FreeNoiseLongVideoT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FreeNoiseLongVideoT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FreeNoiseLongVideoT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 FreeNoise Long Video / 长视频噪声重排 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3FreeNoiseLongVideoT8Advanced.description: Adds deterministic FreeNoise-style video-noise rescheduling to either T8 in-node long-video runner. It composes with Prompt Relay and Enhance-A-Video because it does not own attention. Audio noise remains native and independent.

manual_base_sigmas.tooltip: Used only by manual_h3_calibrated. Supply steps+1 strictly descending base-flow sigmas from 1.0 to 0.0.

schedule_label.tooltip: Human-readable provenance; a label is not validation evidence.

MiniMaxH3DualClockAYSScheduleT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3DualClockAYSScheduleT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3DualClockAYSScheduleT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Dual-Clock AYS Schedule Contract (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3DualClockAYSScheduleT8Advanced.description: Builds the native H3 schedule or imports H3-calibrated base-flow knots, then maps the same knots onto separate video/audio clocks. It does not claim that image-model AYS schedules are valid for MiniMax H3.

MiniMaxH3CADSVisualReferenceT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3CADSVisualReferenceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CADSVisualReferenceT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 CADS Visual Reference Annealing (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3CADSVisualReferenceT8Advanced.description: Applies the CADS paper formula to MiniMax H3 visual reference/keyframe latents at each denoising step. Audio conditioning and target audio are untouched.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilityRouteT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilityRouteT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilityRouteT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine 4/8-Step Compatibility Route / 音频精修4/8步兼容路由 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilityRouteT8.description: Append-only route for final-latent Audio Refine after Turbo4/8, learned two-pass, PDD, EAV, Prompt Relay and Long Video. The MODEL connected here is the explicit refine MODEL; filenames, sizes and disk hashes are never execution gates.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilityPlanT8A.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilityPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilityPlanT8A.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Compatibility Plan / 音频精修兼容计划 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilityPlanT8A.description: Builds the fixed four-NFE final audio tail for a signed compatibility route. Total NFE is reported as cost only, never as a training-distribution equivalence claim.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilitySetupT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilitySetupT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilitySetupT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Compatibility Setup / 音频精修兼容装配 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilitySetupT8.description: Revalidates the compatibility route, Relay/Long Video ownership when present, conditioning, final AV latent and resources, then emits the uncached four-NFE dual-clock audio tail for SamplerCustomAdvanced.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineLongVideoDeliveryT8A.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineLongVideoDeliveryT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineLongVideoDeliveryT8A.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Long Video Delivery Split / 长视频精修交付分流 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineLongVideoDeliveryT8A.description: Keeps the exact original segment AV latent for continuation and emits a separate reviewed delivery latent whose video is forcibly restored from the original. Never feed delivery_av_latent into the next segment.

MiniMaxH3LoRACompatibilityLoaderT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3LoRACompatibilityLoaderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LoRACompatibilityLoaderT8Advanc.description: MODEL-only H3 LoRA loader supporting native ComfyUI plus direct DiffSynth-Studio/ModelScope module names. It uses structural key mapping only; filenames and sizes are display-only, with no hash scan or model-file execution gate. Select disabled to pass the MODEL through, which makes an optional per-stage external LoRA safe.

MiniMaxH3TimedImageReferenceT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TimedImageReferenceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TimedImageReferenceT8Advanced.description: Adds one Qwen-only semantic image at an exact target time. Chain on the H3 CLIP line and use #prompt_tag in core Ref2VA. It is not VAE-encoded, does not enter minimax_refs and consumes no native slot.

MiniMaxH3TimedVideoReferenceT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TimedVideoReferenceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TimedVideoReferenceT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Timed Video Reference (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3TimedVideoReferenceT8Advanced.description: Presents selected video frames to Qwen at their generated-timeline times. This is semantic-only conditioning: no native H3 reference slot, VAE latent or audio is added.

target_width.tooltip: 仅target_dimensions模式使用。倍率/面积模式忽略此值；请用width输出连接HIGH条件。连接source_latent时会按aspect_policy计算实际目标尺寸。

target_height.tooltip: 仅target_dimensions模式使用。倍率/面积模式忽略此值；请用height输出连接HIGH条件。实际输出为32像素对齐后的尺寸。

sampling_contract.tooltip: 旧默认只重采视频并保留输入音频。标准4+4选standard_joint_4plus4_exp，并连接Parity Plan的report_json；每窗后4步联合AV，交付二采音频。

parity_report_json.tooltip: 标准4+4模式必接Learned Two-Pass Parity Plan的report_json；旧模式不需要。

size_mode.tooltip: 旧默认手填尺寸；scale_by按源LATENT倍率、target_megapixels按目标面积计算，均使用普通放大节点的数学与32像素对齐规则。

scale_by.tooltip: scale_by模式生效，例如1.5或2.0。必接source_latent，target_width/height在倍率模式不参与计算。

aspect_policy.tooltip: 连接源LATENT时preserve_source保持原比例；honor_dimensions_exp允许按手填尺寸改变比例，仍检查max_anisotropy。旧图不接源时仍保留原手填尺寸。

source_latent.tooltip: 接一采LATENT（标准4+4用denoised_output），用于读取实际原始宽高；不是HIGH条件的LATENT，不改变输入视频或音频。

MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Chunked Two-Pass Plan (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassPlanT8Advanced.description: Plans learned 3D latent upscale followed by temporal-chunk H3 re-sampling. The safe default keeps each temporal chunk full-frame; independent spatial canvases remain explicit EXP. There is no project pixel-area ceiling; memory and runtime remain user-owned. Optional scale_by/target_megapixels sizing reads the actual first-pass LATENT and uses the ordinary learned-upscaler geometry, aspect and 32-pixel alignment rules. Connect width/height outputs to HIGH conditioning to keep its canvas synchronized.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassUpscaleT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassUpscaleT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassUpscaleT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Chunked Two-Pass Upscale (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassUpscaleT8Advanced.description: Runs learned latent upscale per temporal chunk and restores the exact input audio tensor. Full-frame mode preserves global H3 spatial context; independent spatial tiles are research-only because their content can diverge. Opt-in standard_joint_4plus4_exp instead upscales once, runs four joint AV refine intervals per window, and publishes refined audio. Multiple windows increase total model calls; this is not eight calls for the entire clip.

MiniMaxH3FastH34StepSetupT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FastH34StepSetupT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FastH34StepSetupT8Advanced.description: Configures the published T2VA-only FastH3 4-step DMD2 joint-AV sampling contract. Apply the matching FastH3 LoRA first. Dense ComfyUI attention remains the default; the opt-in VSA profile applies the learned 90%-sparse tile-64 route only when the LoRA gate payload and current Comfy Kitchen VSA kernel contract are both available, otherwise it falls back to dense.

frames.tooltip: Decoded H3 draft frames; AUDIO is intentionally not accepted.

frame_policy.tooltip: Official route trims without adding frames. preserve_all_exp is only for runtimes that explicitly accept a non-8n+1 length.

fps.tooltip: Source H3 frame rate; used only to calculate exact audio-bypass trim duration.

MiniMaxH3SolEngineDraftToLTXT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SolEngineDraftToLTXT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SolEngineDraftToLTXT8Advanced.display_name: H3 Super: Draft to LTX Refiner / H3草稿转LTX二阶段 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3SolEngineDraftToLTXT8Advanced.description: Prepares decoded H3 RGB frames for NVIDIA's H3 Super Acceleration Stage 2: trim to the LTX 8n+1 frame grid, aspect-preserving center-crop to half the requested output size, then encode it with ComfyUI's full LTX-2.5 video VAE before the official x2 latent upsampler. The refiner was trained on the full VAE latent distribution; TAEHV is only used for the final fast decode. H3 audio must bypass Stage 2 on a separate wire.

model.tooltip: LTX-2.5 dev transformer with the distilled refiner LoRA applied at 0.8.

attention_backend.tooltip: auto uses an already-loaded ComfyUI-SolAttn_triton; otherwise it safely stays dense.

MiniMaxH3SolEngineLTXRefinerSetupT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3SolEngineLTXRefinerSetupT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SolEngineLTXRefinerSetupT8Advan.description: Configures the official LTX-2.5 Stage-2 Euler schedule [0.909375, 0.725, 0.421875, 0], keeps self-attention layer 0 dense, and routes layers 1-47 through the loaded ComfyUI-SolAttn_triton backend with tau 1.0/1.25/1.5. Missing Sol-Attn falls back to dense without blocking. Apply the official LTX-2.5 distilled LoRA at the returned 0.8 strength before this node.

model_name.tooltip: Place the official weight in ComfyUI/models/taehv or models/vae.

MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVLoaderT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVLoaderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVLoaderT8Advanced.display_name: H3 Super: TAEHV Wide Loader / TAEHV宽模型加载 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVLoaderT8Advanced.description: Loads the taeltx2_3_wide codec used by NVIDIA's published H3 Super Stage 2. The architecture is selected explicitly; execution is never blocked by a filename, hash, or byte-size allowlist.

MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVEncodeT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVEncodeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVEncodeT8Advanced.display_name: TAEHV Encode (Legacy/Diagnostic) / TAEHV编码（旧兼容/诊断）
MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVEncodeT8Advanced.description: Legacy-compatible TAEHV round-trip encoder. Do not connect this output to the H3 Super LTX-2.5 refiner: NVIDIA keeps the original full LTX video VAE encoder because the refiner was trained on that latent distribution.

MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVDecodeT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVDecodeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVDecodeT8Advanced.display_name: H3 Super: TAEHV Decode / TAEHV解码 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVDecodeT8Advanced.description: Decodes the refined normalized LTX video latent with the published TAEHV wide path.

model.tooltip: LTX-2.5 dev transformer with the distilled refiner LoRA applied at 0.8.

schedule_mode.tooltip: The preset always uses 0.5, 0.412, 0.350, 0. manual_exp parses the next field.

manual_sigmas.tooltip: Comma-separated, finite, strictly descending values ending at zero. Used only when schedule_mode=manual_exp.

attention_backend.tooltip: Dense isolates the sigma change. The Sol route is optional and experimental.

MiniMaxH3SolEngineLTXIdentityRefinerSetu.name: MiniMaxH3SolEngineLTXIdentityRefinerSetupT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SolEngineLTXIdentityRefinerSetu.display_name: H3 Super: LTX-2.5 Low-Sigma Identity Refiner / LTX低Sigma保脸细化 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3SolEngineLTXIdentityRefinerSetu.description: Append-only identity-preserving Stage-2 route. The default schedule is [0.5, 0.412, 0.350, 0]: three Euler updates with complete terminal denoising. Dense attention is the validated-first default. Optional Sol-Attn uses a conservative constant tau 1.0 EXP policy instead of remapping custom knots to the official per-step tau schedule. H3 audio remains on the external bypass.

MiniMaxH3FlashVSRModelT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FlashVSRModelT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FlashVSRModelT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 FlashVSR Model / 视频超分模型 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3FlashVSRModelT8Advanced.description: Loads the official FlashVSR/FlashVSR-v1.1 checkpoint set from ComfyUI/models. No hash, file-size or pixel limit is enforced; missing structural files remain actionable errors.

MiniMaxH3FlashVSRExecutionPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FlashVSRExecutionPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FlashVSRExecutionPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 FlashVSR Plan / 质量与显存计划 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3FlashVSRExecutionPlanT8Advanced.description: Plans fixed quality, opt-in motion-aware budgets, or memory-safe tiling. quality_locked keeps the public 2.0/3.0/11 LCSA settings unchanged.

MiniMaxH3FlashVSRRestoreT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FlashVSRRestoreT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FlashVSRRestoreT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 FlashVSR Restore / 视频超分执行 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3FlashVSRRestoreT8Advanced.description: Runs the selected FlashVSR plan, trims repeated tail padding and returns the exact original AUDIO object. No resolution ceiling is imposed; use memory_safe when resources are limited.

manual_sigmas.tooltip: Used only by manual_second_pass; must strictly descend to 0.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoSamplingPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoSamplingPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LongVideoSamplingPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Long Video Tail/Second Pass Plan (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoSamplingPlanT8Advanced.description: Optional append-only sampling plan for the two in-node long-video runners. Disconnected/disabled preserves their old sampler exactly.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassGlobalNoisePlanT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassGlobalNoisePlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassGlobalNoisePlanT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Chunked Two-Pass Global Noise Plan (v2 Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassGlobalNoisePlanT8.description: Opt-in v2 plan: creates one full target-resolution video-noise field and slices it by exact coordinates. Temporal overlap inherits the previous output only in the explicit guarded_overlap_exp route. The default full_clip_safe route never stitches temporal trajectories. Use full_frame_safe for quality: independent spatial H3 Transformer tiles change local coordinates and remain diagnostic EXP only. Old v1 plans and workflows are unchanged. Audio noise stays zero and the executor returns the exact input audio tensor.

second_pass_audio_policy.tooltip: joint_av_preserve_input matches the upstream model-context behavior but discards refined audio at output; locked_input_audio is a diagnostic alternative.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassLowSigmaPlanT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassLowSigmaPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassLowSigmaPlanT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Complete First Pass + Low-Sigma Refine Plan (v3 Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassLowSigmaPlanT8Adv.description: Corrected append-only v3 route. Complete the first-pass trajectory to sigma zero before learned latent upscale, then connect a separate low-noise schedule. The published workflow uses ComfyUI BasicScheduler(simple, 3 steps, denoise 0.30). The default keeps one full-frame/full-clip H3 trajectory. Joint AV context is sampled during refine, while the exact first-pass audio tensor is returned for delivery. Old v1/v2 nodes and workflows are unchanged.

video_mask_policy.tooltip: Recommended: inherit_required. It refuses an unmasked input instead of silently reopening the full background.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassMaskedLowSigmaPla.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassMaskedLowSigmaPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassMaskedLowSigmaPla.display_name: MiniMax H3 Mask-Preserving Low-Sigma Refine Plan (v4 Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassMaskedLowSigmaPla.description: Append-only v4 route for a first-pass H3 latent that already carries a nested video noise mask. The learned upscaler resizes only the mask's spatial grid with nearest-exact; the second pass multiplies that mask with spatial and temporal ownership. Mask value 0 protects the original region and 1 permits refinement. Dynamic mismatched time masks are rejected instead of interpolated. The exact first-pass audio is still returned. Old v1/v2/v3 nodes and workflows are unchanged.

base_frames.tooltip: D0/base frames that own the background.

refined_frames.tooltip: T2/refined frames for the subject only.

subject_alpha.tooltip: Reviewed per-frame final alpha. Zero means exact D0 ownership.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False keeps selected output on D0. Enable only for a reviewed candidate.

mask_frame_policy.tooltip: Strict requires one alpha frame for every video frame.

protect_mask.tooltip: Optional face/text/identity protection; one removes T2 ownership.

audio.tooltip: D0/source audio is returned as the exact same object.

MiniMaxH3SubjectSafeRGBCompositeT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3SubjectSafeRGBCompositeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SubjectSafeRGBCompositeT8Advanc.display_name: MiniMax H3 Subject-Safe RGB Composite / 人物安全RGB合成 (v8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SubjectSafeRGBCompositeT8Advanc.description: Keeps the D0/base frame everywhere outside a reviewed per-frame subject alpha and blends the refined T2 candidate only inside that alpha. No automatic person, face, text, camera or quality decision is performed.

full_song.tooltip: 最终成片使用的完整原曲。

vocal_policy.tooltip: 没有人声干声时推荐 assume_vocal；energy_proxy 仅按能量估计；vocal_stem_required 要求连接本地干声。

manual_boundaries_json.tooltip: 可选秒数列表，例如 [5.2, 11.8]；留空自动分析。

MiniMaxH3MVVocalScenePlannerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MVVocalScenePlannerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MVVocalScenePlannerT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 MV Vocal Scene Planner / 本地歌曲分镜 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3MVVocalScenePlannerT8Advanced.description: Analyzes local AUDIO with deterministic CPU tensor math and chooses 5–10s scene boundaries before generation. A local vocal stem is optional. No remote LLM, TTS, music service or external API is called.

global_creative_prompt.default: A singer performs through a coherent cinematic music video with natural expression and intentional scene changes.

performer_description.default: the same lead performer shown in the reference picture

visual_style.default: cinematic music video, natural skin, realistic light and texture

camera_pattern.tooltip: 每行或每个 | 一种镜头，按场景循环使用。
camera_pattern.default:
stable medium close-up with subtle handheld movement
smooth lateral tracking medium shot
restrained slow push-in with a stable background

non_vocal_action.default: keeps the mouth naturally closed and moves with the rhythm

exact_lyrics_json.tooltip: 可选：按场景提供精确歌词字符串列表。留空时绝不猜歌词，也不生成字幕。

MiniMaxH3MVRef2VAPromptCompilerT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3MVRef2VAPromptCompilerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MVRef2VAPromptCompilerT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 MV Ref2VA Prompt Compiler / 本地口型分镜提示词 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3MVRef2VAPromptCompilerT8Advance.description: Deterministically compiles one six-section Ref2VA prompt per local scene. It uses <Picture 1>/<Audio 1>, never guesses lyrics and also exposes typed Prompt Relay events. No LLM or external API is used.

model.tooltip: 本地 MiniMax H3 MODEL。

clip.tooltip: 本地 MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP。

full_song.tooltip: 驱动表演并最终一次性混入成片的原曲。

width.tooltip: 官方 Ref2V Turbo v0.1 验证尺寸；需要其他画幅时再显式修改。

model_id.tooltip: 只写入审计报告，不校验文件名、大小或哈希。

MiniMaxH3LocalMVInNodeRendererT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LocalMVInNodeRendererT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LocalMVInNodeRendererT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Local MV In-Node Renderer / 全本地MV内循环生成 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LocalMVInNodeRendererT8Advanced.description: Generates every Ref2VA scene serially through the connected local H3 MODEL, atomically resumes accepted scenes, assembles video with bounded memory and muxes the original full song once. It never submits ComfyUI /prompt HTTP jobs and never calls a remote video, LLM, TTS or music API.

full_song.tooltip: 最终成片使用的完整原曲。

vocal_lock_audio.tooltip: 必需：与原曲同起点、同时间线的本地隔离人声或清晰对白。

vocal_active_ratio.tooltip: 场景内高于本地人声能量门的最小时间比例。

manual_boundaries_json.tooltip: 可选秒数列表，例如 [5.2, 11.8]；留空自动分析。

MiniMaxH3MVVocalLockScenePlannerV2T8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3MVVocalLockScenePlannerV2T8Advanced

MiniMaxH3LocalMVVocalLockVisualRendererV.display_name: MiniMax H3 Local MV Vocal Lock Visual Renderer V3 / 单人物视觉合同生成 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LocalMVVocalLockVisualRendererV.description: Runs only V3 visual-director prompt plans through the connected local H3 MODEL, using an independent resume contract and preserving full_song for one final mux.

MiniMaxH3SLADynamicLoRABypassV2T8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SLADynamicLoRABypassV2T8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SLADynamicLoRABypassV2T8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 SLA Dynamic LoRA Bypass V2 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SLADynamicLoRABypassV2T8Advance.description: Loads the selected H3 SLA LoRA as a model-only dynamic residual. Quantized base weights are not merged or re-quantized. Place this before SLA Precision V2 Attention.

MiniMaxH3SLAPrecisionV2T8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SLAPrecisionV2T8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SLAPrecisionV2T8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 SLA Precision V2 Attention (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SLAPrecisionV2T8Advanced.description: Precision-first MiniMax H3 SLA attention derived from PlagueKind v1.4.3 at pinned commit 066ada9: FP32 routing, direct Triton sparse attention, logical sigma-step tracking, first/last dense protection and precise language/audio segment protection. Input MODEL must already carry the SLA LoRA; the recommended route uses the matching dynamic bypass node.

MiniMaxH3SLAPrecisionV2AuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SLAPrecisionV2AuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SLAPrecisionV2AuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 SLA Precision V2 Runtime Audit (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SLAPrecisionV2AuditT8Advanced.description: Fails closed after sampling unless logical NFE, 50 H3 blocks per sparse step, dense boundaries, protected audio/language blocks and zero kernel fallback are all observed.

av_latent.tooltip: Connect the matching Long Video Conditioning latent before the sampler.

context.tooltip: Connect the same validated Previous Context used by Conditioning.

planner_report_json.tooltip: Connect the matching Segment Planner report_json directly.

conditioning_report_json.tooltip: Connect the matching Long Video Conditioning report_json directly. Conditioning must use context_audio=video_only.

MiniMaxH3NativeMaskedVideoContextT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3NativeMaskedVideoContextT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3NativeMaskedVideoContextT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Native Masked Video Context / 原生画面硬续接 Plan B (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NativeMaskedVideoContextT8Advan.description: Plan B for Long Video continuation. It copies the validated previous native video-latent tail into the current target and hard-locks only that video prefix. The current audio tensor and any Vocal Lock audio mask are reused unchanged.

enabled.tooltip: Default on. Disable for exact source frames while still recording the tail statistics for a later segment.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoColorMatchT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoColorMatchT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LongVideoColorMatchT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Long Video Color Match / 长视频接缝颜色统一 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoColorMatchT8Advanced.description: Default-on optional seam color matching after Output Trim. Segment 0 stores its actual tail statistics; later segments use bounded global Lab distribution matching plus an 8x5 local RGB correction that fades out. Audio and native AV latent are never changed.

allow_structural_base.tooltip: Explicit provenance exception for a structurally matching Comfy H3 base whose exact official BF16 revision is unavailable.

MiniMaxH3VDNRuntimeAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3VDNRuntimeAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3VDNRuntimeAuditT8Advanced.description: Read-only audit for the pinned OpenVDN MiniMax H3 branch and adapters. Checks exact asset identity, native H3 structure, attention ownership and the explicit structural-base exception without loading the 4.28GB branch. The report also exposes the separately governed weight-license boundary.

allow_structural_base.tooltip: Required for the current local INT8/ConvRot H3 base. This records an explicit unproven-base exception; it does not relabel it exact.

MiniMaxH3VDNModelComposerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3VDNModelComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3VDNModelComposerT8Advanced.description: Clones a clean native H3 MODEL, applies the pinned OpenVDN default/turbo adapters, and attaches the 50-layer VDN branch through Comfy ModelPatcher. Supports native H3 text, first/last-frame, image/video/audio-reference and hybrid PackedLayouts while rejecting every competing attention owner. Users must review the MiniMax H3 Community License before running the weights.

MiniMaxH3VDNExecutionPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3VDNExecutionPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3VDNExecutionPlanT8Advanced.description: Builds the exact OpenVDN sampling contract from the connected MODEL: DMD uses 8 NFE, Stage B uses 50 NFE, both use native AV Euler and video/audio shifts 12/3. No user-overridable mismatched step count.

probe_mode.tooltip: feature_probe_1_frame：实际运行一帧自检，通过后可接超分。static_only：仅检查文件和环境，不输出可运行句柄。

dxgi_adapter_index.tooltip: 外部程序使用的 Windows 显卡编号，不是显存大小。单显卡一般用 0；必须与 CUDA 选择对应同一张卡。

cuda_device_index.tooltip: ComfyUI/PyTorch 使用的 CUDA 设备编号。单显卡一般用 0；不是 Windows DXGI 编号的同义词。

MiniMaxH3DLSSNRRuntimeAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3DLSSNRRuntimeAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3DLSSNRRuntimeAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 DLSS-NR Runtime Audit (T8 Advanced)
MiniMaxH3DLSSNRRuntimeAuditT8Advanced.description: Read-only Windows/RTX audit for a user-supplied, allowlisted DLSS-NR runtime. It verifies the official release archive, installed EXE/DLL byte identity, driver, free VRAM and CUDA/DXGI adapter mapping. It never downloads, installs, unloads models, upgrades drivers or processes media in static-only mode.

MiniMaxH3DLSSNRImageSuperResolutionT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 DLSS-NR Image / 图片超分 (T8 Advanced)
MiniMaxH3DLSSNRImageSuperResolutionT8Adv.description: Runs each SDR IMAGE independently through the audited external runtime. Supports 1x NR-only or 1.5x/2x/3x SR-only and SR+NR. RGB uses an explicit 8-bit RGBA bridge; alpha and extra channels are resized from the source and reattached. Standard matches the reference wrapper; custom exposes every NR control and v1.3 SR model selector.

MiniMaxH3DLSSNRVideoFileT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 DLSS-NR Video File / 文件视频超分 (T8 Advanced)
MiniMaxH3DLSSNRVideoFileT8Advanced.description: Streams an untrimmed SDR 8-bit Rec.709 CFR file-backed VIDEO without building a full IMAGE batch. Candidate video is encoded separately, source audio packets are copied and packet/PCM checked, and publication is atomic. HDR, VFR, rotation, crop metadata, odd target sizes and unsupported audio fail closed.

action_preset.tooltip: WASD controls the character; IJKL controls the camera; F makes pan fast.

custom_timeline_json.tooltip: Only used when preset=custom. Segments must tile 0..37 without gaps.

MiniMaxH3WorldActionTimelineT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3WorldActionTimelineT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3WorldActionTimelineT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3-World Action Timeline / 动作时间线 (T8)
MiniMaxH3WorldActionTimelineT8Advanced.description: Builds the exact 37-step H3-World action script for one 832x480, 124-frame clip. Custom ranges use end-exclusive latent indices.

compile_flex_attention.tooltip: Recommended. First run compiles one shape-specific FlexAttention kernel.

MiniMaxH3WorldModelComposerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3WorldModelComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3WorldModelComposerT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3-World Model Composer / 模型组合 (T8)
MiniMaxH3WorldModelComposerT8Advanced.description: Loads the H3-World LoRA and installs its required per-action text refiner segmentation plus directed FlexAttention runtime.

prompt.default: A man in a yellow floral shirt stands in a dim, multi-level concrete parking garage.

MiniMaxH3WorldI2VAConditioningT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3WorldI2VAConditioningT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3WorldI2VAConditioningT8Advanced.description: First-frame H3-World conditioning. Action sentences are encoded and refined independently, then bound one-to-one to 37 video latents.

MiniMaxH3WorldSafeVideoSaveT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3WorldSafeVideoSaveT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3WorldSafeVideoSaveT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3-World Safe Video Save / 安全视频保存 (T8)
MiniMaxH3WorldSafeVideoSaveT8Advanced.description: Saves the fixed 832x480x124 H3-World result with an isolated, single-thread libx264 process. The MP4 is published only after strict video and audio decoding succeeds.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Window Plan / 局部修脸窗口规划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowPlanT8Advanced.description: Plans explicit shot-local 24fps H3 windows around 0-based inclusive repair ranges. It binds the source, rejects hard-cut crossings and overlap ambiguity, and never loads a model or accepts a candidate automatically. Empty or disabled plans are exact no-op routes.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowExtractT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowExtractT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowExtractT8Advanc.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Window Extract / 合法窗口提取 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowExtractT8Advanc.description: Extracts one contiguous 17n+5 IMAGE window without resizing. Explicit edge padding repeats only the boundary image while the corresponding AUDIO samples remain zero. Generated window audio is never authorized as the final soundtrack.

accepted_subranges.tooltip: Optional 0-based inclusive source-frame ranges. Empty means the planned repair range, but only after confirm_accept is enabled.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineManualReviewT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineManualReviewT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineManualReviewT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Manual Review / 人工选择回贴 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineManualReviewT8Advance.description: Shows the source window beside the candidate and keeps the complete source timeline by default. Acceptance requires an explicit confirmation and can only touch selected source repair frames inside the supplied changed mask. Context, padding and candidate audio are never accepted automatically.

execution_mode.tooltip: Preview in review_only first. The second mode does not accept by itself; Commit still requires an explicit accept/reject decision.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioStartT8Ad.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioStartT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioStartT8Ad.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Window Studio Start / 多窗口串行启动 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioStartT8Ad.description: Creates or resumes a source-bound multi-window manifest. review_only never queues work. Explicit accept-and-continue reuses the Long Video OS process lease, retry and cancellation controller and may queue only one next window.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioCommitT8A.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioCommitT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioCommitT8A.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Window Studio Commit / 人工决策提交 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioCommitT8A.description: Validates the current source-bound candidate again, then atomically records an explicit accept or reject. Accepted overlays are immutable and never overwrite source media. Only after that durable boundary may one next prompt be queued.

commit_barrier.tooltip: Optional Commit report link used only to enforce graph order.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioComposeT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioComposeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioComposeT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Window Studio Compose / 已接受窗口合成 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioComposeT8.description: Rebuilds the full IMAGE timeline from immutable source frames plus accepted Studio overlays. Rejected and pending windows remain exact source. Connect the original complete AUDIO separately when saving the final video.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineSamplerMaskPatchV11T8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineSamplerMaskPatchV11T8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineSamplerMaskPatchV11T8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Sampler-Mask Fix V1.1 / 采样遮罩修正 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineSamplerMaskPatchV11T8.description: Optional, disabled by default: the reviewed fixture favored the original route. Disabled returns the exact input MODEL and LATENT unchanged. When enabled, Applies the audited H3 FaceRefine v1.1.1 correction on a cloned MODEL: the video noise mask remains on the sampler path only, held video is re-noised to the current sigma, and the locked audio mask still reaches MiniMax H3 unchanged. The connected latent and denoise report are hash-bound; unsupported models, stale reports and conflicting object patches fail closed.

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintSampleT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintSampleT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintSampleT8.description: Draft native MODEL path, including audited KJ memory patches. Other acceleration adapters remain pending.

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintCandidateT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintCandidateT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintCandidateT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 生成首帧候选 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintCandidateT8.description: 只生成首个窗口并显示真实首帧。先单独运行本节点审图，再连接选择/接续。候选名或生成设置改变需使用新缓存。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintSelectCandidateT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintSelectCandidateT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintSelectCandidateT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 确认所连候选 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintSelectCandidateT8.description: 将喜欢的候选接入。只有已看过首帧并开启确认，才允许接续；不会自动挑选候选。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintContinueCandidateT.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintContinueCandidateT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintContinueCandidateT.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 接续所选候选 (EXP)

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintComposeCandidateT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintComposeCandidateT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintComposeCandidateT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 保存所选扩画 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintComposeCandidateT8.description: 沿用候选的颜色设置，首帧RGB与所选预览不符时拒绝发布。原声音保留。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadCandidateT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadCandidateT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadCandidateT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 读取已存候选 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadCandidateT8.description: 按生成时返回的candidate_id读取原候选PNG，不采样、不解码VAE、不自动确认。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadSelectionT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadSelectionT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadSelectionT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 恢复已确认候选 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadSelectionT8.description: 明确输入之前确认时返回的selection_id。读取原候选和确认记录，可接Continue；不会自动生成或改选。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadCompletedSelec.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadCompletedSelectionT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadCompletedSelec.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 读取已完成选择 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadCompletedSelec.description: 读取已确认且全部窗口已完成的缓存，可直接接保存节点；不加载生成模型、不采样。未完成缓存会拒绝。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadPreparedT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadPreparedT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadPreparedT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 读取已准备缓存 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadPreparedT8.description: 用相同原片、Plan参数和run_name读取已完成的源视频/音频/提示词缓存。不加载CLIP/VAE，不重新编码提示词；缺失或损坏会报错。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintGuidanceT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintGuidanceT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintGuidanceT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 区域提示/人物保护计划 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintGuidanceT8.description: 区域提示按H3原生32px空间token路由；人物框使用原片坐标，只审计已锁定原片中的人物及边界风险，不声称扩出区域能绝对阻止人物幻觉。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintPrepareGuidedT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintPrepareGuidedT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintPrepareGuidedT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 准备区域引导缓存 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintPrepareGuidedT8.description: 独立的区域引导准备路径；不会改变普通Prepare节点或已有工作流。请使用新的run_name。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintRegionalModelT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintRegionalModelT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintRegionalModelT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 区域引导模型 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintRegionalModelT8.description: 把已准备的区域提示绑定到原生H3 MODEL；兼容已审计KJ低显存Attention/FFN，拒绝LoRA、其他Attention所有者和未知wrapper静默叠加。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintCompatibilityAudit.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintCompatibilityAuditT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintCompatibilityAudit.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 模型组合审计 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintCompatibilityAudit.description: 读取真实MODEL内容与patch/wrapper，不按文件名猜。Stock20与已锁定KJ低显存补丁可用；Turbo/SPEED/SLA/VDN/Fast H3/Prompt Relay尚无扩画组合验收时明确标为不支持。

MiniMaxH3VDNRefinePlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3VDNRefinePlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3VDNRefinePlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 VDN Two-Pass Refine / VDN二采 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3VDNRefinePlanT8Advanced.description: Restart VDN on its own stage sigma grid after a completed first pass and learned video latent upscale. Rebuild high-resolution Conditioning and reconcile audio first. Connect fresh RandomNoise; do not add another Turbo LoRA. Quality is experimental.

MiniMaxH3SafeAVSaveT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SafeAVSaveT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SafeAVSaveT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Safe AV Save / 安全音视频保存 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SafeAVSaveT8Advanced.description: Encode raw even-size IMAGE and AUDIO at 24fps through isolated single-thread H264/AAC. Strict decode before publication, no overwrite. Requires FFmpeg on PATH. Returns reusable VIDEO without a second SaveVideo.

sampler.tooltip: 连接原生 Setup 的 euler，不使用 dual_clock_euler。

sigmas.tooltip: 完整首采时间表：从 1 到 0，至少 2 步。

upscaler_model.tooltip: models/latent_upscale_models 内的 H3 学习型潜空间放大模型。必须显式选择。

low_evaluations.tooltip: 小画幅的步数。例：完整 8 步中选 6，则放大后还采 2 步。至少留 1 步。

low_scale.tooltip: 小画幅宽高比例，按 32 像素对齐；0.5 不是保证 4 倍加速。

reserve_vram_mib.tooltip: 阶段边界和采样回调检查的显存余量，不代表峰值预测或不会 OOM。

model_hires.tooltip: 可选HIGH阶段MODEL；可独立串联LoRA/注意力补丁，原有补丁保留。结构和AV时钟须匹配；不接沿用model。

guide_resize.tooltip: 首帧LOW参考缩放；preserve_mean显式保持通道均值，HIGH原参考不变。

eav_mode.tooltip: 分阶段EAV使用完整8/20步原视频sigma时钟，CFG1。report_only只测量，apply_exp实际增强；不是画质认证。

eav_start_video_progress.tooltip: 1-原视频sigma；切换分辨率不重置。旧API省略该参数仍保留原0/1合同。

eav_g_hard_limit.tooltip: 真实超限正常报错，不截断或重试。关闭选disabled，tau=0不是关闭。

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveSamplerEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveSamplerEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveSamplerEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Progressive Sampler / 渐进分辨率首采 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveSamplerEXPT8.description: 先以较小画幅采样，再用学习型模型放大潜空间，完成剩余步数。仅当前 Core 原生 Euler 的 T2VA/首帧 I2VA；输入必须是空 AV 潜空间。不是完成一采后的 VDN 二采，不锁音轨，不启用像素锚或分块。已有本机短片速度对照；画质仍需按素材审看，不保证省显存。可选HIGH模型及分阶段EAV；Relay接配对MODEL/positive，TST可接MODEL配置节点。缺失放大模型时不会改用普通插值。

runtime_directory.tooltip: 留空使用 ComfyUI/models/DLSS-FI/310.7.0；也可填已安装运行目录。需要 dlssg-worker.exe 和 nvngx_dlssg.dll，不是 DLSS-NR 目录。

cut_frames.tooltip: 硬切后第一帧的索引，从 0 开始，例如 24,48。留空表示无硬切；不会自动识别镜头。

timeout_seconds.tooltip: 完整文件处理的最长秒数；超时停止本节点自己的子进程，不重试。

MiniMaxH3DLSSFrameInterpolationEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3DLSSFrameInterpolationEXPT8
MiniMaxH3DLSSFrameInterpolationEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 DLSS 视频插帧 2x (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3DLSSFrameInterpolationEXPT8.description: 独立成片插帧：24→48 / 30→60fps，时长和原音轨不变。不是超分，也不加速 H3 采样。仅 Windows 单 RTX 显卡、8bit SDR 恒定帧率文件；需要自行提供独立 DLSSG 运行文件。

MiniMaxH3TRTVAECheckEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TRTVAECheckEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TRTVAECheckEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 TRT VAE 安装检查 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TRTVAECheckEXPT8.description: 只检查独立运行文件是否齐全，不编译、不加载GPU，也不安装依赖。文件齐全不代表实际推理已验收。

native_video_vae.tooltip: 原版H3视频VAE；不选择音频VAE。编码保持原生时仍需这份权重。

decoder_engine.tooltip: 本机编译的解码引擎；单帧或小尺寸需要flex引擎。

cpu_output_budget_mib.tooltip: 解码后的CPU像素缓冲上限，不是显存上限。

MiniMaxH3TRTVAEDecoderEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TRTVAEDecoderEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TRTVAEDecoderEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 TRT VAE 解码加速 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TRTVAEDecoderEXPT8.description: 推荐先用此模式：只替换视频解码，图片/参考视频编码保持原生。连接到原来video_vae的位置，音频VAE不变。

native_video_vae.tooltip: 原版H3视频VAE；不选择音频VAE。编码保持原生时仍需这份权重。

decoder_engine.tooltip: 本机编译的解码引擎；单帧或小尺寸需要flex引擎。

cpu_output_budget_mib.tooltip: 解码后的CPU像素缓冲上限，不是显存上限。

image_encoder_engine.tooltip: 选择T1单帧编码引擎，不把单图补成17帧。

video_encoder_engine.tooltip: 选择T17视频编码引擎；内部自动分块。

MiniMaxH3TRTVAEFullEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TRTVAEFullEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TRTVAEFullEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 TRT VAE 编码＋解码 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TRTVAEFullEXPT8.description: 可选完整模式：参考图/视频编码也用TRT，编码差异可能影响后续采样。单图未体现提速，默认建议只加速解码。

kind.tooltip: 推荐flex解码；W4A16已审短片整体可接受，但量化差异更大，不承诺省显存或更快。

timeout_seconds.tooltip: 单次编译时间上限。编译需要至少12000MiB空闲显存和24GiB空闲内存。

MiniMaxH3TRTVAECompileEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TRTVAECompileEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TRTVAECompileEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 TRT VAE 本机编译 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TRTVAECompileEXPT8.description: 只在准备引擎时运行。独立子进程串行编译，不改已有引擎，不下载或安装依赖；取消只结束本次子进程。

global_prompt.tooltip: Used when Prompt Relay is disabled. With Relay, leave empty or copy the Plan global prompt exactly.

segment_prompts_json.tooltip: Prompt overrides must be empty when Prompt Relay owns the timeline.

prompt_relay_mode.tooltip: disabled is exact bypass; report_only compiles/projects Relay without attention bias; apply_exp enables the projected route.

eav_mode.tooltip: Stock20 only. report_only audits CFI/g without modifying attention; apply_exp enables target-video FETA gain.

minimum_free_vram_mib.tooltip: Rechecked before every segment; this is a start floor, not a peak guarantee.

source_motion.tooltip: Dance RGB motion source. Read a different source interval per segment; generated continuity is separate.

color_match.tooltip: Match each continuation to the accepted RGB tail; bounded color correction only, not geometry repair.

video_context_mode.tooltip: EXP: constrain high-pass overlap to the accepted final tail. Ramp mode releases three latent cells at 0.25/0.5/0.75. Audio unchanged; inspect the full continuation.

low_context_source.tooltip: Accepted picture: re-encode the previous accepted movie tail for LOW video guidance only. Adds a short VAE encode, no sampling steps. New chain_id when switching. Example reviewed at 0.4MP/8s/22 context/4+4.

color_match_mode.tooltip: Temporal mode suppresses short RGB flicker in the first12 continuation frames. Motion Color EXP additionally corrects confident, bracketed local color outliers; requires OpenCV. No frame blending, geometry or audio changes; new chain_id required.

MiniMaxH3DualModelLongVideoEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3DualModelLongVideoEXPT8
MiniMaxH3DualModelLongVideoEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 双MODEL潜空间放大长视频 / Dual Model Long Video (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3DualModelLongVideoEXPT8.description: Serial low-resolution first MODEL → learned latent upscale → independent high-resolution second MODEL. Each MODEL can have its own LoRA. Width/height are final resolution; low_width/low_height are first pass. Authenticated T8 LowVRAM Attention and ChunkFFN nodes may be connected independently to either MODEL. Auto audio continues joint AV for partial4+4; only complete Stock20 first-pass audio is locked. Both spatial continuations use completed output audio. Older partial first_pass zero-lock settings are migrated. EAV requires coarse_steps20; disable it for4+4. Resume verifies content, not filenames.

source_start_seconds.tooltip: Offset into source frames and source_audio; aligned original music is output below.

source_fps.tooltip: Connect Get Video Components fps. Overrides the manual rational frame rate.

MiniMaxH3DanceMotionSourceEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3DanceMotionSourceEXPT8
MiniMaxH3DanceMotionSourceEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 舞蹈动作参考 / Dance Motion Source (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3DanceMotionSourceEXPT8.description: Connect source dance frames in original CFR order. Each long-video segment reads its own source interval including overlap; generated continuity stays separate. Connect the target character to ref_images and original music to final_audio on the loop. This is soft RGB reference, not strict pose control. Normalize variable-frame-rate media first; no automatic speed change.

install_directory.tooltip: 正式 Topaz Video 程序目录，不是模型目录。

model_definitions_directory.tooltip: 正式安装对应的 models JSON 定义目录。

model_data_directory.tooltip: 正式 Topaz 配置的模型数据目录，可能与定义目录不同。

MiniMaxH3TopazEnvironmentEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TopazEnvironmentEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TopazEnvironmentEXPT8.display_name: Official Topaz · 环境检查 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TopazEnvironmentEXPT8.description: 检查正式安装、签名、滤镜，并在报告中列出模型ID、各倍率候选权重与可用参数。文件存在不代表能运行。不会安装、下载或运行增强；星光需独立官方 Neuroserver 与有效权限。

model_id.tooltip: iris-3 Iris：真人脸、低清人像；prob-4 Proteus：通用且参数最全；rhea-1 Rhea：中等质量细节恢复；nyx-3/nxf-1/nxl-1 Nyx：强降噪；ahq-12/amq-13/alq-13 Artemis：分别用于高/中/低质量素材；thf-4 Theia Fidelity：偏忠实；thd-3 Theia Detail：偏细节；ghq-5 Gaia HQ：高质量实拍/CG；gcg-5 Gaia CG：CG、锯齿和摩尔纹；ganim-1 Gaia Animation：动画。当前正式定义中Gaia Animation通常仅2x、Nyx Fast/XL仅1x、Nyx通常为1x/2x；其他常用模型通常有1x/2x/4x。不同安装版本以环境报告为准，不存在的倍率不是漏下载。

scale.tooltip: 不改变帧率；需在正式 Topaz 中准备对应倍率的权重。

vram_fraction.tooltip: Topaz可使用的显存比例，不是启动门槛。默认0.80；显存紧张可试0.60。

parameters_json.tooltip: 仅供精确覆盖独立控件或未来参数；普通用户不要填写。

size_mode.tooltip: scale 使用上方倍率。target_dimensions 使用下方宽高，忽略倍率；需保持原比例、1至4倍，不裁剪或拉伸。

target_width.tooltip: 仅自定义尺寸模式生效；填写32至8192之间的偶数。

target_height.tooltip: 仅自定义尺寸模式生效；宽高须同时填写并保持原视频比例。

output_directory.tooltip: 可选母版输出目录。留空写入ComfyUI/output/MiniMaxH3-Topaz；磁盘不足时可填写另一个本地目录。

custom_model_id.tooltip: 仅用于列表中尚未收录的新正式模型ID；填写后覆盖model_id。

output_profile.display_name: 高级输出策略（普通用户保持默认）
output_profile.tooltip: 默认delivery_h264自动接收常见8/10/16-bit SDR并统一输出8-bit H.264，无需按原片位深选择。Main10和lossless_master只供明确需要保留位深或审计的高级用户。HDR仍需先转为SDR。节点已直接保存，不要再接SaveVideo。

parameter_mode.tooltip: model_defaults使用模型默认；auto_estimate让Topaz抽帧估计；manual使用下方独立参数。

auto_estimate_frames.tooltip: 仅auto_estimate生效；默认8较稳定，复杂长片可试12至20，越多启动越慢。

preblur.tooltip: 负值偏抗锯齿/摩尔纹，正值偏去模糊；例如-0.20或+0.20。仅manual生效。

noise.tooltip: 例如0.20轻度、0.45中度；过高会蜡化皮肤。仅manual生效。

details.tooltip: 例如0.25自然、0.50较强；过高可能生成假纹理。仅manual生效。

halo.tooltip: 例如0.20轻度、0.50用于明显边缘光晕；过高会损失边缘。仅manual生效。

sharpen.tooltip: 内部映射Topaz blur参数；例如0.15轻锐、0.35较锐。仅manual生效。

compression.tooltip: 例如0.25轻度网压、0.55明显块效应。仅manual生效。

add_noise.tooltip: 默认0；例如0.01可帮助过度平滑素材保留纹理。仅manual生效。

grain.tooltip: 默认0；例如0.10轻颗粒、0.20明显胶片感。仅manual生效。

grain_size.tooltip: 仅输出颗粒大于0时有意义；1.0细颗粒，2.0较粗。

keep_color.tooltip: 默认true；关闭只建议用于色彩对比测试。

input_blend.tooltip: 0=完全增强，1=完全原片；0.10至0.20可减弱过度锐化或蜡感。

engine_instances.tooltip: 0最稳。1在本机60帧仅由11.5秒降到10.5秒，收益小但占用更多显存；16GB卡不建议更高。

gpu_device_index.tooltip: 单卡保持0；多卡时选择正式Topaz所使用的GPU序号。

MiniMaxH3TopazVideoEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TopazVideoEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TopazVideoEXPT8.display_name: Official Topaz · 视频高清增强 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TopazVideoEXPT8.description: 正式tvai_up高清增强；默认自动接收常见8/10/16-bit SDR并统一输出高质量8-bit H.264 MP4。兼容音轨直接保留，其他音轨自动转AAC；无需用户选择格式或再接“保存视频”。不插帧、不自动下载；Topaz软件无需保持打开。

model_id.tooltip: apo-8 Apollo：高质量通用，适合非线性运动；apf-2 Apollo Fast：速度优先；chr-2 Chronos：通用高质量变帧率；chf-3 Chronos Fast：速度优先；aion-1 Aion：新版通用插帧。请先在正式Topaz软件内下载对应模型。

duplicate_threshold.tooltip: 0或负值关闭重复帧检测；过高可能误删正常静止帧。一般保持0.01。

output_directory.tooltip: 留空写入ComfyUI/output/MiniMaxH3-Topaz；也可填写其他本地盘。

custom_model_id.tooltip: 仅用于列表未收录的正式插帧模型ID；填写后覆盖model_id。

output_profile.display_name: 高级输出策略（普通用户保持默认）
output_profile.tooltip: 默认delivery_h264自动接收常见8/10/16-bit SDR并统一输出8-bit H.264，无需按原片位深选择。Main10仅供明确需要保持10-bit的高级用户。HDR仍需先转为SDR。

gpu_device_index.tooltip: 单卡保持0；多卡选择Topaz使用的GPU。

MiniMaxH3TopazFrameInterpolationEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TopazFrameInterpolationEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TopazFrameInterpolationEXPT8.display_name: Official Topaz · 视频插帧 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TopazFrameInterpolationEXPT8.description: 独立正式tvai_fi插帧：2x/4x提高帧率但保持时长和尺寸；默认自动接收常见SDR位深并保存高质量8-bit H.264 MP4，非兼容音轨自动转AAC。不是慢动作，不与高清模型混用，不需要保持Topaz软件开启。

prepared_bundle_path.tooltip: 由准备工具生成的本地JSON绝对路径，不是工作流JSON。不同提示词需要重新准备匹配的文本/音频条件。

MiniMaxH3PreparedGenerationBundleEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PreparedGenerationBundleEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PreparedGenerationBundleEXPT8.display_name: Tao / LTX · 读取已准备生成输入 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3PreparedGenerationBundleEXPT8.description: 读取本地准备清单，不下载、不编码提示词、不运行模型。需要匹配的教师/文本缓存或LTX AV输入；完整文件身份在生成节点执行时再次检查。

noise_seed.tooltip: 视频噪声种子；Tao多请求依次加1（uint64回绕）。教师音频种子来自准备清单，不随这里改变。

chain_id.tooltip: 只用字母数字下划线连字符。改输入/种子/代码或关闭恢复时请换新ID；不会覆盖旧结果。

resume_existing.tooltip: 仅复用身份和哈希完全匹配的阶段。只生成成功而解码失败时只补解码。

serial_lease_path.tooltip: 本地串行GPU锁文件的绝对路径，必须与同时使用的其他研究入口一致。不要通过换锁文件绕过占用。

MiniMaxH3PreparedVideoEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PreparedVideoEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PreparedVideoEXPT8.display_name: Tao / LTX · 串行生成与解码 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3PreparedVideoEXPT8.description: 完整身份检查→生成latent→生成进程退出→独立VAE解码。Windows单GPU实验入口。已有严格匹配缓存只复用；报告区分新生成/恢复/旧回执迁移。尚未代表所有输入/模型质量通过。

sigmas.tooltip: 完整原生视频sigma表；HIGH只使用其对应区间，不能传只有后4步的表冒充完整8步。

mode.tooltip: disabled不安装补丁；report_only测量不改Query；apply_exp实际修正。

tau.tooltip: 修正强度；0仍计算诊断。增大不等于更清晰，需固定素材对照。

max_workspace_mib.tooltip: 显式临时tensor预算，超过会拒绝；不是整卡显存上限或无OOM保证。

MiniMaxH3TSTModelEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TSTModelEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TSTModelEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 TST Temporal Query / 时序Query修正 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3TSTModelEXPT8.description: 独立MODEL补丁。接在LoRA、后端、Relay/EAV配置之后。原生Euler、CFG1；完整SIGMAS必须与采样器一致。不是画质保证，未完成完整权重成片验收。帧均值代理的有符号Query修正，非作者代码当前的输出增益算法。LOW/HIGH可分别配置；HIGH沿用完整时间表的位置，不从0计时。

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveSetupEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Progressive Dual Setup / 渐进双模型配置 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveSetupEXPT8.description: 给LOW/HIGH配置同一完整原生Euler时间表，不执行采样。两路各接兼容LoRA和单一后端；TST应接在此节点输出之后。不接model_hires则复用LOW源配置，不改动输入MODEL。

render_window_frames.tooltip: 内部窗口至少124帧、17n+5网格，无固定帧数上限；短片按总时长裁出。窗口越大，显存和耗时通常越高。

low_evaluations.tooltip: 完整8步表中填4为4+4，填6为6+2；至少留1步HIGH。

resume_existing.tooltip: 相同输入重新执行会核验后复用阶段/成片。关闭则拒绝已有数据链；不清理旧结果。

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLongVideoEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLongVideoEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLongVideoEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Progressive Long Video / 渐进双采长视频 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLongVideoEXPT8.description: 独立渐进长视频实验：每段完整Euler表拆成LOW+HIGH，复用现有3D放大器。使用内容绑定的接受画面续接、原生AV遮罩与磁盘恢复；不替换旧双MODEL节点。完整权重成片验收尚未完成。只支持T2VA或单首帧I2VA；不宣称通用多参考支持。关闭resume_existing会拒绝已有链，不删除旧文件；改配置使用新chain_id。

head_chunks.tooltip: 注意力头分组数。更大通常降低单次 attention 临时显存，但增加调用开销；1 仍启用提前释放，只是不分组。

MiniMaxH3LowVRAMAttentionT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LowVRAMAttentionT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LowVRAMAttentionT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Low VRAM Attention / 低显存注意力 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LowVRAMAttentionT8Advanced.description: 独立 T8 低显存注意力节点：提前释放 H3 归一化输入，并按头分组调用当前 Core attention。默认 4 组；数值公式不变，但不同内核形状可能产生浮点舍入差异。已有 KJ/Sage/Sol 或其他 callable 补丁不硬拦截；保留外部 block/attention forward 的层可能不安装本节点头分组。报告实际安装/保留层数，组合效果由用户承担。

chunks.tooltip: FFN 分块数。更大可能降低激活峰值，但会增加 GEMM 调用开销；1 返回原 MODEL。

seq_threshold.tooltip: 只有 packed token 数严格大于该值才分块；等于或低于阈值时保持单次原生 FFN。

MiniMaxH3ChunkFeedForwardT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkFeedForwardT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ChunkFeedForwardT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Chunk FeedForward / 分块前馈 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ChunkFeedForwardT8Advanced.description: 独立 T8 H3 SwiGLU 分块节点：仅在 packed token 数超过阈值时按 token 轴分块，降低 FFN 激活峰值。chunks=1 是完全不改 MODEL 的旁路。已有 KJ/Sage/Sol、block 或 MLP 补丁不作兼容性硬拦截，仅警告并保留/委托调用；组合风险由使用者承担，不保证兼容或实际省显存。

min_tokens.tooltip: Below this packed-token count native VSA runs Dense and reports it; 0 forces eligibility testing.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2SetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2SetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2SetupEXPT8.description: Full V2 student, not a four-step LoRA. Exact DMD8 / shift10+3 / learned VSA20%. Dense compatibility and official Comfy template are separate EXP recipes. Use the existing encoders/VAEs. Model: https://huggingface.co/FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-Comfy

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2RuntimeAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2RuntimeAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2RuntimeAuditEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Actual Dispatch Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2RuntimeAuditEXPT8.description: Wire the sampler output to run after sampling. VSA profiles count sparse dispatch and Dense eligibility failures. Dense compatibility preserves its backend; separate instrumentation is needed to measure its dispatch. Not quality acceptance.

global_prompt.tooltip: Used when Prompt Relay is disabled. With Relay, leave empty or copy the Plan global prompt exactly.

segment_prompts_json.tooltip: Prompt overrides must be empty when Prompt Relay owns the timeline.

prompt_relay_mode.tooltip: disabled is exact bypass; report_only compiles/projects Relay without attention bias; apply_exp enables the projected route.

eav_mode.tooltip: Stock20 only. report_only audits CFI/g without modifying attention; apply_exp enables target-video FETA gain.

minimum_free_vram_mib.tooltip: Rechecked before every segment; this is a start floor, not a peak guarantee.

source_motion.tooltip: Dance RGB motion source. Read a different source interval per segment; generated continuity is separate.

color_match.tooltip: Match each continuation to the accepted RGB tail; bounded color correction only, not geometry repair.

video_context_mode.tooltip: EXP: constrain high-pass overlap to the accepted final tail. Ramp mode releases three latent cells at 0.25/0.5/0.75. Audio unchanged; inspect the full continuation.

low_context_source.tooltip: Accepted picture: re-encode the previous accepted movie tail for LOW video guidance only. Adds a short VAE encode, no sampling steps. New chain_id when switching. Example reviewed at 0.4MP/8s/22 context/4+4.

color_match_mode.tooltip: Temporal mode suppresses short RGB flicker in the first12 continuation frames. Motion Color EXP additionally corrects confident, bracketed local color outliers; requires OpenCV. No frame blending, geometry or audio changes; new chain_id required.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2DualModelLongVideoEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2DualModelLongVideoEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2DualModelLongVideoEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Dual MODEL4+Upscale+4 Loop (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2DualModelLongVideoEXPT8.description: Two full V2 student MODEL branches, optional independent ordinary LoRA and T8 memory nodes. Exact trained ladder cut4+4, AV clocks10/3, learned3D latent upscale. Reference/loop is EXP, not distilled training support. Relay apply_exp requires explicitly selected dense_compat_exp; no silent loss of timeline bias. Do not connect the latent-bound single V2 setup MODEL here. No old workflow migration.

model_name.tooltip: 原版/BUNNY：https://huggingface.co/t8star/Semantic-Bridge-Comfy ；T8动漫战斗：https://huggingface.co/t8star/semantic_bridge_T8-comic-combat 。放在 models/semantic_bridge/t8_compat；不是LoRA或H3主模型。

token_scope.tooltip: all_tokens复现原作者；text_only仅修改原生tag=1行，仍不能保证歌声。

chunk_tokens.tooltip: 0 = whole sequence; required by some trained Transformer bridges.

MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeConfigT8.name: MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeConfigT8
MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeConfigT8.display_name: H3 Semantic Bridge / 模型与设置 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeConfigT8.description: 手动参数，旧默认0.10不变。新手请用‘自动模型参数’节点按文件内容读取推荐值。动漫战斗固定1.0/per_token/all_tokens/chunk=0；武术v1不是1.0。固定契约不匹配会在预检报错。多桥用显式‘组合’，不要串多个Apply。

MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeApplyT8.name: MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeApplyT8
MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeApplyT8.display_name: H3 Semantic Bridge / 应用条件 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeApplyT8.description: 接在原生条件编码之后、采样之前。Relay请使用内部Bridge入口；不要重复增强。

source_frames.tooltip: 实际H3输出帧数17n+5，不从潜空间猜时长。

source_fps.tooltip: 当前配方仅24fps；不自动重采样。

frame_policy.tooltip: exact保持帧数；124帧需显式选pad→129或crop→121，原音需另行对应处理。

source_directory.tooltip: 固定Sana源码中h3_ltx_adapter目录，非整个仓库。

MiniMaxH3LTXLatentAdapterEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3LTXLatentAdapterEXPT8
MiniMaxH3LTXLatentAdapterEXPT8.display_name: H3 → LTX 视频潜空间 / Learned Adapter (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3LTXLatentAdapterEXPT8.description: 仅转换H3视频潜空间；原AV原样另行输出。接已有learned放大之后，不再额外放大。LTX音频/条件不自动转换。

MiniMaxH3NodeSourceDiagnosticT8.name: MiniMaxH3NodeSourceDiagnosticT8
MiniMaxH3NodeSourceDiagnosticT8.display_name: T8 节点来源／运行版本诊断

report_json.tooltip: 连接已有条件／采样／放大报告，不是提示词，不改变声音。

MiniMaxH3AudioSourceExplanationT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioSourceExplanationT8
MiniMaxH3AudioSourceExplanationT8.display_name: T8 音频来源／缓存说明（只读）

mute_first_frames.tooltip: 对应开头N帧的声音置零，保留时长；太大会削掉首字。

fade_in_ms.tooltip: 静音后半余弦淡入；N=0时仅淡入。不做全片降噪或归一化。

MiniMaxH3AudioOpeningMuteFadeT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioOpeningMuteFadeT8
MiniMaxH3AudioOpeningMuteFadeT8.display_name: T8 开头音频静音＋淡入（AUDIO）

mute_first_frames.tooltip: 对应开头N帧的声音置零，保留时长；太大会削掉首字。

fade_in_ms.tooltip: 静音后半余弦淡入；N=0时仅淡入。不做全片降噪或归一化。

MiniMaxH3VideoOpeningMuteFadeT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOpeningMuteFadeT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOpeningMuteFadeT8.display_name: T8 末端音频静音＋淡入（VIDEO EXP）
MiniMaxH3VideoOpeningMuteFadeT8.description: 只改开头音频，不缩短或重采样。tensor VIDEO帧数据直通；文件VIDEO按实际帧PTS定位，视频流复制。原有trim/crop/非MP4视图由Core流式导出后处理，不加载全片RGB。AAC有损编码可能有尾部padding。

sampler.tooltip: 连接原生 Setup 的 euler，不使用 dual_clock_euler。

sigmas.tooltip: 完整首采时间表：从 1 到 0，至少 2 步。

upscaler_model.tooltip: models/latent_upscale_models 内的 H3 学习型潜空间放大模型。必须显式选择。

low_evaluations.tooltip: 小画幅的步数。例：完整 8 步中选 6，则放大后还采 2 步。至少留 1 步。

low_scale.tooltip: 小画幅宽高比例，按 32 像素对齐；0.5 不是保证 4 倍加速。

reserve_vram_mib.tooltip: 阶段边界和采样回调检查的显存余量，不代表峰值预测或不会 OOM。

model_hires.tooltip: 可选HIGH阶段MODEL；可独立串联LoRA/注意力补丁，原有补丁保留。结构和AV时钟须匹配；不接沿用model。

guide_resize.tooltip: 首帧LOW参考缩放；preserve_mean显式保持通道均值，HIGH原参考不变。

eav_mode.tooltip: 分阶段EAV使用完整8/20步原视频sigma时钟，CFG1。report_only只测量，apply_exp实际增强；不是画质认证。

eav_start_video_progress.tooltip: 1-原视频sigma；切换分辨率不重置。旧API省略该参数仍保留原0/1合同。

eav_g_hard_limit.tooltip: 真实超限正常报错，不截断或重试。关闭选disabled，tau=0不是关闭。

MiniMaxH3AvatarProgressiveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AvatarProgressiveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AvatarProgressiveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Avatar 录音驱动渐进采样（EXP/T8）
MiniMaxH3AvatarProgressiveEXPT8.description: 人物首帧＋现成录音，经原 Audio Conditioning 的 lock_source 后接此节点。录音通过原生audio mask=0参与采样，不是仅保存时贴音轨；复用原learned3D与clean-anchor。默认LOW4＋HIGH4，支持可选独立HIGH MODEL／LoRA，旧渐进节点仍要求空AV。仅phase1独立单段；不含空间分块，不是同音色生成新台词。指定短片已验收，未知素材／组合需自行验证。

checkpoint.tooltip: 下载：https://huggingface.co/t8star/Taeh3-Comfy；放models/vae_approx。taeh3.safetensors为时序版；2D另存taeh3_2d_kijai.safetensors，不覆盖时序版。

MiniMaxH3TAEH3SamplingPreviewEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TAEH3SamplingPreviewEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TAEH3SamplingPreviewEXPT8.display_name: H3 一采动态预览＋安全取消（TAEH3 EXP/T8）
MiniMaxH3TAEH3SamplingPreviewEXPT8.description: MODEL串联到原采样器。预览实际x0的连续开头片段，仅近似观察运动，不是最终画质／声音。不会增加扩散步；有少量解码开销。LOW/HIGH来自实际阶段；普通采样标为未识别。取消仅作用于本面板绑定的请求，不清队列、不结束服务。缺少预览模型时原采样继续。模型下载：https://huggingface.co/t8star/Taeh3-Comfy；保留models/vae_approx目录。

prompt_relay_plan.tooltip: 接全局Plan／Query Route后，再接长视频内循环；不要接已投影窗口。

text_policy.tooltip: preserve_all保持旧图。accepted_window_text_exp只保留与当前交付窗口相交的局部文本；已结束／未来／只在已知上下文的事件不重复送入CLIP。跨段事件仍保留原sigma。dialogue_start_owner_exp另外只让事件起始交付窗口保留<d>台词；跨段视觉描述及AV上下文不删。Global不可放<d>，未标记的对白无法识别。一次性台词尽量完整放入一个物理段；不保证逐字／不重复，组合需新chain_id。

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayWindowTextEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayWindowTextEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayWindowTextEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Long Relay · 窗口文本策略 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayWindowTextEXPT8.description: Optional global-Plan policy for native long-video projection. Old all-key behavior stays the default. The experiment omits completed/future event text without changing accepted AV context, crossing-event sigma or sampling. It is not paper-faithful all-key Relay or a no-repeat guarantee.

model_path.tooltip: 留空自动寻找models/meridian/meridian_dmd_int8_convrot_comfy.safetensors；支持MERIDIAN_MODEL环境变量。下载：https://huggingface.co/t8star/Meridian-Comfy；DMD已合并，不重复加载

omega_checkpoint.tooltip: 正确Omega1B512原始PT，不是普通VGGT或INT8。默认models/meridian/vggt-omega/checkpoints/vggt_omega_1b_512.pt；VGGT_OMEGA_CKPT。下载：https://huggingface.co/t8star/Meridian-Comfy；单独遵守FAIR非商用研究许可

cache_gib.tooltip: 自有磁盘缓存预算，不是显存准入；0关闭磁盘缓存

MiniMaxH3MeridianConfigEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MeridianConfigEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MeridianConfigEXPT8.description: 独立Meridian merged-DMD原生ConvRot INT8。懒加载，不更改旧双采或用户全局优化。外部MODEL/VAE补丁保留并提示未验证，关闭其不可靠的磁盘缓存。模型及Omega下载：https://huggingface.co/t8star/Meridian-Comfy；两者许可分别适用，源码/assets及H3 VAE另备。

window_frames.tooltip: 源窗口，按24fps归一；IMAGE只重建一次，不复制成73张再重建

MiniMaxH3MeridianMaterialEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MeridianMaterialEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MeridianMaterialEXPT8.description: 只接IMAGE或VIDEO之一。保留VIDEO活动trim/crop/画面比例，按真实PTS取所选窗口。Omega联合几何一次；1280letterbox后使用训练ROI，不拉伸。大窗口可能OOM，不自动缩小或重复运行。

strength.tooltip: 相对固定枢轴深度的位移；orbit为strength×100度。大位移补洞更多，非性能/画质保证

camera_plan.tooltip: 高级编辑器自动写入规范JSON；留空使用预设。空间轨与源时间轨独立。

MiniMaxH3MeridianCameraEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MeridianCameraEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MeridianCameraEXPT8.description: 先运行预设获得真实几何预览，再打开大编辑器。固定首源相机坐标、深度单位、roll=0；无反向源时间或自动角色跟踪。改素材/窗口后显式重置旧路径。预览是灰洞点云warp，不是生成视频。

audio_mode.tooltip: 冻结/变速选silent；source_1to1只交付原声，不认证新生成口型

MiniMaxH3MeridianGenerateEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MeridianGenerateEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MeridianGenerateEXPT8.description: 原生INT8 merged-DMD＋两路480级视频token参考＋768级训练桶。CFG1、euler、shift3/3、三次前向，原生joint AV。自动完整解码核验H264 MP4后交付。取消遵循Core普通任务中断；不改旧节点或全局队列。

MiniMaxH3DirectorProjectT8.name: MiniMaxH3DirectorProjectT8
MiniMaxH3DirectorProjectT8.display_name: 曜石导演台 / Obsidian Director D1 (T8)
MiniMaxH3DirectorProjectT8.description: Open the real director UI using the node button. This D1 node only validates saved projects and compiles contracts on CPU; it never queues generation.

prompt.default: The camera orbits the subject of <Picture 1> clockwise; five coordinated views, consistent identity and clothing.

size.tooltip: Square size of each of five images, not the total strip size.

MiniMaxH3FiveViewConditioningEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FiveViewConditioningEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FiveViewConditioningEXPT8.description: One reference to five independently decoded image slots. Requires a Ref2VA pruned base and the dedicated turnaround LoRA; not a video workflow.

MiniMaxH3FiveViewDecodeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FiveViewDecodeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FiveViewDecodeEXPT8.description: Decode five image slots separately through five legal two-token VAE clips; reject ordinary video latents.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowLoaderT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowLoaderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowLoaderT8Advanced.description: Loads the ORIGINAL 632-tensor HyperFlow adapter, maps every LoRA target, and installs its separate endpoint-time branch. Requires a full non-pruned MiniMax H3 base and the typed HyperFlow sampler. It does not substitute a generic acceleration LoRA or silently degrade to a single time.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowPlanT8Advanced.description: Creates the fixed 9-point/8-forward AV interval plan from the loaded HyperFlow artifact. It is bound to that exact MODEL, not a bare SIGMAS list.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowSamplerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowSamplerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowSamplerT8Advanced.description: Binds the HyperFlow MODEL and typed 8-interval plan to T8 dual-clock Euler. Connect outputs to the normal SamplerCustomAdvanced alongside native H3 conditioning; the old H3 sampler and standard 4+4 route are unchanged.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowSplitT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowSplitT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowSplitT8Advanced.description: Two independently content-patched HyperFlow MODELs over one trained 8-step AV trajectory, with exact x_sigma handoff and no new noise. This is a same-resolution 4+4 validation, not the legacy Director 4+4 and not a low-to-high upscale. Clone one common full H3 base for both stages.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadPlanT8Advanced.description: Absolute trained intervals 0:4 for explicit partial-x0 low-to-high 4+4 upscale only.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCoarseSamplerT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCoarseSamplerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCoarseSamplerT8Advance.description: Runs only absolute intervals 0:4. Feed SamplerCustomAdvanced's denoised_output (socket 1), not its nonterminal x_sigma result, to the learned 3D upscaler. HIGH then starts a separately re-noised 4:8 tail; this is not a continuous trajectory.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowTailPlanT8Advanced.description: Absolute trained intervals 4:8, for explicit new-noise 8+4 upscale experiment only.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowRefineSamplerT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowRefineSamplerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowRefineSamplerT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 HyperFlow Tail New-Noise Sampler (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowRefineSamplerT8Advance.description: Only for LOW full8 -> learned 3D latent upscale -> HIGH 4-interval new-noise experiment (12 total NFE). This is not a seamless 4+4 continuation. Connect the HIGH stage MODEL, upscaled clean AV latent and Tail Plan; the generic SamplerCustomAdvanced supplies a distinct noise seed.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowPartialRefineSamplerT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowPartialRefineSamplerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowPartialRefineSamplerT8.description: Only for LOW absolute 0:4 denoised_output -> learned 3D upscale -> HIGH absolute 4:8 new-noise sampler (8 total NFE).

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowLatentParityT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowLatentParityT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowLatentParityT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 HyperFlow Latent Parity Audit (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowLatentParityT8Advanced.description: Read-only video/audio latent difference between continuous split and single8.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowLongVideoEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowLongVideoEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowLongVideoEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 HyperFlow 双采长片 / Long Video (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowLongVideoEXPT8.description: Separate T2VA/native HyperFlow 0:4 predicted x0 → learned 3D → new-noise 4:8 long-video experiment. Two content-LoRA MODEL branches must come from one full H3 base; select the original HyperFlow file separately. Uses its own stage-cache namespace and a new chain_id. Only a total-eight-second/two-segment film is planned for qualification; visual/audio seam quality is not inherited from legacy 4+4.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowSingle8LongVideoEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowSingle8LongVideoEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowSingle8LongVideoEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 HyperFlow 原生8步长片 / Single8 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowSingle8LongVideoEXPT8.description: T2VA/native only. Each segment runs one complete trained HyperFlow 0:8 AV trajectory at final dimensions. No dual pass or learned upscaler. Separate cache and chain_id; picture/audio seam needs review.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2StageSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2StageSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2StageSetupEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Separate LOW / HIGH Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2StageSetupEXPT8.description: Sets up ONE exact DMD stage, never runs a hidden loop. Use two standard SamplerCustomAdvanced nodes and the existing learned upscale/reconcile nodes. Each stage accepts its own MODEL and LoRA chain. LOW uses absolute 0:4; HIGH uses 4:8 with AV shifts 10/3. Split/reference use remains experimental.

MiniMaxH3StageEAVConfigEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageEAVConfigEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageEAVConfigEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage EAV · External Config (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageEAVConfigEXPT8.description: Reusable immutable configuration. Connect only LOW, only HIGH, or separate configs to both. Progress is absolute 1-video_sigma; it is not reset at the stage boundary. disabled is exact bypass; tau=0 is not an off switch.

MiniMaxH3StageEAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageEAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageEAVApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage EAV · Apply to This Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageEAVApplyEXPT8.description: Bind one stage after its Setup/Bind. Supports V2, Native Dual, explicit native, PDD, Manual Pass and RF without changing legacy EAV. Keeps the selected backend and authenticated Relay; does not silently replace VSA with Dense. Native V2 sparse FETA uses bounded extra video projections and the original kernel; CUDA qualification and sparse Relay bias remain pending. Foreign producers may bypass effects. Connect matching stage SIGMAS and AV latent and inspect the downstream audit.

MiniMaxH3StageEAVAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageEAVAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageEAVAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage EAV · Actual Calls Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageEAVAuditEXPT8.description: Wire after the matching sampler. Reports actual absolute sigmas, FETA/Relay calls and incomplete producer coverage. No GPU-quality claim or persisted-cache authorization.

MiniMaxH3StageSamplerEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageSamplerEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageSamplerEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage Sampler · ONE Stage + Result (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageSamplerEXPT8.description: Runs exactly one native SamplerCustomAdvanced call. The five native inputs and first two outputs are unchanged; adds typed stage evidence for optional saving. No loop, second pass, retry or automatic cache. Binds V2, Native Dual, explicit native, Manual Pass and RF adapters.

MiniMaxH3StageSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage Result · Save Frozen Artifact (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageSaveEXPT8.description: Writes a new immutable native AV artifact under output/MiniMaxH3/stage_artifacts. Outputs exact path and mandatory SHA for explicit restoration. Existing artifacts are never overwritten. Incomplete or unknown sampler execution is rejected before a completed artifact is written; inspect report_json.

MiniMaxH3StageLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage Result · Load Exact Frozen Artifact (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageLoadEXPT8.description: Explicitly selects a saved stage by relative manifest path and exact SHA. Never runs LOW or loads a model. Keeps x_sigma and denoised_output distinct. This freezes the selected prior result, not a claim that edited LOW settings still match. To rerun only HIGH, use saved LOW denoised_output at the existing learned upscale handoff.

MiniMaxH3NativeDualStageSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3NativeDualStageSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3NativeDualStageSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 Native Dual · Separate LOW4 / LOW20 / HIGH3-5 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3NativeDualStageSetupEXPT8.description: Sets up ONE original Dual stage: LOW4 is simple8 prefix, LOW20 full native flow, HIGH3/4/5 published LBH tables with this MODEL's own AV shifts. No sampling or loop. LOW denoised_output -> existing learned3D -> Native Dual Handoff -> independent HIGH.

MiniMaxH3NativeDualHandoffEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3NativeDualHandoffEXPT8
MiniMaxH3NativeDualHandoffEXPT8.display_name: H3 Native Dual · Learned / Audio Handoff (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3NativeDualHandoffEXPT8.description: Original Dual audio reconciliation after the existing learned3D upscaler. LOW4 auto continues unfinished joint audio; LOW20 auto preserves completed audio. Keeps template-locked audio prefix and old first_pass/zero migration. No sampler or upscale.

MiniMaxH3ManualPassStageSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ManualPassStageSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ManualPassStageSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 Manual Second Pass · Separate Stage Setup (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ManualPassStageSetupEXPT8.description: One original full first stage OR independent manual second stage. Does not sample. Wire first OUTPUT to second latent_image, not learned-upscale denoised_output. Each stage has independent MODEL, conditions and fresh NOISE; same seed reproduces old loops. dual_clock_euler/euler completion adapted; other Core samplers run without false certification.

MiniMaxH3StageNoiseEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageNoiseEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageNoiseEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage Noise · External FreeNoise / Legacy Plan (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageNoiseEXPT8.description: Wraps one NOISE generation; no diffusion. Reuses original FreeNoise video permutation/blend, preserves source seed/batch_index and exact audio noise. Same segment_index for both passes reproduces old loops. from_model_plan reads the optional MODEL's old FreeNoise configuration. disabled or absent model plan is exact provider bypass; configuration report is not execution.

MiniMaxH3RFBaseStageSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3RFBaseStageSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3RFBaseStageSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 RF · Base Descent Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3RFBaseStageSetupEXPT8.description: ONE native dual-clock descent with explicit full/partial/tail SIGMAS. No hidden restart. Bias/STG/Relay/EAV stay external. Stage Sampler preserves the original template and exact model-space endpoint before Core's float32 output boundary for frozen restart.

MiniMaxH3RFHandoffEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3RFHandoffEXPT8
MiniMaxH3RFHandoffEXPT8.display_name: H3 RF · Endpoint + Original Template (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3RFHandoffEXPT8.description: Bind completed OUTPUT and the original base template; no model call or random draw. Original template can be omitted only when a Stage Sampler RF result already contains it. Do not substitute denoised or the completed endpoint for the original inpaint/audio anchor. A plain Core output lacks the exact pre-conversion state; base_sigmas preserves schedule dtype only.

MiniMaxH3RFRestartStageSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3RFRestartStageSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3RFRestartStageSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 RF · Restart Descent Only (T8 EXP)
